items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I have known Mr. Park since I moved to this town.
The museum has opened in 1998, and many people have visited it since then.
My sister has gone to Jeju, so she isn't here now.
How long have you been waiting for the bus?
He has just finished cleaning the kitchen.
items.exp: in 1998처럼 명확한 과거 시점은 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없어서 has opened를 opened로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: How long do you know each other?
She has been to London last year.
Two years have passed since we have moved to this city.
Have you ever been to the new library downtown?
I didn't see her since she left for Busan.
items.exp: ever와 함께 경험을 묻는 현재완료 의문문은 옳아요. since가 이끄는 절에는 과거시제(moved)를 쓰고, since 앞 주절은 현재완료(haven't seen, have known)여야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: My brother has been playing games since he got home.
Each of the students has finished the project.
The books on the shelf have been there for months.
It has rained a lot this week.
One of my friends have visited Paris twice.
items.exp: 주어가 'One of + 복수명사'이면 중심어는 One이라 단수 동사를 써요. have visited를 has visited로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: He has been knowing her for a long time.
We have met each other two days ago.
Mina has went to the bakery to buy some bread.
I have read this novel three times so far.
items.exp: so far는 현재완료와 잘 어울려요. went는 gone으로, two days ago와 when은 과거시제로, 상태동사 know는 진행형 대신 has known으로 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) I have never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
(b) Have you finished your report yesterday?
(c) The weather has been cold since last week.
(d) She has lived in Seoul when she was a child.
(e) How many times have you visited your grandparents this year?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 경험을 나타내는 현재완료예요. (b) 틀림: yesterday는 과거 시점이라 Did you finish로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: since + 과거 시점과 현재완료가 맞게 쓰였어요. (d) 틀림: when she was a child는 과거라 lived로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: this year는 현재를 포함하는 기간이라 현재완료와 쓸 수 있어요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) My father has worked at the bank for twenty years.
(b) I have lost my key, so I can't open the door.
(c) Since I was ten, I have been interested in drawing.
(d) The baby has been sleep for three hours.
(e) Have you heard the news? The game has been canceled.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: for + 기간과 현재완료(계속)예요. (b) 옳음: 결과를 나타내는 현재완료예요. (c) 옳음: since절은 과거, 주절은 현재완료로 맞아요. (d) 틀림: 현재완료진행형은 have been -ing라서 sleeping으로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 현재완료 수동태 has been p.p.가 맞게 쓰였어요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) Jake has finished his homework an hour ago.
(b) How long have you had this bike?
(c) We haven't eaten anything since this morning.
(d) My cousin has visited Korea in 2022.
(e) The children have been played outside for an hour.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: an hour ago는 과거 시점이라 finished로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: 계속을 묻는 현재완료 의문문이에요. (c) 옳음: since this morning과 현재완료가 맞게 쓰였어요. (d) 틀림: in 2022는 명확한 과거라 visited로 써야 해요. (e) 틀림: 아이들이 노는 것이므로 진행형 have been playing으로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I have already sent the email to the teacher.
(b) She has been sick since three days.
(c) Have you ever tried Thai food?
(d) He has just came back from the gym.
(e) We have known each other for a long time.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 완료를 나타내는 현재완료예요. (b) 틀림: three days는 기간이라 since가 아니라 for를 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 경험을 묻는 현재완료예요. (d) 틀림: come의 과거분사는 come이라 has just come으로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 상태동사 know의 현재완료(계속)예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) They have been waiting in line since 7 a.m.
(b) When did you start learning the guitar?
(c) I have seen that movie last weekend.
(d) The number of tourists has increased since 2019.
(e) A lot of students has joined the club this year.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 현재완료진행형으로 계속을 나타내요. (b) 옳음: when 의문문은 과거시제로 맞게 썼어요. (c) 틀림: last weekend는 과거 시점이라 saw로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: 'The number of ~'는 단수 취급이라 has가 맞아요. (e) 틀림: A lot of students는 복수라 have joined로 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) My grandmother has never used a smartphone before.
(b) The train has just left the station.
(c) I have been knowing the answer for a while.
(d) Where have you been? I've been looking for you.
(e) Minho has gone to Canada twice.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 경험을 나타내는 현재완료예요. (b) 옳음: 완료를 나타내는 현재완료예요. (c) 틀림: know는 진행형으로 쓰지 않아 have known으로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: 현재완료와 현재완료진행형이 맞게 쓰였어요. (e) 틀림: have gone to는 '가 버리고 없다'는 결과라 횟수와 쓸 수 없고, 경험은 has been to로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I have played the piano (A) ___ I was seven.
• He (B) ___ his leg last month, so he still can't run.
items.exp: (A) 뒤에 시작 시점(I was seven)이 오므로 since를 써요. (B) last month는 명확한 과거 시점이라 현재완료가 아니라 과거시제 broke를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The number of cars on this road (A) ___ grown since 2015.
• I (B) ___ my homework yet.
items.exp: (A) 'The number of + 복수명사'는 단수 취급이라 has를 써요. (B) 주어가 I이고 현재완료 부정은 haven't + 과거분사이므로 haven't finished예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I [have lost] my wallet, so I have to walk home.
choices: We [have lived] here for ten years.
He [has gone] to Paris, so he isn't here.
items.exp: <보기>는 지갑을 잃어버려서 지금 없다는 '결과' 용법이에요. 파리에 가 버려서 지금 여기 없다는 문장이 같은 결과 용법이고, 나머지는 경험·계속·완료·경험이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
items.exp: 2015년부터 지금까지 알고 지낸다는 '계속' 용법이고, 나머지는 모두 '경험' 용법이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 도서관은 작년에 문을 닫은 이후로 아직 다시 열지 않았다.
items.s: The library ___ again since it closed last year.
items.exp: 작년에 닫은 이후 지금까지 계속 열지 않은 상태이므로 현재완료 부정 has not opened를 써요. 주어가 단수라 has예요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Jisu started to learn Chinese three years ago. She is still learning it.
items.s: Jisu ___ Chinese for three years.
items.exp: 3년 전에 시작해서 지금도 배우고 있으므로 현재완료진행형 has been learning을 써요. 주어 Jisu는 3인칭 단수라 has예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My parents [have bought] this car in 2015, and they still drive it. → ___
items.exp: in 2015는 명확한 과거 시점이므로 현재완료가 아니라 과거시제 bought를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The boxes in the corner of the room [has been] there for weeks. → ___
items.exp: 주어의 중심어는 The boxes(복수)이고 in the corner of the room은 수식어구예요. 그래서 have been으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 노래는 발표된 이후로 수백만 번 재생되었다.
items.s: This song ___ millions of times since it came out.
items.exp: since가 있어 현재완료를 쓰고, 노래는 '재생되는' 대상이라 수동태예요. 그래서 has been played가 돼요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Mr. Kim went to London, and he isn't here now.
items.s: Mr. Kim ___ London.
items.exp: 런던에 가서 지금 여기 없다는 '결과'는 has gone to로 나타내요. has been to는 '가 본 적이 있다'는 뜻이라 맞지 않아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: By the time you come back, I will have cleaned the whole house.
She had been living in Busan for five years before she moved to Seoul.
We had never seen snow until we visited Canada.
When I got to the bus stop, the bus had already left.
He lost the watch that his father has given him.
items.exp: 시계를 잃어버린 것(과거)보다 아버지가 준 것이 더 먼저이므로 has given이 아니라 과거완료 had given으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I didn't know that he had moved to another city.
By the time the movie will end, it will be midnight.
By next year, my brother will have finish his military service.
When I arrived, they have already started the meeting.
I had been knowing him for years before we became friends.
items.exp: 몰랐던 시점보다 이사한 일이 먼저라 had moved가 맞아요. will have finished, 시간 부사절의 ends, had already started, 상태동사 know의 had known으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: By the end of this month, I will have read ten books.
Next Friday, we will have been married for twenty years.
Until last year, I had never traveled by plane.
When the police arrived, the thief had run away.
My sister went to bed after she has finished her homework.
items.exp: 잠자리에 든 것(과거)보다 숙제를 끝낸 것이 먼저이므로 has finished가 아니라 had finished(또는 finished)로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: She will has finished the report by tomorrow.
He told me that he had been seen the movie twice.
I will have been worked here for ten years next month.
By the time we reached the top, the sun had already set.
The game has already started when we turned on the TV.
items.exp: 정상에 도착한 과거 시점보다 해가 먼저 졌으므로 had already set이 맞아요. 나머지는 will have worked, had already started, will have finished, had seen으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) When I woke up, my mom had already made breakfast.
(b) By the time he arrives, we will have eaten all the pizza.
(c) I had studied English for three years before I go to Canada.
(d) The shop had been closed for an hour when we got there.
(e) By 2030, the new bridge will have been built.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 깬 시점보다 먼저 끝난 일이라 과거완료예요. (b) 옳음: 시간 부사절은 현재(arrives), 주절은 미래완료로 맞아요. (c) 틀림: 기준 시점이 과거이므로 go를 went로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: 도착 시점까지 닫혀 있던 상태가 계속된 과거완료예요. (e) 옳음: 미래완료 수동태 will have been p.p.예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) She said she had never eaten Indian food before.
(b) By this time tomorrow, I will have arrived in Jeju.
(c) The kids had been played outside for hours when it started to rain.
(d) I will have finished my homework by the time you will call me.
(e) We were tired because we had walked all day.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 말한 시점보다 앞선 경험이라 과거완료예요. (b) 옳음: 미래 시점까지 완료될 일이라 미래완료예요. (c) 틀림: 아이들이 논 것이므로 had been playing으로 써야 해요. (d) 틀림: 시간 부사절에서는 미래 대신 현재를 써서 you call로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 피곤했던 과거보다 앞서 걸은 일이라 과거완료예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) He had lost his key, so he couldn't get into the house.
(b) By next summer, I will have learn to swim.
(c) When I called her, she has already gone out.
(d) They have lived in this town for ten years by next month.
(e) Before I met Sam, I had never talked to a foreigner.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 들어가지 못한 과거보다 먼저 잃어버린 결과라 과거완료예요. (b) 틀림: 미래완료는 will have + 과거분사라 learned로 써야 해요. (c) 틀림: 전화한 과거 시점 기준이므로 had already gone으로 써야 해요. (d) 틀림: by next month는 미래 시점이라 will have lived로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 만나기 전까지의 경험이라 과거완료예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I had never ridden a bike until I was ten.
(b) By the time she got home, her family has had dinner.
(c) We will have known each other for ten years next spring.
(d) He had been waited for an hour when the bus came.
(e) The movie had already began when we found our seats.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 열 살 이전까지의 경험이라 과거완료예요. (b) 틀림: got home(과거) 기준이므로 had had로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 미래 시점까지 계속될 일이라 미래완료예요. (d) 틀림: 그가 기다린 것이므로 had been waiting으로 써야 해요. (e) 틀림: begin의 과거분사는 begun이라 had already begun으로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) By the end of the day, he will have written three letters.
(b) She found that someone had eaten her cake.
(c) I had finished the test before the bell rings.
(d) They will have been arrived by noon.
(e) He was nervous because he had never given a speech before.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 미래 시점까지 완료될 일이라 미래완료예요. (b) 옳음: 발견한 시점보다 먼저 일어난 일이라 과거완료예요. (c) 틀림: 과거 일이므로 rings를 rang으로 써야 해요. (d) 틀림: arrive는 자동사라 수동태가 안 되므로 will have arrived로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 그 이전까지의 경험이라 과거완료예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) After he had locked the door, he went to bed.
(b) My uncle will have worked at the company for thirty years next year.
(c) When I came home, my dog had been waited for me at the door.
(d) Jane had already left the party by the time I arrived.
(e) By next week, the new library will be opened for a month.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 잠자리에 들기 전 먼저 한 일이라 과거완료예요. (b) 옳음: 미래 시점까지 계속될 일이라 미래완료예요. (c) 틀림: 개가 기다린 것이므로 had been waiting으로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: 내가 도착한 과거 시점보다 먼저 떠났으므로 과거완료예요. (e) 틀림: 다음 주까지 한 달째 계속 열려 있는 상태이므로 will have been open으로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• When I arrived at the station, the train (A) ___.
• By next month, I (B) ___ here for a year.
choices: has already left – will have worked
had already left – will have work
had already been left – will have worked
had already left – will have worked
items.exp: (A) 도착한 과거 시점보다 기차가 먼저 떠났으므로 과거완료 had already left예요. (B) by next month까지 1년째 계속될 일이므로 미래완료 will have worked예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• She was upset because she (A) ___ her phone on the bus.
• By the time you read this letter, I (B) ___ the country.
items.exp: (A) 속상했던 과거보다 휴대폰을 두고 내린 일이 먼저라 had left예요. (B) 편지를 읽을 미래 시점에는 이미 떠난 뒤일 것이므로 미래완료 will have left예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I [had never seen] a koala until I visited Australia.
choices: When I got home, the party [had already ended].
They [had just finished] dinner when I called.
He [had never been] abroad before he turned twenty.
I [had lost] my key, so I couldn't open the door.
She [had lived] in Busan for ten years before she moved.
items.exp: <보기>는 그때까지 본 적이 없었다는 '경험' 용법이에요. 스무 살 전까지 외국에 가 본 적이 없었다는 문장이 같은 경험이고, 나머지는 완료·계속·결과·완료예요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: By noon, she [will have finished] the report.
They [will have been married] for twenty years next May.
I [will have worked] at this company for ten years next month.
By next year, he [will have lived] here for five years.
Next week, we [will have known] each other for a year.
items.exp: 정오까지 보고서를 끝낼 것이라는 '완료' 용법이고, 나머지는 모두 for + 기간과 함께 쓰인 '계속' 용법이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 극장에 도착했을 때, 영화는 이미 시작했었다.
items.s: When I arrived at the theater, the movie ___.
items.exp: 도착한 과거 시점보다 영화가 먼저 시작했으므로 과거완료 had already started를 써요. already는 had와 과거분사 사이에 와요.

items.q: 다음 상황을 읽고 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Ann started cleaning at 1:00. Her mom came home at 4:00, and Ann was still cleaning.
items.s: Ann ___ for three hours when her mom came home.
items.exp: 엄마가 온 과거 시점까지 3시간 동안 계속 청소하고 있었으므로 과거완료진행형 had been cleaning을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: By the time we [will get] to the airport, the plane will have taken off. → ___
items.exp: by the time이 이끄는 시간 부사절에서는 미래의 일이라도 현재시제를 써요. 주어가 we라서 get이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She showed me the pictures that she [has taken] in Italy the year before. → ___
items.exp: 보여 준 것(과거)보다 사진을 찍은 것이 먼저이고 the year before도 과거 기준의 '그 전 해'라서 과거완료 had taken을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 다리는 2030년까지는 완공되어 있을 것이다.
items.s: The bridge ___ by 2030.
items.exp: 2030년까지 완료될 일이라 미래완료이고, 다리는 '완공되는' 대상이라 수동태예요. 그래서 will have been completed예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I lost my umbrella. The next day, I found it.
items.s: The next day, I found the umbrella that I ___.
items.exp: 우산을 찾은 것(과거)보다 잃어버린 것이 먼저 일어났으므로 과거완료 had lost를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: He may can fix the computer for you.
You ought not to tell lies to your friends.
We don't have to hurry. The movie starts at eight.
She must be tired after the long trip.
You will have to wear a uniform from next week.
items.exp: 조동사 두 개를 나란히 쓸 수 없어요. may can은 may be able to로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Do you able to swim across the river?
You must not to touch the paintings in the museum.
She has to cleans her room every Saturday.
I was able to finish the race though I hurt my leg.
He ought to not eat so much junk food.
items.exp: was able to + 동사원형은 옳아요. has to clean, must not touch, Are you able to, ought not to로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: That can't be Mina. She is in Busan now.
You don't have to bring lunch. Lunch will be provided.
May I borrow your pen for a minute?
Jake had to stay home yesterday because he was sick.
Everyone in my family have to get up early on weekdays.
items.exp: Everyone은 단수 취급이고 in my family는 수식어구예요. 그래서 have to를 has to로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: We have to take the test last Monday.
He doesn't have to come if he is busy.
She will must leave early tomorrow.
Students must not using phones during class.
You should to eat more vegetables.
items.exp: doesn't have to + 동사원형(~할 필요가 없다)은 옳아요. should eat, must not use, will have to leave, had to take로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) You must not run in the hallway.
(b) My grandfather can't walk without a cane, but he could run fast when he was young.
(c) She will can get a job soon.
(d) Does he have to wear glasses when he drives?
(e) We ought to protecting the environment.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: must not + 동사원형(금지)이에요. (b) 옳음: 과거의 능력은 could로 나타내요. (c) 틀림: 조동사를 겹쳐 쓸 수 없어 will be able to로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: have to의 의문문은 Does he have to ~?예요. (e) 틀림: ought to 뒤에는 동사원형 protect를 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) You don't have to pay. It's free.
(b) He musts be very hungry now.
(c) I had to waited in line for an hour.
(d) Were you able to find your wallet?
(e) Visitors may not take pictures inside the museum.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 불필요(~할 필요 없다)를 나타내요. (b) 틀림: 조동사에는 -s를 붙이지 않아 must로 써야 해요. (c) 틀림: had to 뒤에는 동사원형 wait를 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: be able to의 과거 의문문이에요. (e) 옳음: may not(~하면 안 된다)이 맞게 쓰였어요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) She may not like spicy food.
(b) You should not leave the door open.
(c) The students will have to finish the project by Friday.
(d) Can I use your phone? Mine is dead.
(e) He doesn't has to come early.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: may not + 동사원형(~하지 않을지도 모른다)이에요. (b) 옳음: should not + 동사원형이에요. (c) 옳음: 미래의 의무는 will have to로 나타내요. (d) 옳음: 허락을 구하는 Can I ~?예요. (e) 틀림: doesn't 뒤에는 동사원형이 와서 doesn't have to로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) You ought not to stay up too late.
(b) He must be at home. The lights are on.
(c) My sister can speaks three languages.
(d) We didn't have to wear masks yesterday.
(e) Jiwon must not to be late again.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: ought to의 부정은 ought not to예요. (b) 옳음: 강한 추측의 must be예요. (c) 틀림: can 뒤에는 동사원형 speak를 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: 과거의 불필요는 didn't have to로 나타내요. (e) 틀림: must not 뒤에는 to 없이 동사원형 be를 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Can you be able to come to my party?
(b) Each of the players has to wear a helmet.
(c) You will be able to see the stars tonight.
(d) She had to leave early last night.
(e) He mays be in the library now.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: can과 be able to는 같은 뜻이라 함께 쓰지 않아 Can you come이나 Are you able to come으로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: Each of ~는 단수 취급이라 has to가 맞아요. (c) 옳음: 미래의 능력은 will be able to로 나타내요. (d) 옳음: 과거의 의무는 had to로 나타내요. (e) 틀림: 조동사에는 -s를 붙이지 않아 may로 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The story can't be true. It doesn't make sense.
(b) Do I have to bring my own lunch?
(c) You don't have to worry about it.
(d) We should keeping quiet in the library.
(e) He has to study hard last year.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 강한 부정 추측 can't be예요. (b) 옳음: have to의 의문문이에요. (c) 옳음: 불필요를 나타내는 don't have to예요. (d) 틀림: should 뒤에는 동사원형 keep을 써야 해요. (e) 틀림: last year는 과거라 had to로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법과 문맥상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I lost my key, so I (A) ___ wait outside until Mom came home.
• You (B) ___ bring an umbrella. It won't rain today.
items.exp: (A) 과거(came)의 의무이므로 had to를 써요. must는 과거형이 없어요. (B) 비가 오지 않으니 우산을 가져올 '필요가 없다'는 don't have to예요. must not은 '금지'라 문맥에 맞지 않아요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법과 문맥상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• He (A) ___ be Mr. Lee's son. He looks just like him.
• She (B) ___ be at school. Today is Sunday.
items.exp: (A) 아주 닮았다는 근거로 '~임에 틀림없다'는 강한 추측 must예요. (B) 일요일이라 학교에 있을 리가 없다는 강한 부정 추측 can't예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> You [must] finish the report by tomorrow.
choices: She [must] be tired after working all day.
He [must] be very rich to buy that car.
Students [must] wear uniforms at this school.
It [must] be cold outside. Look at the snow.
items.exp: <보기>의 must는 '~해야 한다'는 의무예요. 교복을 입어야 한다는 문장이 같은 의무이고, 나머지는 모두 '~임에 틀림없다'는 추측이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: My little sister [can] read English books.
items.exp: 영어책을 읽을 수 있다는 '능력'의 can이고, 나머지는 모두 '~해도 된다'는 허가의 can이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너는 내일 일찍 올 필요가 없다.
items.s: You ___ early tomorrow.
items.exp: '~할 필요가 없다'는 불필요는 don't have to + 동사원형으로 나타내요. must not은 금지라 뜻이 달라요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 다음 달에는 혼자 운전할 수 있을 것이다.
items.s: He ___ by himself next month.
items.exp: 미래의 능력은 조동사 두 개(will can)를 겹칠 수 없어서 will be able to + 동사원형으로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Last night, I [must] stay up late to finish my homework. → ___
items.exp: must는 과거형이 없으므로 과거의 의무(Last night)는 had to로 나타내요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: One of the rules is that every visitor [have to] wear a mask. → ___
items.exp: that절의 주어 every visitor는 단수라 has to로 써야 해요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: It is certain that Jiho is angry with me.
items.s: Jiho ___ angry with me.
items.exp: It is certain that ~(~이 확실하다)은 강한 추측의 must be로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: You should not swim in this river.
items.s: You ___ swim in this river.
items.exp: should not은 ought not to로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어요. not의 위치는 ought와 to 사이예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: You had better not eat too much before bed.
My dad is used to get up early for work.
There used to be a small bakery on this corner.
I would rather walk than take a crowded bus.
She must have forgotten about our meeting.
items.exp: '~하는 데 익숙하다'는 be used to + -ing이므로 get을 getting으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He would rather not to talk about it.
She used to living in a small village.
I should have studied harder for the test.
You'd better to take an umbrella.
items.exp: should have + 과거분사(~했어야 했는데)는 옳아요. had better take, would rather not talk, used to live, must have left로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: When I was young, there would be a tall tree in front of the school.
He didn't use to like milk, but now he loves it.
This tool is used to cut wood.
We would go fishing every Sunday when we were young.
I'm sorry. I shouldn't have yelled at you.
items.exp: would는 과거의 반복된 '동작'에만 쓰고 과거의 '상태'에는 쓰지 않아요. 그래서 would를 used to로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: He must have be very nervous yesterday.
My grandmother is used to using a smartphone now.
I would rather to stay home than go out.
You had not better go out alone at night.
Jenny might has taken the wrong bus.
items.exp: be used to + -ing(~에 익숙하다)는 옳아요. had better not, might have taken, would rather stay, must have been으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) You'd better not skip breakfast.
(b) This knife is used to cutting bread.
(c) I used to have long hair when I was in elementary school.
(d) She can't have done it alone. It was too difficult.
(e) We would rather stay home than going out in the rain.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: had better의 부정은 had better not이에요. (b) 틀림: '~하는 데 사용된다'는 be used to + 동사원형이라 cut으로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 과거의 상태는 used to로 나타내요. (d) 옳음: can't have p.p.는 과거에 대한 강한 부정 추측이에요. (e) 틀림: would rather A than B에서 B도 동사원형이라 go로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) I'm not used to wearing glasses yet.
(b) He should have went to bed earlier last night.
(c) There used to be many trees on this hill.
(d) You had better to apologize to her.
(e) She may has missed the bus this morning.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: be used to + -ing의 부정이에요. (b) 틀림: should have 뒤에는 과거분사 gone을 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 과거의 상태를 나타내는 used to예요. (d) 틀림: had better 뒤에는 동사원형 apologize를 써야 해요. (e) 틀림: may 뒤에는 동사원형이 와서 may have missed로 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) Mike would often visit his grandparents on weekends.
(b) I would rather not answer that question.
(c) He must have been sick. He didn't come to school.
(d) Wood is used to make paper.
(e) You shouldn't have told her the secret.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거의 반복된 동작은 would로 나타낼 수 있어요. (b) 옳음: would rather의 부정은 would rather not이에요. (c) 옳음: must have p.p.는 과거에 대한 강한 추측이에요. (d) 옳음: be used to + 동사원형(~하는 데 사용된다)이에요. (e) 옳음: shouldn't have p.p.는 '~하지 말았어야 했는데'예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d), (e) 5개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) You had better see a doctor.
(b) My brother is used to cook for himself.
(c) She must have left her phone at home.
(d) I would have a dog named Max when I was little.
(e) We would rather take a taxi than to walk.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: had better + 동사원형이에요. (b) 틀림: '~하는 데 익숙하다'는 be used to + -ing라 cooking으로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 과거에 대한 강한 추측 must have p.p.예요. (d) 틀림: 과거의 상태(have)에는 would를 쓸 수 없어 used to로 써야 해요. (e) 틀림: would rather A than B에서 B도 동사원형이라 walk로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He can't have broken the vase. He wasn't home.
(b) You'd not better tell anyone.
(c) The old building used to be a hospital.
(d) I should have bring my umbrella.
(e) My parents are used to living in the countryside.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거에 대한 강한 부정 추측 can't have p.p.예요. (b) 틀림: had better의 부정은 had better not이라 You'd better not으로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 과거의 상태를 나타내는 used to예요. (d) 틀림: should have 뒤에는 과거분사 brought를 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: be used to + -ing예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Salt is used to keep food fresh.
(b) She would rather read books than watch TV.
(c) He might have heard the news already.
(d) I'm used to get up at six.
(e) You had better not go swimming today.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: be used to + 동사원형(~하는 데 사용된다)이에요. (b) 옳음: would rather A than B, 둘 다 동사원형이에요. (c) 옳음: might have p.p.는 과거에 대한 약한 추측이에요. (d) 틀림: be used to + -ing라 getting으로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: had better not + 동사원형이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법과 문맥상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I'm sorry I'm late. I (A) ___ the earlier bus.
• Mina is used to (B) ___ alone.
items.exp: (A) 늦어서 미안하다는 문맥이므로 과거에 대한 후회 should have taken(탔어야 했는데)이에요. (B) '~에 익숙하다'는 be used to + -ing라 living이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법과 문맥상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• Jake (A) ___ the window. He was with me all afternoon.
• There (B) ___ a big park here, but now it's a parking lot.
choices: must have broken – used to be
can't have broken – used to be
items.exp: (A) 오후 내내 나와 함께 있었으니 깼을 리가 없다는 과거에 대한 부정 추측 can't have broken이에요. (B) 과거의 상태는 would가 아니라 used to로 나타내요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> My grandpa [would] take me fishing on Sundays.
choices: He said he [would] call me later.
[Would] you open the door for me?
items.exp: <보기>의 would는 '~하곤 했다'는 과거의 습관이에요. 방과 후에 숨바꼭질을 하곤 했다는 문장이 같고, 나머지는 권유, would rather, will의 과거, 요청이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: We [used to] go camping every summer.
He [used to] play soccer after school.
There [used to] be a lake here.
Paper bags are [used to] carry things.
items.exp: 종이봉투가 물건을 나르는 데 '사용된다'는 be used to + 동사원형(수동태)이고, 나머지는 모두 '~하곤 했다, 예전에 ~였다'는 used to예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너는 그에게 그 사실을 더 일찍 말했어야 했다.
items.s: You ___ him the truth earlier.
items.exp: 과거에 하지 않은 일에 대한 후회·유감은 should have + 과거분사로 나타내요. tell의 과거분사는 told예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I'm sure that she was very busy yesterday.
items.s: She ___ very busy yesterday.
items.exp: 과거 사실에 대한 확신(I'm sure that ~ was)은 must have + 과거분사로 나타내요. be의 과거분사는 been이에요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: It is impossible that he wrote this song by himself.
items.s: He ___ this song by himself.
items.exp: 과거 일이 불가능했다는 강한 부정 추측은 can't have + 과거분사예요. write의 과거분사는 written이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My father is used to [drink] coffee every morning. → ___
items.exp: '~하는 데 익숙하다'는 be used to + -ing예요. 여기서 to는 전치사라 동명사 drinking을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: You [had not better] eat too much sugar. → ___
items.exp: had better의 부정형은 not을 better 뒤에 두어 had better not + 동사원형으로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 지하철을 타느니 차라리 걸어가겠다.
items.s: I ___ the subway.
items.exp: 'B하느니 차라리 A하겠다'는 would rather A than B이고, A와 B 모두 동사원형을 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The accident was happened late at night.
This laptop belongs to my brother.
The new gym is being built near our school.
Many old houses have been torn down in this area.
The letters will be delivered tomorrow morning.
items.exp: happen은 목적어를 갖지 않는 자동사라 수동태로 쓸 수 없어요. was happened를 happened로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The song has sung by many singers.
Was this picture taken by your father?
The room is being clean by the staff now.
The cookies were eat by the children.
The boy was disappeared after school.
items.exp: 수동태 의문문 Was + 주어 + 과거분사 ~?는 옳아요. is being cleaned, disappeared, were eaten, has been sung으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: The windows in the classroom are cleaned every Friday.
The rules must be followed by everyone.
A lot of trash was found on the beach.
Each of the rooms has been painted white.
Most of the students in my class was invited to the party.
items.exp: 'Most of + 명사'는 of 뒤 명사에 수를 맞춰요. the students가 복수라 was를 were로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: The tickets will be sell online.
She is resembled by her daughter.
The old bike has not been used for years.
My bag was stolen while I am sleeping.
items.exp: 현재완료 수동태의 부정 has not been p.p.는 옳아요. resemble은 수동태 불가, built, sold로 고치고, while절은 과거 was sleeping이어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법에 맞지 않는 문장은?
choices: A big farm is had by my grandfather.
The meeting has been canceled because of the storm.
These shoes were made in Italy.
The dog is being walked by my sister right now.
My grandfather has a big farm in the country.
items.exp: '가지고 있다'는 뜻의 have는 상태를 나타내는 동사라 수동태로 쓰지 않아요. My grandfather has a big farm.처럼 능동태로 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) English is spoken in many countries.
(b) The thief was caught by the police last night.
(c) The door must be locked before you leave.
(d) The new movie will be released next month.
(e) The bag was belonged to my teacher.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 현재 수동태예요. (b) 옳음: 과거 수동태예요. (c) 옳음: 조동사 수동태 must be p.p.예요. (d) 옳음: 미래 수동태 will be p.p.예요. (e) 틀림: belong은 수동태로 쓸 수 없어 belonged로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) The house is being painting now.
(b) Where was your bike found?
(c) Ten people were injured in the accident.
(d) The plan didn't accepted by the members.
(e) Something strange was happened at the party.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 집은 칠해지는 대상이라 진행 수동태 is being painted로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: 수동태 의문문이 맞게 쓰였어요. (c) 옳음: 과거 수동태예요. (d) 틀림: 수동태의 부정은 wasn't accepted로 써야 해요. (e) 틀림: happen은 자동사라 happened로 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The cake was made by my sister and her friends.
(b) Many trees have been planted since last year.
(c) The problem can be solved easily.
(d) The keys are disappeared from the table.
(e) Will the results be announced tomorrow?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거 수동태예요. (b) 옳음: 현재완료 수동태예요. (c) 옳음: 조동사 수동태예요. (d) 틀림: disappear는 자동사라 have disappeared 등 능동으로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 미래 수동태 의문문이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The bridge was being repaired when we passed by.
(b) This book has been read by millions of people.
(c) The pizza will deliver in thirty minutes.
(d) Mina resembles her mother very much.
(e) The car was washed by my dad yesterday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거진행 수동태 was being p.p.예요. (b) 옳음: 현재완료 수동태예요. (c) 틀림: 피자는 배달되는 대상이라 will be delivered로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: resemble은 수동태로 쓰지 않으므로 능동태가 맞아요. (e) 옳음: 과거 수동태예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The windows weren't closed last night.
(b) Where was this letter written?
(c) The test results should be checked again.
(d) The dinosaurs were disappeared millions of years ago.
(e) A new library is building in our town.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거 수동태의 부정이에요. (b) 옳음: 의문사가 있는 수동태 의문문 Where + was + 주어 + p.p.?예요. (c) 옳음: 조동사 수동태예요. (d) 틀림: disappear는 자동사라 disappeared로 써야 해요. (e) 틀림: 도서관은 지어지는 대상이라 is being built로 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) My phone was stolen on the subway.
(b) The flowers are watering every morning by my mom.
(c) These pictures were taken by my uncle.
(d) The room has already been cleaned.
(e) The work must finish by tomorrow.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거 수동태예요. (b) 틀림: 꽃은 물을 받는 대상이라 are watered로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 과거 수동태예요. (d) 옳음: 현재완료 수동태예요. (e) 틀림: 일은 끝내지는 대상이라 must be finished로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• Look! The kitchen floor (A) ___ by Dad now.
• The problem (B) ___ yet.
choices: is being cleaned – hasn't been solved
items.exp: (A) now가 있고 바닥은 청소되는 대상이라 진행 수동태 is being cleaned예요. (B) yet과 함께 '아직 해결되지 않았다'는 현재완료 수동태 hasn't been solved예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• What (A) ___ at the party last night?
• The money (B) ___ to the poor next week.
items.exp: (A) happen은 자동사라 수동태 없이 happened를 써요. (B) 돈은 주어지는 대상이고 next week가 있으므로 will be given이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The car accident yesterday (A) ___ two people.
• Two people (B) ___ in the car accident yesterday.
items.exp: (A) 사고가 두 사람을 다치게 한 것이므로 능동태 injured예요. (B) 두 사람은 다친 대상이고 yesterday가 있으므로 과거 수동태 were injured예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 탑은 지금 수리되고 있는 중이다.
items.s: The tower ___ now.
items.exp: 지금 진행 중인 일이고 탑은 수리되는 대상이라 진행 수동태 be being p.p.를 써요. 주어가 단수라 is being repaired예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 편지는 아직 보내지지 않았다.
items.s: The letter ___ yet.
items.exp: yet과 함께 '아직 ~되지 않았다'는 현재완료 수동태 부정 has not been p.p.로 나타내요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Who invented the telephone?
items.s: ___ the telephone invented?
items.exp: Who가 주어인 능동태 의문문을 수동태로 바꾸면 행위자가 by whom이 되어 By whom was + 주어 + p.p.?가 돼요. 과거라 was예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My cat [was disappeared] two days ago, and she came back today. → ___
items.exp: disappear는 목적어를 갖지 않는 자동사라 수동태로 쓸 수 없어요. 과거 능동태 disappeared로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: A lot of new words [has been added] to the dictionary this year. → ___
items.exp: A lot of 뒤의 new words가 복수라 동사도 복수형 have been added로 써야 해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 규칙은 모든 학생들에 의해 지켜져야 한다.
items.s: The rule ___ by all students.
items.exp: 조동사가 있는 수동태는 조동사 + be + 과거분사예요. 그래서 must be followed가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The students were given a lot of homework by the teacher.
A sweater was made for me by my grandmother.
A letter was sent to me by my pen pal.
The question was asked of the speaker by a reporter.
I was bought a new bike by my parents.
items.exp: buy는 간접목적어(사람)를 주어로 하는 수동태를 쓰지 않아요. A new bike was bought for me by my parents.로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The players were asked to arrive early.
The puppy was named to Coco.
The man was seen enter the bank.
A cake was baked to us by Dad.
She was made clean the room by her mom.
items.exp: ask + 목적어 + to부정사의 수동태 be asked to부정사는 옳아요. was made to clean, was seen to enter(entering), was named Coco, baked for us로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: The book was found boring by many readers.
Math is taught us by Mr. Cho.
The door was left open all night.
He was heard singing in the shower.
Our dog is called Max by everyone.
items.exp: 직접목적어(Math)를 주어로 한 teach의 수동태는 간접목적어 앞에 to를 써서 Math is taught to us로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: Some cookies were given for the children.
A new phone was bought me by my uncle.
They were made to waiting for hours.
She was seen to cross the street.
The room was kept cleanly by my sister.
items.exp: 지각동사의 수동태는 be seen to부정사(또는 -ing)라 옳아요. bought for me, given to, made to wait, 보어는 형용사 clean으로 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) A small gift was given to each guest.
(b) The baby was named Hana by her grandparents.
(c) The boy was made apologize to his friend.
(d) We were shown the way to the station by a kind man.
(e) Dinner was cooked to us by my brother.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: give는 간접목적어 앞에 to를 써요. (b) 옳음: 목적격보어(명사)가 그대로 남아요. (c) 틀림: 사역동사 make의 수동태는 be made to부정사라 to apologize로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: show는 간접목적어를 주어로 쓸 수 있어요. (e) 틀림: cook은 간접목적어 앞에 for를 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) I was asked a lot of questions by the reporters.
(b) The window was found broken this morning.
(c) The thief was seen run away by a neighbor.
(d) My mom was bought flowers by my dad.
(e) We were told not to use our phones.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: ask는 간접목적어를 주어로 쓸 수 있어요. (b) 옳음: 목적격보어 broken이 그대로 남아요. (c) 틀림: 지각동사 수동태는 to run이나 running으로 써야 해요. (d) 틀림: buy는 간접목적어를 주어로 쓰지 않아 Flowers were bought for my mom으로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: be told not to부정사예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) English is taught to us by a teacher from Canada.
(b) The girl was heard to cry in her room.
(c) The kids were made to clean the classroom.
(d) He was elected class president by his classmates.
(e) A doll was made to her by her aunt.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: teach는 간접목적어 앞에 to를 써요. (b) 옳음: 지각동사 수동태 be heard to부정사예요. (c) 옳음: 사역동사 수동태 be made to부정사예요. (d) 옳음: 목적격보어(명사)가 그대로 남아요. (e) 틀림: make는 간접목적어 앞에 for를 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The money was lent to me by my friend.
(b) He was seen playing soccer in the park.
(c) A dress was made to me by my aunt.
(d) The students were allowed to leave early.
(e) The movie was found exciting by the audience.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: lend는 간접목적어 앞에 to를 써요. (b) 옳음: 지각동사 수동태에서 현재분사는 그대로 써요. (c) 틀림: make는 간접목적어 앞에 for를 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: be allowed to부정사예요. (e) 옳음: 목적격보어 exciting이 그대로 남아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The workers were made work late at night.
(b) The cat was named Nabi by my sister.
(c) A new sweater was bought for me by Mom.
(d) I was bought a new sweater by Mom.
(e) The boy was told to wait outside.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 사역동사 수동태는 to work로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: 목적격보어 Nabi가 그대로 남아요. (c) 옳음: buy는 간접목적어 앞에 for를 써요. (d) 틀림: buy는 간접목적어(I)를 주어로 쓰지 않아요. (e) 옳음: be told to부정사예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The secret was told to everyone by Minho.
(b) The wall was painted white by the students.
(c) The dog was heard bark all night.
(d) A question was asked of the teacher by Yuna.
(e) He was made to feeling sorry.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: tell은 간접목적어 앞에 to를 써요. (b) 옳음: 목적격보어 white가 그대로 남아요. (c) 틀림: 지각동사 수동태는 to bark나 barking으로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: ask는 간접목적어 앞에 of를 써요. (e) 틀림: to 뒤에는 동사원형 feel을 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• A nice watch was given (A) ___ me by my grandfather.
• A sandwich was made (B) ___ me by my sister.
items.exp: (A) give는 직접목적어를 주어로 한 수동태에서 간접목적어 앞에 to를 써요. (B) make는 for를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The girl was seen (A) ___ the street by a police officer.
• We were made (B) ___ the classroom by our teacher.
items.exp: (A) 지각동사 see의 수동태에서는 원형부정사가 to부정사로 바뀌거나 현재분사가 그대로 남아요. 보기 중에는 crossing만 가능해요. (B) 사역동사 make의 수동태는 be made to부정사예요.

items.q: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: The old pictures were shown ___ the students.
A postcard was sent ___ me from Paris.
The story was told ___ the children.
The prize was given ___ the winner.
Some cookies were baked ___ the guests.
items.exp: bake는 간접목적어 앞에 for를 쓰고, send·give·show·tell은 to를 써요.

items.q: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것을 고르면?
choices: A kite was made ___ the boy.
A favor was asked ___ me by my neighbor.
A seat was found ___ the old lady.
A new dress was bought ___ her.
items.exp: ask는 간접목적어 앞에 of를 쓰고, buy·cook·make·find는 for를 써요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 a pretty bag을 주어로 하는 수동태로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: My aunt bought me a pretty bag.
items.s: A pretty bag ___ me by my aunt.
items.exp: buy는 직접목적어를 주어로 한 수동태에서 간접목적어 앞에 for를 써요. 과거라 was bought for예요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The coach made the players run ten laps.
items.s: The players ___ ten laps by the coach.
items.exp: 사역동사 make의 수동태에서는 원형부정사가 to부정사로 바뀌어요. 주어가 복수이고 과거라 were made to run이에요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 수동태로 바꿀 때 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: We saw him dancing on the stage.
items.s: He ___ on the stage.
items.exp: 지각동사의 목적격보어가 현재분사이면 수동태에서도 그대로 남아요. 그래서 was seen dancing이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The students were told [be] careful on the stairs. → ___
items.exp: tell + 목적어 + to부정사의 수동태는 be told to부정사이므로 to be로 써야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Delicious food was cooked [to] the guests by the chef. → ___
items.exp: cook은 직접목적어를 주어로 한 수동태에서 간접목적어 앞에 for를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 학생들은 선생님에게 교실을 떠나지 말라는 말을 들었다.
items.s: The students ___ the classroom by the teacher.
items.exp: tell + 목적어 + not to부정사의 수동태는 be told not to부정사예요. 주어가 복수이고 과거라 were told not to leave예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The boy was laughed at by the other kids.
The cat was run over a car.
The baby is taken care of by her grandmother.
The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
The old couch was thrown away by my dad.
items.exp: 구동사 run over의 수동태는 be run over by로 써야 해요. over 뒤에 by가 빠졌어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: My sister is interested at drawing.
Kevin is said be very rich.
The kids were looked after my aunt.
He is known as a great cook in our town.
Everyone was satisfied of the result.
items.exp: be known as(~로서 알려지다)는 옳아요. interested in, satisfied with, looked after by, is said to be로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: It is believed that the island has a hidden treasure.
The plan was turned down by the manager.
The singer is known to many teenagers.
The island is believed to have a hidden treasure.
The dog is taken care by my brother.
items.exp: take care of는 하나의 동사처럼 쓰여 수동태에서도 of를 빼면 안 돼요. is taken care of by로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: People are believed that the bridge is safe.
The meeting was called off at the last minute.
She is said to love by everyone.
My suitcase is filled of clothes.
The singer is known for young people.
items.exp: 구동사 call off의 수동태 was called off는 옳아요. known to, filled with, to be loved, It is believed that으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The old dog was looked after by the neighbors.
(b) I'm tired of hearing the same excuse.
(c) This town is known as its delicious apples.
(d) It is said that the tower was built 500 years ago.
(e) The boy was made fun by his friends.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 구동사 look after의 수동태예요. (b) 옳음: be tired of(~에 싫증 나다)예요. (c) 틀림: 이유를 나타내는 '~로 유명하다'는 be known for라 for로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: It is said that ~ 구문이에요. (e) 틀림: make fun of의 수동태는 was made fun of by로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) The lights were turned off by the last person to leave.
(b) The baby was taken care of by a nurse.
(c) The box was filled with old toys.
(d) He is said to be the best player on the team.
(e) Butter is made from milk.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 구동사 turn off의 수동태예요. (b) 옳음: take care of의 수동태예요. (c) 옳음: be filled with예요. (d) 옳음: 주어 + be said to부정사예요. (e) 옳음: 재료의 성질이 변하면 be made from이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 없어서 0개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) I was surprised at the size of the dog.
(b) My parents are satisfied for my grades.
(c) The ring is made of gold.
(d) He was laughed at by everyone in the room.
(e) It is thought that she to be a good leader.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: be surprised at이에요. (b) 틀림: be satisfied with라서 with로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 재료의 성질이 그대로면 be made of예요. (d) 옳음: laugh at의 수동태예요. (e) 틀림: that절에는 주어와 동사가 와야 해서 she is로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The music was turned down by my sister.
(b) The puppy was run over by a bike.
(c) Jiho is interested in science.
(d) The cups are filled for juice.
(e) She is believed to be honest.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 구동사 turn down의 수동태예요. (b) 옳음: run over의 수동태예요. (c) 옳음: be interested in이에요. (d) 틀림: be filled with라서 with로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 주어 + be believed to부정사예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The problem was dealt by the teacher.
(b) Wine is made from grapes.
(c) The actor is known to people all over the world.
(d) The boy was made fun of by his classmates.
(e) The hill is covered of flowers in spring.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: deal with의 수동태는 was dealt with by로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: 성질이 변하는 재료라 from이에요. (c) 옳음: be known to(~에게 알려지다)예요. (d) 옳음: make fun of의 수동태예요. (e) 틀림: be covered with라서 with로 써야 해요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) People say that the lake is very deep.
(b) The lake is said being very deep.
(c) It is said that the lake is very deep.
(d) The lake is said that it is very deep.
(e) The lake is said to be very deep.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 능동태 원래 문장이에요. (b) 틀림: be said 뒤에는 to부정사가 와서 to be로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 가주어 It + is said that ~이에요. (d) 틀림: that절의 주어를 문장 주어로 쓰면 is said to be로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 주어 + is said to부정사예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The library was crowded (A) ___ students during exam week.
• Paper is made (B) ___ wood.
items.exp: (A) '~으로 붐비다'는 be crowded with예요. (B) 나무가 종이가 되면서 성질이 변하므로 be made from이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The singer is said (A) ___ very kind to her fans.
• It is believed (B) ___ the bridge was built by the king.
items.exp: (A) 사람을 주어로 하면 be said 뒤에 to부정사가 와서 to be예요. (B) 가주어 It 구문에서는 It is believed 뒤에 that절이 와요.

items.q: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: The table was covered ___ a white cloth.
items.exp: be interested 뒤에는 in을 쓰고, be filled·satisfied·covered·crowded 뒤에는 with를 써요.

items.q: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것을 고르면?
choices: The writer is known ___ readers of all ages.
The secret was known ___ only a few people.
He is known ___ his funny jokes.
The story is known ___ children all over the world.
The song is known ___ many people.
items.exp: 이유(~로 유명하다)를 나타낼 때는 be known for를 쓰고, 나머지는 '~에게 알려지다'라는 be known to예요.

items.q: 다음 문장을 my little brother를 주어로 하는 수동태로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: My grandmother looked after my little brother.
items.s: My little brother ___ my grandmother.
items.exp: 구동사 look after는 한 덩어리로 취급해서 수동태에서도 after를 남기고 by를 붙여요. 과거라 was looked after by예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: People say that the old tree brings good luck.
items.s: The old tree ___ good luck.
items.exp: People say that ~의 that절 주어를 문장 주어로 쓰면 be said to부정사가 돼요. 현재이므로 is said to bring이에요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: People believed that the man was a spy.
items.s: It ___ the man was a spy.
items.exp: People believed that ~을 가주어 It으로 바꾸면 It + be believed + that이 돼요. believed가 과거라 was believed that이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Most students in my class are interested [with] the new club. → ___
items.exp: '~에 관심이 있다'는 be interested in이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The poor kitten [was taken care] by the kind girl. → ___
items.exp: take care of는 한 덩어리 동사라 수동태에서도 of를 남겨 was taken care of by로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 학교 축제는 폭우 때문에 다음 달까지 연기되었다.
items.s: The school festival ___ until next month because of the heavy rain.
items.exp: '연기하다'는 구동사 put off이고, 축제는 연기되는 대상이라 과거 수동태 was put off를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It is not easy to learn a new language.
My goal is to read fifty books this year.
I want you to come to my house.
To take pictures of birds are my hobby.
She decided not to go to the party.
items.exp: to부정사구 주어(To take pictures of birds)는 단수 취급하므로 are를 is로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: It is important for you not being late.
He doesn't know where to go.
Mom told me clean my room.
I found it hard keep a diary every day.
items.exp: 의문사 + to부정사(where to go)는 옳아요. to keep, told me to clean, planned to visit, not to be로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: I'm not sure what to wear to the party.
It is kind for you to help me.
Her wish is to travel around the world.
She asked me to help her with the project.
He made it a rule to exercise every morning.
items.exp: kind처럼 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사 뒤에서는 의미상 주어를 of + 목적격으로 써서 of you로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: Do you know how to making kimchi?
Sumi wants that I join the club.
To exercise regularly make you healthy.
It was difficult of me to answer the question.
I expected him to pass the test.
items.exp: expect + 목적어 + to부정사는 옳아요. how to make, for me, wants me to join, makes로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) It is dangerous to swim in this river.
(b) I didn't know what to say.
(c) My dream is become a vet.
(d) She wanted me to join the club.
(e) He found boring to wait in line.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가주어 It, 진주어 to부정사예요. (b) 옳음: 의문사 + to부정사예요. (c) 틀림: 보어 자리에는 to부정사 to become을 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: want + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (e) 틀림: to부정사 목적어는 가목적어 it을 써서 found it boring to wait로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) The doctor told him to stop eating fast food.
(b) Not to give up is the most important thing.
(c) It was nice of you to invite me.
(d) I'd like you meet my friend.
(e) We haven't decided where to stay yet.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: tell + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (b) 옳음: to부정사의 부정은 not to예요. 주어로 쓰여 단수 동사 is예요. (c) 옳음: 성품 형용사 nice 뒤 의미상 주어는 of you예요. (d) 틀림: would like + 목적어 + to부정사라 to meet으로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 의문사 + to부정사예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) Please tell me how to get to the station.
(b) It is necessary for us to save water.
(c) He hopes to become a pilot.
(d) My parents want me to be honest.
(e) To make new friends is not always easy.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: how + to부정사예요. (b) 옳음: necessary 뒤 의미상 주어는 for us예요. (c) 옳음: hope는 to부정사를 목적어로 써요. (d) 옳음: want + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (e) 옳음: to부정사구 주어는 단수 취급해서 is예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d), (e) 5개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I asked him not to tell anyone.
(b) It is fun to play board games with family.
(c) She chose to studying abroad.
(d) I don't know which bus to take.
(e) The teacher wanted us bring our textbooks.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: ask + 목적어 + not to부정사예요. (b) 옳음: 가주어 It, 진주어 to부정사예요. (c) 틀림: to 뒤에는 동사원형 study를 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: which + 명사 + to부정사예요. (e) 틀림: want + 목적어 + to부정사라 to bring으로 써야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was careless for him to leave the door open.
(b) My plan is to visit my grandparents this weekend.
(c) He found difficult it to sleep at night.
(d) Let me know when to start.
(e) She promised to help me.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 성품 형용사 careless 뒤 의미상 주어는 of him으로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: 보어로 쓰인 to부정사예요. (c) 틀림: 가목적어 it은 형용사 앞에 와서 found it difficult로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: when + to부정사예요. (e) 옳음: promise는 to부정사를 목적어로 써요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) To keep a pet are not easy.
(b) The coach told the players to warm up.
(c) We agreed not to fight again.
(d) I don't know what to do it.
(e) It is hard for me to wake up early.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: to부정사구 주어는 단수 취급해서 is로 써야 해요. (b) 옳음: tell + 목적어 + to부정사예요. (c) 옳음: agree + not to부정사예요. (d) 틀림: what이 do의 목적어 역할을 하므로 it을 빼야 해요. (e) 옳음: hard 뒤 의미상 주어는 for me예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I don't know (A) ___ to use this camera.
• It is very kind (B) ___ you to say so.
items.exp: (A) use가 목적어 this camera를 이미 가지고 있으므로 '사용하는 방법' how를 써요. what은 목적어 자리가 비어야 해요. (B) kind는 성품 형용사라 의미상 주어는 of you예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• My mom told me (A) ___ late again.
• I found (B) ___ hard to solve the puzzle.
items.exp: (A) tell + 목적어 + to부정사에서 부정은 not to be예요. (B) to부정사 목적어가 길 때는 가목적어 it을 써요. that은 가목적어로 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> My hope is [to win] the gold medal.
choices: I went to the store [to buy] milk.
His job is [to take] care of animals.
items.exp: <보기>의 to win은 be동사 뒤 보어로 쓰인 명사적 용법이에요. 같은 보어 역할은 His job is to take ~이고, 나머지는 주어, 목적어, 형용사적, 부사적 용법이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 It의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: [It] is not easy to bake bread at home.
[It] is fun to ride a bike.
[It] is hard for me to get up early.
[It] is a long way to the station.
items.exp: 거리를 나타내는 비인칭 주어 It이에요. 여기서 to는 전치사예요. 나머지는 모두 뒤의 to부정사를 대신하는 가주어 It이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 매일 영어로 일기를 쓰는 것은 쉽지 않다.
items.s: ___ a diary in English every day.
a: It is not easy to keep
items.exp: to부정사 주어가 길 때는 가주어 It을 앞에 두고 진주어 to keep을 뒤로 보내요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I don't know what I should cook for dinner.
items.s: I don't know ___ for dinner.
items.exp: '의문사 + 주어 + should + 동사원형'은 '의문사 + to부정사'로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Mina said to me, "Don't touch my phone."
items.s: Mina told me ___ her phone.
items.exp: 부정 명령문을 tell + 목적어 + to부정사로 바꾸면 not을 to 앞에 둬서 not to touch가 돼요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I think it impossible [finish] the work today. → ___
items.exp: it은 가목적어이고 진목적어는 to부정사여야 하므로 to finish로 고쳐요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It was very generous [for] him to share his lunch with me. → ___
items.exp: generous처럼 사람의 성품을 나타내는 형용사 뒤에서는 의미상 주어를 of + 목적격으로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 선생님은 우리에게 복도에서 뛰지 말라고 말씀하셨다.
items.s: The teacher ___ in the hallway.
items.exp: tell + 목적어 + not to부정사(~하지 말라고 말하다)이고 과거라 told us not to run이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Here is a spoon to eat with.
She has many friends to help her.
Don't worry. There is nothing to worry.
We left early so as not to miss the bus.
He was surprised to see his old friend.
items.exp: worry는 '~에 대해 걱정하다'라는 뜻일 때 about이 필요해요. 꾸밈을 받는 nothing이 about의 목적어이므로 nothing to worry about으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: She grew up to be a famous writer.
The meeting is to holding at 3 p.m.
He must be smart solving the problem so fast.
I have a lot of homework doing tonight.
This chair is comfortable to sit.
items.exp: 결과를 나타내는 grow up to be는 옳아요. sit on, to solve, homework to do, is to be held로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: We are to meet in front of the library at noon.
If you are to succeed, you should work hard.
This book is easy to read.
He was sad to hear the news.
I'm looking for a house to live.
items.exp: '집에서 살다'는 live in a house이므로 꾸밈을 받는 명사가 전치사의 목적어예요. a house to live in으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: You must be careless to losing your phone again.
The new library are to open next week.
She went to the bakery in order buy bread.
Give me something cold to drink.
He woke up to found himself in the hospital.
items.exp: -thing으로 끝나는 대명사는 '형용사 + to부정사'가 뒤에서 꾸며서 옳아요. in order to buy, to find, to lose, is to로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) I have no friends to play with.
(b) She was disappointed failing the test.
(c) He studied hard in order to pass the exam.
(d) There is special nothing to see here.
(e) The bag was too heavy to carry it.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: play with friends라서 전치사 with가 필요해요. (b) 틀림: 감정의 원인은 to부정사로 나타내서 to fail로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 목적을 나타내는 in order to예요. (d) 틀림: -thing 대명사는 형용사가 뒤에 와서 nothing special로 써야 해요. (e) 틀림: 주어 the bag이 carry의 목적어이므로 it을 빼야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) I need someone to talk to.
(b) You are to finish this by Friday.
(c) She must be rich buying such an expensive car.
(d) He turned off the TV to focus on his homework.
(e) The man lived to be ninety.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: talk to someone이라 to가 필요해요. (b) 옳음: 의무를 나타내는 be to예요. (c) 틀림: 판단의 근거는 to부정사로 나타내서 to buy로 써야 해요. (d) 옳음: 목적을 나타내는 to부정사예요. (e) 옳음: 결과를 나타내는 to부정사예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) We need a bigger room to live in.
(b) Do you have a pen to write?
(c) I was glad to hear from you.
(d) To catch the train, we ran to the station.
(e) The festival is to be held next month.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: live in a room이라 in이 필요해요. (b) 틀림: write with a pen이라 a pen to write with로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 감정의 원인을 나타내는 to부정사예요. (d) 옳음: 목적을 나타내는 to부정사예요. (e) 옳음: 예정을 나타내는 be to와 수동형 to be held예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Give me some paper to write on.
(b) He was happy to get a letter from her.
(c) I have something important to tell you.
(d) The water is safe to drink it.
(e) You are not to use your phone during the test.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: write on paper라 on이 필요해요. (b) 옳음: 감정의 원인을 나타내는 to부정사예요. (c) 옳음: -thing + 형용사 + to부정사 어순이에요. (d) 틀림: 주어 the water가 drink의 목적어이므로 it을 빼야 해요. (e) 옳음: 금지를 나타내는 be not to예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This river is dangerous to swim in.
(b) There is a bench to sit.
(c) He must be kind to help the old lady.
(d) I was shocked hear the news.
(e) If you are to pass the test, you must study harder.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: swim in the river라 in이 필요해요. (b) 틀림: sit on a bench라서 a bench to sit on으로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: 판단의 근거를 나타내는 to부정사예요. (d) 틀림: 감정의 원인은 to부정사라 to hear로 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 의도를 나타내는 be to예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I came home to find my dog sleeping on my bed.
(b) She has two cats to take care.
(c) Seoul is a great city to visit.
(d) He ran fast so as to catching the bus.
(e) We were excited to go on a trip.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 결과를 나타내는 to부정사예요. (b) 틀림: take care of cats라서 to take care of로 써야 해요. (c) 옳음: visit a city라 전치사가 필요 없어요. (d) 틀림: so as to 뒤에는 동사원형 catch를 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 감정의 원인을 나타내는 to부정사예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I need a knife to cut the bread (A) ___.
• Please bring a chair to sit (B) ___.
items.exp: (A) 칼'로' 자르는 것이라 cut the bread with a knife예요. (B) 의자 '위에' 앉는 것이라 sit on a chair예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 어법상 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• He was pleased (A) ___ that his team won.
• This puzzle is hard (B) ___.
items.exp: (A) 감정의 원인은 to부정사로 나타내서 to hear예요. (B) 주어 this puzzle이 solve의 목적어이므로 뒤에 it을 다시 쓰지 않아 to solve예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I was sad [to leave] my hometown.
choices: We were glad [to see] you again.
The boy grew up [to be] a scientist.
He must be honest [to say] so.
She went to Paris [to study] art.
items.exp: <보기>는 슬펐던 이유를 나타내는 '감정의 원인'이에요. 기뻤던 이유를 나타내는 to see가 같고, 나머지는 목적, 판단의 근거, 결과, 형용사 수식이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: He needs a friend [to help] him.
I have a lot of work [to do].
I saved money [to buy] a camera.
items.exp: 카메라를 사기 위해 돈을 모았다는 '목적'의 부사적 용법이고, 나머지는 모두 앞의 명사·대명사를 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그 소식을 듣고 놀랐다.
items.s: I ___ the news.
items.exp: '놀랐다'는 was surprised이고, 놀란 원인은 to부정사로 나타내서 to hear를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He studied hard so that he could get a scholarship.
items.s: He studied hard ___ a scholarship.
items.exp: 목적을 나타내는 so that ~ could는 in order to + 동사원형으로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The bus was so crowded that we couldn't get on it.
items.hint: too ~ to 사용, 의미상 주어 포함
items.s: The bus was ___ on.
a: too crowded for us to get
items.exp: so ~ that 주어 couldn't는 too ~ to로 바꾸고 의미상 주어 for us를 넣어요. 주어 the bus가 get on의 목적어이므로 it은 빼요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: There are many problems to [deal] in our town. → ___
items.exp: '문제를 다루다'는 deal with a problem이에요. 꾸밈을 받는 problems가 with의 목적어이므로 deal with로 써야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: All students [is to] wear name tags during the event. → ___
items.exp: 의무를 나타내는 be to에서 be동사는 주어에 맞춰요. All students는 복수라 are to예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나에게 먹을 따뜻한 무언가를 줘.
items.s: Give me ___.
items.exp: -thing으로 끝나는 대명사는 형용사와 to부정사가 뒤에서 꾸며서 something + 형용사 + to부정사 어순이에요.

units.name: Ch4-3 to부정사의 의미상의 주어 · 시제 · 수동태

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It was careless of you to leave the window open during the storm.
The old castle is said to have been built about 500 years ago.
It was foolish for him to believe such a strange story.
It is necessary for every member to follow the rules.
The children were happy to be invited to the party.
items.exp: foolish는 사람의 성격·태도를 나타내는 형용사라 의미상의 주어를 of him으로 써야 해요. necessary는 for를 쓰는 게 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He seems to be sick last night, so he stayed in bed.
It is important of us to protect the environment.
The report needs to finish by tomorrow morning.
My grandfather is believed to have been a great soccer player.
It was very wise for her to save money for the future.
items.exp: ④ 축구 선수였던 것이 믿어지는 시점보다 앞서므로 to have been이 맞아요. ① last night → to have been, ② of → for, ③ 보고서는 '끝내지는' 대상 → to be finished, ⑤ wise → of her.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: The students seem to be preparing for the festival now.
Every student in both classes seem to have finished the project.
It was rude of him not to say thank you.
The rumor turned out to have been false.
The thief is said to have been caught yesterday.
items.exp: 주어가 Every student(단수)이므로 seem이 아니라 seems를 써야 해요. in both classes에 속지 않도록 주의해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
It is impossible of anyone to finish the work in a day.
She pretended to be not angry with her brother.
The picture seems to have painted by a little child.
He is said to be born in a small village in 1990.
items.exp: ① 기다리게 한 것이 미안한 시점보다 앞서므로 to have kept가 맞아요. ② of → for, ③ to부정사의 부정은 not to be, ④ 그림은 '그려진' 것 → to have been painted, ⑤ in 1990(과거) → to have been born.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It is generous of you to share your lunch with me.
(b) It is natural of babies to cry when they are hungry.
(c) He seems to have studied hard for the last exam.
(d) Nobody wants to be treated like a child.
(e) She seems to be rich when she was young.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: generous는 사람의 성품 → of you. (b) 틀림: natural은 성품이 아니므로 for babies. (c) 옳음: 지난 시험 공부가 seems보다 앞선 일 → to have studied. (d) 옳음: '대우받는' 것 → to be treated. (e) 틀림: when she was young(과거) → to have been. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The new library is expected to be opened next month.
(b) It was smart of him to bring an umbrella.
(c) The boy appears to have lost his way.
(d) It is dangerous for children to swim here alone.
(e) My bike seems to have been stolen while I was in the store.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 도서관은 '개관되는' 대상 → to be opened. (b) 옳음: smart는 사람의 태도 → of him. (c) 옳음: 길을 잃은 것이 appears보다 앞선 일 → to have lost. (d) 옳음: dangerous는 for children. (e) 옳음: 자전거가 이미 '도난당한' 것 → to have been stolen. 따라서 5개 모두 옳아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) It was silly for me to believe his lie.
(b) He is said to have lived in Japan ten years ago.
(c) It is hard for him to wake up early on Mondays.
(d) These rules need to keep by everyone in the school.
(e) She seemed to be very tired, so she went to bed early.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: silly는 사람의 태도 → of me. (b) 옳음: 10년 전 일이 is said보다 앞서므로 to have lived. (c) 옳음: hard는 for him. (d) 틀림: 규칙은 '지켜지는' 대상 → to be kept. (e) 옳음: 피곤한 것과 seemed가 같은 시점 → to be. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was kind for you to help the old man.
(b) It is easy for her to make new friends.
(c) The window seems to have been broken by the wind last night.
(d) I expect to invite to his wedding next month.
(e) He seems to be angry with me now.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: kind → of you. (b) 옳음: easy → for her. (c) 옳음: 어젯밤 '깨진' 것 → to have been broken. (d) 틀림: 내가 '초대받는' 것 → to be invited. (e) 옳음: 지금 화난 상태 → to be. 따라서 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was honest of her to admit her mistake.
(b) The singer is believed to have written the song alone.
(c) It is not easy of me to say no to my friends.
(d) The meeting was supposed to be held yesterday.
(e) My grandmother seems to be a teacher when she was young.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: honest → of her. (b) 옳음: 곡을 쓴 것이 믿어지는 시점보다 앞섬 → to have written. (c) 틀림: easy → for me. (d) 옳음: 회의는 '열리는' 대상 → to be held. (e) 틀림: when she was young → to have been. 따라서 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It's important for you not to skip breakfast.
(b) She was proud to choose as the class president.
(c) It was clever of the dog to find its way home.
(d) The workers appear to have finished the job an hour ago.
(e) It is very nice for you to say so.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 의미상 주어 for you + not to skip. (b) 틀림: 그녀가 '뽑힌' 것 → to be chosen. (c) 옳음: clever는 개의 영리함을 나타냄 → of the dog. (d) 옳음: 한 시간 전에 끝낸 일 → to have finished. (e) 틀림: nice(친절한) → of you. 따라서 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
It was thoughtful (A) her to send me a card.
The museum is said (B) in 1950.
It is hard (C) him to say sorry first.
choices: for – to have been built – of
of – to have been built – for
items.exp: (A) thoughtful은 사람의 성품 → of, (B) 1950년에 '지어진' 것은 말해지는 시점보다 앞선 수동 → to have been built, (C) hard → for예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
He seems (A) a famous singer when he was young.
I don't like (B) what to do all the time.
It's necessary (C) everyone to wear a helmet.
choices: to have been – to be told – for
to have been – to tell – of
to be – to be told – of
to have been – to be told – of
items.exp: (A) 젊었을 때(과거) → to have been, (B) 내가 '지시를 받는' 수동 → to be told, (C) necessary는 for예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 for와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> It is difficult [for] me to read this map.
choices: I waited [for] him for an hour.
The box is too heavy [for] a child to carry.
She is famous [for] her beautiful voice.
items.exp: <보기>의 for는 to부정사의 의미상 주어를 나타내요. ③ for a child도 to carry의 의미상 주어예요. 나머지는 '~을 위한', '~을', '~으로', '~에 대해'의 전치사예요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 It 중 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: [It] is important for us to save water.
[It] was brave of him to jump into the river.
[It] is natural for kids to ask questions.
[It] was raining hard when I left home.
[It] is hard for me to believe his story.
items.exp: ④는 날씨를 나타내는 비인칭 주어 It이고, 나머지는 모두 뒤의 to부정사를 대신하는 가주어 It이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 책은 50개가 넘는 언어로 번역되었다고 한다.
items.s: The book ___ into more than 50 languages.
a: is said to have been translated
items.exp: '~라고 한다'는 is said to이고, 번역된 것은 말해지는 지금보다 앞선 일이며 책은 '번역되는' 대상이라 완료 수동 to have been translated를 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: It seems that the boys were lost in the forest.
items.s: The boys ___ in the forest.
items.exp: seem이 현재이고 길을 잃은 것(were)은 과거이므로 완료부정사 to have been을 써요. 주어 The boys가 복수라 seem이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 네가 그것에 대해 거짓말을 한 것은 어리석었다.
items.s: It was ___ about it.
items.exp: foolish는 사람의 성품을 나타내므로 의미상 주어를 of you로 쓰고 to lie를 이어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She seems [to be] a model when she was in her twenties. → ___
items.exp: 20대였을 때(과거)는 seems(현재)보다 앞선 시점이므로 완료부정사 to have been으로 고쳐요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 아무도 다른 사람들 앞에서 꾸중 듣는 것을 좋아하지 않는다.
items.s: Nobody likes ___ in front of others.
items.exp: '꾸중 듣는' 것은 수동이므로 to부정사의 수동태 to be scolded를 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: It seemed that he had been sick for a week.
items.s: He ___ for a week.
items.exp: seemed(과거)보다 아팠던 것(had been)이 더 앞서므로 seemed to have been으로 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I heard someone call my name from behind.
The teacher had the students write a short essay.
I had my watch repair at the shop yesterday.
She got her brother to fix her computer.
He was made to wait outside for an hour.
items.exp: 시계는 '수리되는' 대상이므로 have의 목적격보어로 과거분사 repaired를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The coffee was too hot for me to drink it.
He was seen enter the building at midnight.
This question is enough easy for kids to answer.
Needless to say, health is more important than money.
Mom made me to finish my homework first.
items.exp: ④ Needless to say(말할 필요도 없이)는 독립부정사예요. ① 주어와 같은 목적어 it 삭제, ② 지각동사 수동태 → to enter, ③ easy enough, ⑤ 사역동사 make → finish.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift.
The ice is thick enough for us to walk on.
To make matters worse, it began to snow.
My little brother is old enough to ride a bike by himself.
Strange to say, nobody noticed the mistake.
items.exp: so ~ that 절은 완전한 문장이어야 하므로 lift 뒤에 목적어 it이 필요해요. too ~ to 구문과 달리 목적어를 생략할 수 없어요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: I watched the leaves to fall from the tree.
She had her bag steal on the bus.
The singer was heard sing in the next room.
My teacher got me clean the classroom.
The man was wise enough not to believe the rumor.
items.exp: ⑤ enough to의 부정은 to 앞에 not을 써요. ① 지각동사 → fall, ② 가방은 '도난당한' 것 → stolen, ③ 지각동사 수동태 → to sing, ④ get은 to부정사 → to clean.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) We helped the old lady carry her bags.
(b) I felt something crawling up my arm.
(c) She was made clean the room by her mom.
(d) The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
(e) The test was too difficult for me to pass it.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: help는 원형부정사 목적격보어 가능. (b) 옳음: 지각동사 feel + 현재분사. (c) 틀림: 사역동사 make의 수동태는 to clean. (d) 옳음: so ~ that 구문. (e) 틀림: 주어 The test와 같은 목적어 it을 빼야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) To tell the truth, I didn't do my homework.
(b) The kid is tall enough to reach the button.
(c) I'll have the mechanic check my car tomorrow.
(d) She heard her name called by the teacher.
(e) He is too young to drive a car.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 독립부정사 To tell the truth. (b) 옳음: 형용사+enough+to부정사. (c) 옳음: 정비사가 '점검하는' 능동 → 원형 check. (d) 옳음: 이름이 '불리는' 수동 → called. (e) 옳음: too ~ to 구문. 따라서 틀린 것은 0개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The room is big enough to hold 30 people.
(b) The water was too cold for us to swim in it.
(c) The students were made to stand in line.
(d) I saw a boy picked up the trash on the street.
(e) This shirt is enough big for my dad.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: big enough to hold. (b) 틀림: 주어 The water가 in의 목적어이므로 it을 빼야 해요. (c) 옳음: 사역동사 수동태 → to stand. (d) 틀림: 소년이 '줍는' 능동 → pick up 또는 picking up. (e) 틀림: big enough. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Mom didn't let me eat ice cream before dinner.
(b) I had my hair cut short yesterday.
(c) He was seen to run out of the bank.
(d) She is enough brave to speak in front of everyone.
(e) The bag was too heavy to carry it by myself.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: let + 원형. (b) 옳음: 머리가 '잘리는' 것 → cut(과거분사). (c) 옳음: 지각동사 수동태 → to run. (d) 틀림: brave enough. (e) 틀림: 주어와 같은 목적어 it 삭제. 따라서 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The coach had us to run around the field.
(b) I listened to the rain fall on the roof.
(c) We need to get the roof repair before winter.
(d) To begin with, let's look at the map.
(e) She is too shy to talk to strangers.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 사역동사 have → run. (b) 옳음: 지각동사 listen to + 원형. (c) 틀림: 지붕이 '수리되는' 것 → repaired. (d) 옳음: 독립부정사 To begin with. (e) 옳음: too ~ to 구문. 따라서 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The book is easy enough for children to read.
(b) She was heard cry in her room.
(c) He got his car washed at the gas station.
(d) My sister helped me to do the dishes.
(e) It was so dark that we couldn't see anything.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: easy enough for children to read. (b) 틀림: 지각동사 수동태 → to cry. (c) 옳음: 차가 '세차되는' 것 → washed. (d) 옳음: help는 to부정사도 가능. (e) 옳음: so ~ that 구문. 따라서 (a), (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
I'll have him (A) you back later.
She had her wallet (B) on the subway.
He was made (C) the truth.
items.exp: (A) 사역동사 have + 능동 → 원형 call, (B) 지갑이 '도난당한' 것 → stolen, (C) 사역동사 make의 수동태 → to tell이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The puzzle was (A) difficult for me to solve.
She is old (B) to travel alone.
I missed the bus. (C), I left my wallet at home.
choices: so – enough – To make matters worse
too – enough – To make matters worse
enough – too – To make matters worse
items.exp: (A) for me to solve가 이어지므로 too, (B) 형용사 뒤에 enough, (C) 버스를 놓친 데다 지갑까지 두고 왔으므로 '설상가상으로' To make matters worse예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> She had me [carry] the boxes to the car.
choices: I will [carry] the bag for you.
The teacher made us [carry] the desks.
Did you [carry] it all by yourself?
items.exp: <보기>와 ④는 사역동사의 목적격보어로 쓰인 원형부정사예요. ①②⑤는 조동사 뒤의 동사원형, ③은 명령문의 동사원형이에요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 to부정사 중 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: He is old enough [to drive] a car.
The box is too heavy [to lift].
I have no time [to rest] today.
She was kind enough [to help] me.
The river is too wide [to swim across].
items.exp: ③은 명사 time을 꾸미는 형용사적 용법이고, 나머지는 too ~ to / enough to 구문 속 부사적 용법이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 영화는 너무 무서워서 끝까지 볼 수 없었다.
items.s: The movie was ___ until the end.
items.exp: '너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다'는 too+형용사+to부정사로 써요. 주어 The movie가 watch의 목적어이므로 it을 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The box was so heavy that she couldn't move it.
items.s: The box was ___.
a: too heavy for her to move
items.exp: so ~ that ... couldn't는 too ~ to로 바꾸고, that절의 주어 she는 for her로 써요. 목적어 it은 주어와 같으므로 빼요.

items.q: 주어진 문장을 수동태로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The teacher made the students clean the classroom.
items.s: The students ___ the classroom by the teacher.
items.exp: 사역동사 make를 수동태로 바꾸면 원형부정사가 to부정사로 바뀌어요. 과거 시제이고 주어가 복수라 were made to clean이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I heard the door [to open] slowly in the middle of the night. → ___
items.exp: 지각동사 hear의 목적격보어로 to부정사는 쓸 수 없고, 문이 '열리는/열리고 있는' 동작이므로 원형부정사 open이나 현재분사 opening으로 고쳐요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 지난주에 내 자전거를 수리 받았다.
items.s: I ___ last week.
items.exp: 자전거는 '수리되는' 대상이므로 have+목적어+과거분사로 쓰고, last week이므로 과거형 had예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 남동생에게 내 방을 청소하게 했다.
items.s: I ___ my room.
items.exp: get은 '~에게 …하게 하다'의 뜻일 때 목적격보어로 to부정사를 써요. 과거이므로 got이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Making friends at a new school is not always easy.
He is proud of his son having won the gold medal.
Collecting stamps from foreign countries are my hobby.
She complained about not being invited to the party.
I'm sure of his passing the exam.
items.exp: 동명사구 주어(Collecting stamps ~)는 단수 취급하므로 are가 아니라 is를 써야 해요. countries에 수를 맞추면 안 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The boy was afraid of scolding by his mother.
He is ashamed of having been lazy when he was young.
I'm sorry for not to answer your call.
Do you mind me open the window?
Swimming in the lakes in winter are dangerous.
items.exp: ② 게을렀던 것이 부끄러워하는 지금보다 앞서므로 having been이 맞아요. ① '꾸중 듣는' 것 → being scolded, ③ not answering, ④ opening, ⑤ 동명사 주어 → is.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: She left without saying goodbye to anyone.
I remember him being very shy as a child.
The children enjoyed being taken to the zoo.
He insisted on paying for the dinner.
We are used to wear school uniforms.
items.exp: be used to의 to는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사 wearing을 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: She is good at not only singing but also dance.
Learning new things make me excited.
He felt sorry for not having kept his promise.
I object to treat like a little kid.
They're excited about he joining the team.
items.exp: ③ 동명사의 부정은 not을 앞에 쓰고, 약속을 지키지 않은 것이 더 앞선 일이라 not having kept가 맞아요. ① 전치사 at의 목적어끼리 병렬 → dancing, ② 동명사 주어 → makes, ④ '대우받는' 것 → being treated, ⑤ 의미상 주어 → his(him).

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Getting enough sleep is important for teenagers.
(b) She was tired of being asked the same question.
(c) I'm worried about my sister being alone at home.
(d) He admitted having stolen the money.
(e) Thank you for not tell anyone about it.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 동명사 주어 + is. (b) 옳음: '질문 받는' 것 → being asked. (c) 옳음: 의미상 주어로 명사 my sister 가능. (d) 옳음: 훔친 것이 인정한 것보다 앞섬 → having stolen. (e) 틀림: 전치사 for 뒤 → not telling. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The key to success is never giving up.
(b) I don't like he coming home late every night.
(c) She is proud of having been chosen as the team leader.
(d) Taking pictures in the museum are not allowed.
(e) He apologized for being late again.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 보어 자리의 동명사 + 부정어 never. (b) 틀림: 의미상 주어는 소유격이나 목적격 → his(him). (c) 옳음: '뽑힌' 것이 앞선 일 → having been chosen. (d) 틀림: 동명사 주어 → is. (e) 옳음: for being late. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He was punished for lying to his parents.
(b) My mom is used to get up at five every morning.
(c) Eating too many sweets are bad for your teeth.
(d) She is afraid of being not chosen for the team.
(e) I'm sure of she winning the race.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 전치사 for + lying. (b) 틀림: be used to + 동명사 → getting. (c) 틀림: 동명사 주어 → is. (d) 틀림: 동명사의 부정 → not being chosen. (e) 틀림: 의미상 주어 → her(목적격)나 소유격. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Exercising regularly helps you stay healthy.
(b) He is proud of being a member of the team.
(c) She doesn't mind my using her computer.
(d) I'm interested in learn how to cook.
(e) My hobby is collecting old coins and draw cartoons.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 동명사 주어 + helps. (b) 옳음: of being. (c) 옳음: 의미상 주어 my + using. (d) 틀림: 전치사 in → learning. (e) 틀림: collecting과 병렬 → drawing. 따라서 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Instead of take the bus, we walked to school.
(b) She is ashamed of having made such a mistake.
(c) He complained of treating unfairly by his boss.
(d) Using smartphones too much is harmful to your eyes.
(e) I'm looking forward to seeing you again.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 전치사 of → taking. (b) 옳음: 실수가 앞선 일 → having made. (c) 틀림: '대우받는' 것 → being treated. (d) 옳음: 동명사 주어 + is. (e) 옳음: look forward to + 동명사. 따라서 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He left the room without turning off the light.
(b) She is proud of be chosen as the team captain.
(c) The thief escaped without being seen.
(d) Do you mind my sitting here?
(e) Being late for school again and again make the teacher angry.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: without turning. (b) 틀림: 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사, 뽑히는 것이므로 being chosen. (c) 옳음: '보이는' 것 → being seen. (d) 옳음: 의미상 주어 my. (e) 틀림: 동명사 주어 → makes. 따라서 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The boy was afraid of (A) by the big dog.
I'm proud of (B) the contest last year.
Reading books in the park (C) my favorite thing to do.
choices: being bitten – having been won – is
to be bitten – having won – are
items.exp: (A) 개에게 '물리는' 것 → being bitten, (B) 내가 이긴 능동이고 작년 일 → having won, (C) 동명사구 주어는 단수 → is예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
She insisted on (A) paying for dinner.
Thank you for (B) late.
The singer is used to (C) by fans.
items.exp: (A) 동명사의 의미상 주어 → 소유격(목적격) my, (B) 동명사의 부정 → not being, (C) be used to + 동명사, 팬들에게 '따라다녀지는' 수동 → being followed예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> Her job is [teaching] children.
choices: The man [teaching] us English is from Canada.
She was [teaching] math when I visited.
Look at the [smiling] girl over there.
I saw him [running] in the park.
items.exp: <보기>와 ④는 be동사 뒤 보어로 쓰인 동명사('~하는 것')예요. ①③⑤는 현재분사, ②는 진행형의 현재분사예요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: Look at the [dancing] girl on the stage.
items.exp: ②는 '춤추고 있는 소녀'로 상태·동작을 나타내는 현재분사예요. 나머지는 '~하기 위한'이라는 용도를 나타내는 동명사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 어렸을 때 게을렀던 것을 부끄러워한다.
items.s: He ___ lazy when he was young.
items.exp: 부끄러워하는 것은 현재(is ashamed of), 게을렀던 것은 그보다 앞선 과거이므로 완료형 동명사 having been을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 사람들 앞에서 비웃음 당하는 것이 싫다.
items.s: I hate ___ in front of people.
items.exp: '비웃음 당하는 것'은 수동이므로 being+과거분사로 쓰고, laugh at의 at을 빠뜨리지 않아요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I'm sure that he will keep his promise.
items.s: I'm sure of ___ his promise.
items.exp: that절의 주어 he는 동명사의 의미상 주어로 소유격 his(또는 목적격 him)로 바꾸고, will keep은 동명사 keeping으로 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: She denied that she had broken the vase.
items.s: She denied ___ the vase.
items.exp: 깨뜨린 것(had broken)이 부인한 것(denied)보다 앞선 일이므로 완료형 동명사 having broken을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Thank you for [not to tell] my secret to anyone. → ___
items.exp: 전치사 for 뒤에는 동명사를 쓰고, 동명사의 부정은 not을 동명사 앞에 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 그 대회에서 1등상을 받은 것을 자랑스러워했다.
items.s: She ___ first prize in the contest.
a: was proud of having been given
items.exp: 자랑스러워한 것은 과거(was proud of)이고, 상을 '받은(주어진)' 것은 그보다 앞선 수동이므로 having been given을 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She regrets not studying harder when she was younger.
This machine is used to make ice cream.
He managed to finish the report on time.
We're considering to move to a bigger house.
Don't forget to lock the door when you leave.
