items.exp: consider는 동명사를 목적어로 쓰는 동사이므로 moving으로 고쳐야 해요. ②의 be used to make는 '~하는 데 사용되다'라는 뜻으로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: This museum is worth to visit at least once.
I'll never forget meeting you for the first time.
My dad stopped to smoke for his health last year.
She can't afford buying a new laptop.
We are looking forward to go on a field trip.
items.exp: ② 과거에 만났던 일을 잊지 않는 것이므로 forget+동명사가 맞아요. ① worth visiting, ③ 건강을 위해 끊은 것 → stopped smoking, ④ afford to buy, ⑤ look forward to going.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: I don't feel like going out tonight.
He spent the whole weekend playing games.
The workers continued to work in the rain.
She remembered to turn off the gas before leaving.
The doctor advised me to avoid to eat salty food.
items.exp: avoid는 동명사를 목적어로 쓰므로 to eat을 eating으로 고쳐야 해요. advised me to avoid의 to부정사는 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: He promised calling me back after lunch.
When I saw the funny video, I couldn't help laugh.
I regret to tell you that the class has been canceled.
She gave up to learn the violin last year.
They had trouble to find a parking space.
items.exp: ③ regret to tell은 '유감스럽게도 ~을 말하다'라는 뜻으로 옳아요. ① promised to call, ② couldn't help laughing, ④ gave up learning, ⑤ had trouble finding.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I'll try to get there on time.
(b) Would you mind turning off your phone?
(c) He refused answering any questions.
(d) It began raining in the afternoon.
(e) Remember calling your mom tomorrow morning.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: try to(~하려고 애쓰다). (b) 옳음: mind + 동명사. (c) 틀림: refuse는 to부정사 → to answer. (d) 옳음: begin은 동명사·to부정사 모두 가능. (e) 틀림: 앞으로 할 일 → Remember to call. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) My sister keeps biting her nails.
(b) They decided not to go camping because of the rain.
(c) Ms. Kim suggested to take a short break.
(d) I forgot to bring my umbrella, so I got wet.
(e) The boy pretended to be sick.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: keep + 동명사. (b) 옳음: decide + not to부정사. (c) 틀림: suggest는 동명사 → taking. (d) 옳음: 가져와야 할 것을 잊음 → forgot to bring. (e) 옳음: pretend + to부정사. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) We expect to see you at the party.
(b) This song is worth listening to many times.
(c) She is busy to prepare for the exam.
(d) I finished to clean my room an hour ago.
(e) He is used to live alone now.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: expect + to부정사. (b) 옳음: be worth + 동명사(listening to). (c) 틀림: be busy -ing → preparing. (d) 틀림: finish는 동명사를 목적어로 → finished cleaning. (e) 틀림: be used to + 동명사 → living. 따라서 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I hope to hear from you soon.
(b) She finished writing her essay at midnight.
(c) He avoided to make eye contact with me.
(d) I prefer walking to taking the bus.
(e) How about to eat out tonight?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: hope + to부정사. (b) 옳음: finish + 동명사. (c) 틀림: avoid → making. (d) 옳음: prefer A to B에서 to는 전치사라 taking. (e) 틀림: How about + 동명사 → eating. 따라서 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I regret telling him my secret.
(b) He failed passing the driving test.
(c) My little brother learned to ride a bike last year.
(d) She stopped to buy some bread on her way home.
(e) I'm thinking of to join the art club.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 말한 것을 후회 → regret telling. (b) 틀림: fail + to부정사 → to pass. (c) 옳음: learn + to부정사. (d) 옳음: 빵을 사기 위해 멈춤 → stopped to buy. (e) 틀림: 전치사 of → joining. 따라서 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Do you remember visiting this place when you were five?
(b) She agreed helping me with my homework.
(c) I'll never forget to see the sunrise on the mountain last year.
(d) The boys practiced passing the ball.
(e) Try to drink more water every day.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거의 일 → remember visiting. (b) 틀림: agree + to부정사 → to help. (c) 틀림: 작년에 본 일 → forget seeing. (d) 옳음: practice + 동명사. (e) 옳음: try to(~하려고 노력하다). 따라서 (a), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
I'm considering (A) a new bike.
The tank is almost empty. We have to stop (B) gas.
She regrets (C) her friend's birthday party last week.
items.exp: (A) consider + 동명사 → buying, (B) 기름을 넣기 위해 멈춤 → to get, (C) 지난주에 놓친 일을 후회 → missing이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The old bridge is worth (A).
He refused (B) the offer.
Would you mind (C) the door?
items.exp: (A) be worth + 동명사 → visiting, (B) refuse + to부정사 → to accept, (C) mind + 동명사 → closing이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 to와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I'm looking forward [to] seeing you again.
choices: I want [to] see the movie again.
He is used [to] working at night.
She went out [to] buy some milk.
items.exp: <보기>와 ②의 to는 뒤에 동명사가 오는 전치사예요. 나머지는 to부정사의 to예요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 to 중 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: He is used [to] getting up early.
I object [to] being treated like a child.
This tool is used [to] cut wood.
What do you say [to] going for a walk?
She devoted her life [to] helping others.
items.exp: ③은 '~하는 데 사용되다'의 to부정사(to cut)예요. 나머지는 뒤에 동명사가 오는 전치사 to예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 작년에 그 섬을 방문했던 것을 결코 잊지 못할 것이다.
items.s: I ___ the island last year.
items.exp: 앞으로 잊지 않을 것이므로 will never forget이고, 이미 방문했던 과거의 일이므로 동명사 visiting을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 건강을 위해 패스트푸드 먹는 것을 그만두기로 결심했다.
items.s: He ___ fast food for his health.
items.exp: decide는 to부정사를 목적어로 쓰고, '먹는 것을 그만두다'는 stop+동명사이므로 decided to stop eating이에요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I'm sorry that I have to tell you the bad news.
items.s: I regret ___ you the bad news.
items.exp: '유감스럽게도 ~하게 되다'는 regret+to부정사로 나타내요. regret telling은 '말한 것을 후회하다'라는 다른 뜻이에요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: She didn't lock the door, and now she regrets it.
items.s: She regrets ___ the door.
items.exp: 이미 하지 않은 일을 후회하므로 regret+동명사를 쓰고, 부정은 동명사 앞에 not을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My grandfather is used to [walk] for an hour every morning. → ___
items.exp: be used to(~하는 데 익숙하다)의 to는 전치사이므로 동명사 walking으로 고쳐요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그 상자를 열려고 애써 봤지만 열리지 않았다.
items.s: I ___ the box, but it didn't open.
items.exp: 열려고 '애썼지만' 열리지 않았으므로 try+to부정사를 써요. try -ing는 '시험 삼아 해 보다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The girl sitting next to Minho is my cousin.
I found the story about the brave dog very touching.
The students invited to the party was very excited.
He kept me waiting in the cold for an hour.
The cookies baked by my sister were delicious.
items.exp: 분사구 invited to the party의 수식을 받는 주어가 The students(복수)이므로 was가 아니라 were를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The news was so shocked that nobody spoke.
There is a man waited for you at the door.
I heard my name calling in the hallway.
Everyone was surprised at the amazing result.
The language speaking in Brazil is Portuguese.
items.exp: ④ 사람이 놀란 것은 surprised, 놀라움을 주는 결과는 amazing이 맞아요. ① 충격을 주는 소식 → shocking, ② 기다리고 있는 → waiting, ③ 이름이 '불리는' → called, ⑤ 언어는 '말해지는' → spoken.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: We found the math problem very confused.
I'm interested in the book written by a teenager.
She looked tired after the long trip.
The man standing by the car seemed worried.
He had his photo taken in front of the tower.
items.exp: 문제가 혼란을 '주는' 것이므로 목적격보어는 현재분사 confusing이어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: The leaves falling on the ground was beautiful.
I was boring during the long movie.
She showed me some pictures painting by her grandfather.
Please keep the door closing during class.
Do you know the boy riding a bike with a dog?
items.exp: ⑤ 소년이 자전거를 '타고 있는' 능동이므로 riding이 맞아요. ① 주어 The leaves → were, ② 내가 지루함을 느낌 → bored, ③ 그림은 '그려진' 것 → painted, ④ 문이 '닫힌' 상태 → closed.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The singing birds woke me up early.
(b) I saw a car parked in front of my house.
(c) The trip was tiring, but we enjoyed it.
(d) The boy hurt in the accident is now in the hospital.
(e) There were many people waited in line.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: '노래하는' 새 → singing. (b) 옳음: 차가 '주차된' → parked. (c) 옳음: 여행이 피곤하게 '만드는' → tiring. (d) 옳음: 소년이 '다친' → 과거분사 hurt. (e) 틀림: 사람들이 '기다리고 있는' → waiting. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The movie was disappointing, so I left early.
(b) I got my bag stolen on the bus.
(c) She was satisfying with her test score.
(d) The man worked at the bakery is my uncle.
(e) Look at the mountains covered with snow.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 실망을 주는 영화 → disappointing. (b) 옳음: 가방이 '도난당한' → stolen. (c) 틀림: 그녀가 만족한 것 → satisfied. (d) 틀림: 문장의 동사는 is이므로 worked는 '일하는' 현재분사 working이어야 해요. (e) 옳음: 산이 '덮인' → covered. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He sat surrounded by his fans.
(b) I felt something touching my back.
(c) Who is the woman talked to your mom?
(d) The lost dog was found two days later.
(e) The children looked exciting about the trip.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 그가 '둘러싸인' → surrounded. (b) 옳음: 무언가가 '닿고 있는' → touching. (c) 틀림: 여자가 '이야기하고 있는' → talking. (d) 옳음: '잃어버린' 개 → lost. (e) 틀림: 아이들이 신이 난 것 → excited. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The boy wearing glasses is my brother.
(b) We were shocked by the news.
(c) I had my computer fixing yesterday.
(d) There is a sleeping cat under the table.
(e) The results of the test was surprising.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: '쓰고 있는' 소년 → wearing. (b) 옳음: 우리가 충격을 받음 → shocked. (c) 틀림: 컴퓨터가 '수리되는' → fixed. (d) 옳음: '자고 있는' 고양이. (e) 틀림: 주어 The results → were. 따라서 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The fried chicken smelled good.
(b) He left the engine running all night.
(c) The book is full of interested stories.
(d) I saw the thief caught by the police.
(e) Things making in China are cheap.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: '튀겨진' 닭 → fried. (b) 옳음: 엔진이 '돌아가고 있는' → running. (c) 틀림: 흥미를 주는 이야기 → interesting. (d) 옳음: 도둑이 '잡히는' → caught. (e) 틀림: 물건이 '만들어진' → made. 따라서 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The students remained seated during the speech.
(b) The man sat on the bench reading a newspaper.
(c) Her speech was so moving that many people cried.
(d) The bridge building 100 years ago is still used.
(e) I was embarrassing when I fell on the stage.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 학생들이 '앉혀진' 상태 → seated. (b) 옳음: 주격보어 역할의 현재분사 reading. (c) 옳음: 감동을 주는 연설 → moving. (d) 틀림: 다리는 '지어진' → built. (e) 틀림: 내가 당황함 → embarrassed. 따라서 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The movie was so (A) that I fell asleep.
I heard my name (B) by someone.
The girl (C) a red dress is my sister.
items.exp: (A) 지루함을 주는 영화 → boring, (B) 이름이 '불리는' → called, (C) 소녀가 '입고 있는' → wearing이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The tourists (A) in the hotel were angry about the noise.
Most of the toys (B) in this store are made in Korea.
The final match was really (C) for the fans.
items.exp: (A) 관광객들이 '묵고 있는' → staying, (B) 장난감이 '팔리는' → sold, (C) 경기가 흥분을 주는 것 → exciting이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> The man [sitting] on the bench is my uncle.
choices: [Sitting] for a long time is bad for you.
She is [cooking] dinner in the kitchen.
I'm good at [swimming] in the sea.
items.exp: <보기>와 ③은 '~하고 있는'의 뜻인 현재분사예요(③은 진행형). ①②④는 동명사, ⑤는 용도를 나타내는 동명사예요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: People ran out of the [burning] house.
items.exp: ①은 '걷기 위한 지팡이'로 용도를 나타내는 동명사예요. 나머지는 '~하고 있는'의 뜻인 현재분사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 어젯밤 도난당한 그 그림은 아직 발견되지 않았다.
items.s: The painting ___ found yet.
a: stolen last night has not been
items.exp: 그림은 '도난당한' 것이므로 과거분사 stolen이 뒤에서 꾸미고, yet이 있으므로 현재완료 수동 has not been found로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 그 이야기가 매우 감동적이라는 것을 알게 되었다.
items.s: She ___.
items.exp: find+목적어+목적격보어 구조이고, 이야기가 감동을 '주는' 것이므로 현재분사 moving을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The students [interesting] in science joined the club. → ___
items.exp: 학생들이 흥미를 '느끼는' 것이므로 과거분사 interested로 고쳐요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 콘서트를 위해 줄 서서 기다리던 사람들은 지쳐 보였다.
items.s: The people ___ tired.
a: waiting in line for the concert looked
items.exp: 사람들이 '기다리고 있던' 능동이므로 현재분사구 waiting in line for the concert가 꾸미고, 문장의 동사는 과거 looked예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 분사를 이용해 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The letters which were written by my grandfather are kept in this box.
items.s: The letters ___ are kept in this box.
items.exp: 「관계대명사+be동사」를 생략하면 과거분사구 written by my grandfather가 남아 명사를 뒤에서 꾸며요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 나를 한 시간 동안 기다리게 했다.
items.s: He ___ for an hour.
items.exp: keep+목적어+현재분사는 '~을 계속 …하게 하다'예요. 내가 '기다리는' 능동이므로 waiting이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Walking along the beach, a big wave hit me.
Not knowing his phone number, I couldn't call him.
Turning to the right, you will find the post office.
It being Sunday, the bank was closed.
While waiting for the bus, she read a magazine.
items.exp: 해변을 걷는 사람은 '나'인데 주절의 주어는 a big wave예요. 분사구문의 주어와 주절의 주어가 달라 틀렸어요(→ While I was walking ~, a big wave hit me.).

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Being no bus service, we had to walk.
Don't knowing what to do, he called his mom.
Feeling sick, so she went to bed early.
Arrived at the airport, he called his wife.
He sat on the sofa, watching TV with his family.
items.exp: ⑤ 동시동작을 나타내는 분사구문이에요. ① 유도부사 there를 남겨 There being, ② Not knowing, ③ 분사구문 뒤에 접속사 so를 쓸 수 없음, ④ 그가 '도착한' 능동 → Arriving.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: Having a fever, Jisu stayed home from school.
The rain stopped, we went out to play.
Left alone at home, the puppy began to bark.
After finishing dinner, we took a walk in the park.
Though living near the sea, he can't swim.
items.exp: 접속사 없이 두 절을 콤마로 이을 수 없어요. 주어가 다르므로 독립분사구문 The rain stopping으로 쓰거나 After the rain stopped로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: Opened the door, I found a box on the floor.
Being cold outside, we stayed inside.
Not wanting to wake the baby, she walked quietly.
Not have enough money, I couldn't buy it.
Taking this bus, and you will get there faster.
items.exp: ③ 분사구문의 부정 Not wanting이 맞아요. ① 내가 '연' 능동 → Opening, ② 날씨를 나타내는 주어가 달라 It being cold, ④ Not having, ⑤ and를 빼거나 Take this bus, and ~로 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Smiling brightly, the girl waved at me.
(b) Feeling tired, I went to bed early.
(c) My mom being busy, I cooked dinner myself.
(d) Having no time, we took a taxi.
(e) Knowing not the way, he asked a police officer.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 동시동작. (b) 옳음: 이유. (c) 옳음: 주어가 달라 my mom을 남긴 독립분사구문. (d) 옳음: 이유. (e) 틀림: 부정어는 분사 앞 → Not knowing. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Hearing the news, she began to cry.
(b) Being a holiday, the streets were empty.
(c) When crossing the street, you should be careful.
(d) He read the letter, smiling happily.
(e) Getting up late, the school bus left without me.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 휴일인 것은 거리(the streets)가 아니므로 It being a holiday. (c) 옳음: 접속사를 남긴 분사구문. (d) 옳음: 동시동작. (e) 틀림: 늦게 일어난 것은 '나'인데 주절의 주어가 the school bus. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The weather was fine, we went hiking.
(b) Studying hard, you will pass the test.
(c) Living next door, I rarely see her.
(d) Not feeling well, he left school early.
(e) Before go to bed, I brush my teeth.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 접속사 없이 두 절을 이을 수 없음 → The weather being fine. (b) 옳음: 조건. (c) 옳음: 양보(Though I live next door). (d) 옳음: Not feeling. (e) 틀림: 전치사(접속사) before 뒤 → going. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Seeing me, the dog ran toward me.
(b) It being dark, we turned on the lights.
(c) Turning left, the museum is on your right.
(d) While walking home, I met an old friend.
(e) Having not a key, I waited outside.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 독립분사구문. (c) 틀림: 왼쪽으로 도는 것은 박물관이 아님 → Turning left, you will see the museum on your right. (d) 옳음: 접속사를 남긴 분사구문. (e) 틀림: Not having. 따라서 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Taking off his coat, he sat down.
(b) Feel hungry, I made a sandwich.
(c) Not being able to sleep, she read a book.
(d) There being nothing to eat, we went out.
(e) Listening to music, my homework was done quickly.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 연속동작. (b) 틀림: Feeling hungry. (c) 옳음: Not being able to. (d) 옳음: There being. (e) 틀림: 음악을 들은 것은 숙제가 아님 → 주어 불일치. 따라서 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The sun setting, the birds flew back to their nests.
(b) After eating lunch, we played basketball.
(c) Waving her hand, she got on the train.
(d) Arriving at the station, the train had already left.
(e) Being rainy, the game was canceled.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 독립분사구문. (b) 옳음: After eating. (c) 옳음: 동시동작. (d) 틀림: 역에 도착한 것은 기차가 아님 → 주어 불일치. (e) 틀림: 비가 오는 것은 경기가 아니므로 It being rainy. 따라서 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) the window, I felt the cold air.
(B) what to say, she just smiled.
(C) no one at home, the house was quiet.
items.exp: (A) 내가 창문을 '연' 능동 → Opening, (B) 분사구문의 부정 → Not knowing, (C) There was no one을 분사구문으로 → There being이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
It (A) Sunday, the shops were closed.
(B) hard, you will pass the exam.
He said goodbye, (C) his hand.
items.exp: (A) 접속사가 없으므로 독립분사구문 It being, (B) 조건의 분사구문 Studying, (C) 동시동작 waving이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 분사구문과 의미가 같은 것은?
<보기> [Feeling tired], I went to bed early.
choices: [Having a bad cold], he stayed home.
He sat there, [reading a comic book].
[Though living nearby], she is often late.
items.exp: <보기>와 ③은 '~해서, ~ 때문에'라는 이유를 나타내요. ① 조건, ② 시간, ④ 동시동작, ⑤ 양보예요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 분사구문 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: She walked along the street, [singing a song].
He listened to me, [nodding his head].
[Turning off the lights], you will save energy.
items.exp: ④는 '불을 끄면'이라는 조건을 나타내요. 나머지는 '~하면서'라는 동시동작이에요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Because I didn't have an umbrella, I got wet.
items.s: ___, I got wet.
items.exp: 접속사와 주어를 생략하고 didn't have를 분사로 바꾸며, 부정어 not은 분사 앞에 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As it was very cold, we stayed at home.
items.s: ___, we stayed at home.
items.exp: 부사절의 주어 it(날씨)이 주절의 주어 we와 다르므로 생략하지 않고 남기는 독립분사구문 It being으로 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: When the thief saw the police officer, he ran away.
items.s: ___, the thief ran away.
items.exp: 부사절의 주어 the thief가 주절의 주어와 같으므로 접속사와 주어를 빼고 saw를 Seeing으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: [Being] nothing to do, we went to bed early. → ___
items.exp: 원래 문장은 As there was nothing to do이므로 유도부사 there를 남겨 There being으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 엄마에게 손을 흔들며 버스에 올라탔다.
items.s: She got on the bus, ___.
items.exp: '~하면서'라는 동시동작은 현재분사로 시작하는 분사구문으로 나타내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 가게가 문을 닫아서 우리는 다른 곳으로 갔다.
items.s: ___, we went somewhere else.
items.exp: 부사절의 주어(가게)가 주절의 주어 we와 달라 남기는 독립분사구문이에요. 가게가 '닫힌' 상태이므로 being closed예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Having finished her homework, she went out to play.
Written in simple English, the book is easy to read.
He was listening to music with his eyes closing.
Generally speaking, summer in Korea is hot and humid.
Judging from his accent, he must be from Busan.
items.exp: 눈이 '감긴' 상태이므로 「with+명사+과거분사」를 써서 closed로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Frightening by the loud noise, the cat ran away.
Seen from the sky, the island looks like a heart.
Compare with her sister, she is very quiet.
She stood there with her arms folding.
Having been finished the work, he went home.
items.exp: ② 섬이 '보이는' 수동이므로 (Being) Seen이 맞아요. ① 고양이가 '놀란' 것이므로 Frightened, ③ Compared with, ④ 팔이 '접힌' → folded, ⑤ 그가 일을 '끝낸' 능동 → Having finished.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: Surprised by the loud noise, the cat jumped off the sofa.
Having lived in Canada for five years, she speaks English well.
Strictly speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
Speaking of movies, have you seen the new one?
Locating in the center of the city, the hotel is very popular.
items.exp: 호텔은 '위치해 있는' 수동 관계이므로 (Being) Located로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: Interesting in science, he joined the science club.
He fell asleep with the TV turning on.
Considering her age, she plays the piano very well.
Having lost my key, so I couldn't open the door.
Frank speaking, I don't like the idea.
items.exp: ③ considering(~을 고려하면)은 비인칭 독립분사구문이에요. ① 그가 흥미를 느낌 → Interested, ② TV가 '켜진' → turned on, ④ 분사구문 뒤에 so를 쓸 수 없음, ⑤ Frankly speaking.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Not having seen the movie, I couldn't join the talk.
(b) Built 300 years ago, the temple still looks beautiful.
(c) She ran to me with her hair blowing in the wind.
(d) Judging from the dark clouds, it will rain soon.
(e) Having told the news, he was shocked.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 완료형의 부정 Not having seen. (b) 옳음: 절이 '지어진' 수동 → Built. (c) 옳음: 머리카락이 '날리고 있는' → blowing. (d) 옳음: Judging from. (e) 틀림: 그가 소식을 '들은(전해 받은)' 수동 → Having been told. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Shocking by the news, she couldn't say a word.
(b) Having eaten too much, I had a stomachache.
(c) Don't talk with your mouth full.
(d) Roughly speaking, about 100 people came.
(e) The boy sat with his legs crossing.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 그녀가 충격을 '받은' → Shocked. (b) 옳음: 먹은 것이 먼저 → Having eaten. (c) 옳음: with+명사+형용사. (d) 옳음: Roughly speaking(대략 말하면). (e) 틀림: 다리가 '꼬인' → crossed. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Covered with snow, the mountain looked white.
(b) Having invited to the party, he bought a gift.
(c) Compared to last year, prices have gone up a lot.
(d) She walked into the room with her eyes shining.
(e) Strictly speak, this answer is not correct.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 산이 '덮인' → Covered. (b) 틀림: 그가 '초대받은' → Having been invited. (c) 옳음: Compared to(~와 비교하면). (d) 옳음: 눈이 '빛나는' → shining. (e) 틀림: Strictly speaking. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Hurt in the game, the player was taken to the hospital.
(b) Having been cleaned, the room looked bright.
(c) He was sitting with his eyes closed.
(d) Judged from her face, she is very upset.
(e) Not having finished the report, he stayed late.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 선수가 '다친' → Hurt. (b) 옳음: 방이 먼저 '청소된' → Having been cleaned. (c) 옳음: 눈이 '감긴' → closed. (d) 틀림: Judging from. (e) 옳음: Not having finished. 따라서 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Having seen the movie before, I knew the ending.
(b) Left alone, the baby started to cry.
(c) He came in with his shoes covering with mud.
(d) Speaking of food, let's go get some pizza.
(e) Tiring after the long trip, I went to bed early.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 먼저 본 일 → Having seen. (b) 옳음: 아기가 '혼자 남겨진' → Left. (c) 틀림: 신발이 '덮인' → covered. (d) 옳음: Speaking of(~ 이야기가 나와서 말인데). (e) 틀림: 내가 '지친' 것이므로 Tired. 따라서 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Frankly speaking, I didn't like his song.
(b) Painted in bright colors, the house stands out.
(c) With the sun setting, the sky turned red.
(d) Having been lived abroad, she speaks three languages.
(e) Tiring from the long walk, we sat down.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Frankly speaking. (b) 옳음: 집이 '칠해진' → Painted. (c) 옳음: 해가 '지고 있는' → setting. (d) 틀림: live는 수동태 불가 → Having lived. (e) 틀림: 우리가 지친 → Tired. 따라서 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) the book twice, I knew the story well.
He was sitting with his arms (B).
(C) from her smile, she must be happy.
items.exp: (A) 내가 책을 '읽은' 능동이고 먼저 일어난 일 → Having read, (B) 팔이 '접힌' → folded, (C) Judging from(~으로 판단하건대)이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) in 1890, the school has a long history.
(B) the cold weather, the festival was a success.
The dog ran to me with its tail (C).
items.exp: (A) 학교가 '설립된' 수동 → Founded, (B) Considering(~을 고려하면), (C) 꼬리가 '흔들리고 있는' 능동 → wagging이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 with와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> He was reading a book [with] his legs crossed.
choices: I went to the park [with] my dog.
I agree [with] you on that point.
The girl [with] long hair is Mina.
items.exp: <보기>와 ③은 「with+명사+분사/형용사」로 '~한 채로'라는 부대상황을 나타내요. ① 함께, ② 도구, ④ ~에 동의하다, ⑤ ~을 가진이에요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 앞에 Being(또는 Having been)이 생략된 형태가 아닌 것은?
choices: [Having lost] my wallet, I had to walk home.
[Written] in English, the book was hard for me.
[Seen] from here, the tower looks small.
[Shocked] by the news, she sat down.
items.exp: ①은 완료형 분사구문 Having lost(능동)예요. 나머지는 수동형 분사구문에서 Being을 생략하고 과거분사로 시작한 형태예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: After he had finished the work, he went home.
items.s: ___, he went home.
items.exp: 일을 끝낸 것(had finished)이 집에 간 것보다 먼저이므로 완료형 분사구문 Having finished를 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Because the cake was made with fresh fruit, it tasted great.
items.s: ___, the cake tasted great.
items.exp: 케이크가 '만들어진' 수동이므로 Being made에서 Being을 생략한 과거분사 Made로 시작해요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As I had not received any message, I didn't know about the change.
items.s: ___ any message, I didn't know about the change.
items.exp: 메시지를 받지 못한 것(had not received)이 더 앞선 일이므로 완료형 having received를 쓰고, 부정어 Not은 맨 앞에 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: He stood by the door with his arms [folding]. → ___
items.exp: 팔이 '접힌(팔짱 낀)' 수동 상태이므로 「with+명사+과거분사」로 folded를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그의 목소리로 판단하건대, 그는 감기에 걸린 것 같다.
items.s: ___, he seems to have a cold.
items.exp: '~으로 판단하건대'는 비인칭 독립분사구문 Judging from(by)으로 나타내요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 두 번이나 속았기 때문에, 그는 더 이상 그녀를 믿지 않는다.
items.s: ___ twice, he doesn't trust her anymore.
items.exp: 속은 것은 지금보다 앞선 일이고 그가 '속임을 당한' 수동이므로 완료 수동형 Having been tricked를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: This year's festival was even more crowded than last year's.
The weather in July is much hotter than that in May.
The harder you study, the better grades you will get.
My new phone is twice as expensive as my old one.
The prices at this store are cheaper than that store.
items.exp: 비교 대상은 같은 종류여야 해요. 이 가게의 '가격'과 저 가게의 '가격'을 비교하므로 than those at that store로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: It's getting darker and darker outside.
This puzzle is very easier than the last one.
He ran as fast as he can to catch the bus.
The more I know him, the much I like him.
My bag is not as heavier as yours.
items.exp: ① 「비교급 and 비교급」은 '점점 더 ~한'이에요. ② 비교급 강조는 much/even/far 등, ③ 과거 ran에 맞춰 could, ④ the more, ⑤ as와 as 사이에는 원급 heavy.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: Please answer the email as soon as possible.
The less you eat junk food, the healthy you will become.
Your idea is far more creative than mine.
The more carefully you drive, the safer you will be.
This river is three times as long as that one.
items.exp: 「the+비교급, the+비교급」 구문이므로 뒤쪽도 비교급 the healthier로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: The ears of a rabbit are longer than a cat.
The weather became cold and colder.
Minho is less taller than his brother.
She got more and more nervous as the test began.
The more you exercise, you become the stronger.
items.exp: ④ more and more nervous(점점 더 긴장한)가 맞아요. ① 비교 대상 → those of a cat, ② colder and colder, ③ less 뒤에는 원급 → less tall, ⑤ the stronger you become.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) My brother eats twice as much as I do.
(b) The air today is a lot cleaner than yesterday's.
(c) This movie is not so interesting as the book.
(d) He speaks English as fluent as his teacher.
(e) The older we grow, the wiser we become.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 배수사+as ~ as. (b) 옳음: a lot은 비교급 강조, yesterday's는 '어제의 공기'. (c) 옳음: not so ~ as. (d) 틀림: 동사 speaks를 꾸미므로 부사 fluently. (e) 옳음: the+비교급, the+비교급. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The sooner you start, the earlier you will finish.
(b) Today's test was much more difficult than I expected.
(c) Her voice is as beautiful as a singer.
(d) The new building is three times as tall as the old one.
(e) Mina is very smarter than her sister.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: much는 비교급 강조. (c) 틀림: 목소리와 가수를 비교할 수 없으므로 as that of a singer. (d) 옳음: 배수 비교. (e) 틀림: very는 비교급을 꾸밀 수 없음 → much 등. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Walk as quietly as you can.
(b) The cake was more sweeter than I thought.
(c) As time went by, the story got more and more exciting.
(d) My room is less clean than yours.
(e) The bigger the house is, the expensive it is.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: as ~ as you can. (b) 틀림: more와 -er를 겹쳐 쓸 수 없음 → sweeter. (c) 옳음: more and more exciting. (d) 옳음: less+원급+than. (e) 틀림: the more expensive. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Her English is even better than her mother's.
(b) Try to finish the work as quickly as possible.
(c) The more you practice, the more confident you will feel.
(d) This bridge is twice longer as that one.
(e) He is not as tall than his father.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: even은 비교급 강조, her mother's는 '어머니의 영어'. (b) 옳음: as ~ as possible. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: twice as long as. (e) 틀림: not as tall as. 따라서 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The movie was far more exciting than I had expected.
(b) Prices are going up higher and highest.
(c) Junho can swim as well as his coach can.
(d) The more books you read, the more you will learn.
(e) Your bike is much more expensive as mine.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: far는 비교급 강조. (b) 틀림: higher and higher. (c) 옳음: as well as(~만큼 잘). (d) 옳음: the more books ~. (e) 틀림: 비교급 뒤에는 than. 따라서 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He can't run as fast as he could before.
(b) The higher you climb, the colder it gets.
(c) This road is a lot wider than that one.
(d) The problem is getting seriouser and seriouser.
(e) The days are getting shorter and shorter.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: as ~ as he could before. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: a lot은 비교급 강조. (d) 틀림: serious의 비교급은 more serious → more and more serious. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The weather is getting (A).
The (B) you are, the more mistakes you make.
This box is (C) heavier than that one.
choices: more and more cold – busier – much
more and more cold – busy – very
items.exp: (A) 1음절 형용사는 colder and colder, (B) the+비교급 → busier, (C) 비교급 강조 → much예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Please call me as soon as you (A).
His room is three times as (B) as mine.
The ears of an elephant are bigger than (C) of a mouse.
items.exp: (A) 현재 부탁이므로 as soon as you can, (B) as와 as 사이에는 원급 large, (C) 복수 명사 The ears를 받으므로 those예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 as와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> My bag is twice as big [as] yours.
choices: [As] it was late, we went home.
He came as quickly [as] he could.
items.exp: <보기>와 ③의 as는 「as+원급+as」에서 비교 대상을 이끄는 as('~만큼')예요. ① ~로서, ② ~ 때문에, ④ ~할 때, ⑤ ~대로예요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 much 중 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: This plan is [much] better than that one.
She is [much] taller than her sister.
He runs [much] faster than his brother.
items.exp: ⑤의 much는 셀 수 없는 명사 money를 꾸미는 '많은'이에요. 나머지는 비교급을 강조하는 '훨씬'이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 휴대전화는 저것보다 세 배 더 비싸다.
items.s: This phone is ___ that one.
items.exp: 배수 비교는 「배수사+as+원급+as」로 나타내요. expensive는 원급 그대로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 네가 더 열심히 연습할수록 너는 더 잘하게 될 것이다.
items.s: ___, the better you will play.
items.exp: '~할수록 더 …하다'는 「the+비교급+주어+동사, the+비교급+주어+동사」로 써요. 부사 hard의 비교급은 harder예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: She tried to speak as clearly as possible.
items.s: She tried to speak as clearly as ___.
items.exp: as ~ as possible은 as ~ as+주어+can으로 바꿀 수 있는데, 문장이 과거(tried)이므로 could를 써요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Minsu is taller than Jiho.
items.s: Jiho is ___ Minsu.
items.exp: '민수가 지호보다 크다'는 '지호는 민수만큼 크지 않다'와 같으므로 not as(so)+원급+as로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The population of Seoul is much larger than [Busan]. → ___
items.exp: 서울의 '인구'와 부산의 '인구'를 비교해야 하므로 단수 명사 the population을 대신하는 that of Busan으로 고쳐요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 날씨가 점점 더 따뜻해지고 있다.
items.s: The weather ___.
items.exp: 지금 진행 중인 변화이므로 현재진행형 is getting을 쓰고, '점점 더 ~한'은 「비교급 and 비교급」이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: This is the most delicious soup I have ever tasted.
Busan is the second largest city in Korea.
One of the oldest trees in the village stands by the river.
No other student in my class is as diligent as Sora.
Mount Halla is higher than any other mountains in South Korea.
items.exp: 「비교급+than any other」 뒤에는 단수 명사를 써야 하므로 mountains를 mountain으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He is the most fastest runner on our team.
This is one of the most popular song in Korea.
Nothing is more important than your health.
She is the smartest of the class.
No other river in this country is longer as this one.
items.exp: ③ 「Nothing is+비교급+than」은 최상급의 의미예요. ① the fastest, ② one of the+최상급+복수 명사 → songs, ④ 단수 집단 앞 → in the class, ⑤ 비교급 뒤 → than.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: Jiwoo is taller than all the other girl in her class.
Time is the most precious thing of all.
This is the worst movie that I have ever seen.
No other city in the world is as crowded as this one.
Health is more important than anything else.
items.exp: 「비교급+than all the other」 뒤에는 복수 명사를 써야 하므로 girls로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: Minji is the kindest girl I have never met.
This is the most interesting book of the three.
No other boy on the team runs fastest than Tom.
He is one of the greatest scientist in history.
The Pacific is larger than any other oceans.
items.exp: ② 복수(the three) 앞에서는 of를 써요. ① 지금까지 ~한 것 중 → have ever met, ③ No other ~ 비교급+than → faster, ④ scientists, ⑤ any other ocean.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Winter is the coldest season of the year.
(b) It was the happiest day of my life.
(c) This is the best pizza I've ever had.
(d) Seoul is one of the busiest city in Asia.
(e) No other building in town is taller than the city hall.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: the+최상급+(that)+주어+have ever p.p. (d) 틀림: one of the+최상급+복수 명사 → cities. (e) 옳음: No other+단수 명사 ~ 비교급+than. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Ms. Han is the most patient teacher in our school.
(b) He is the funnier of all my friends.
(c) This is the most boring class I have ever taken.
(d) Russia is larger than any other country in the world.
(e) One of my favorite singers is coming to Korea.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: of all my friends(셋 이상) 중 가장 → the funniest. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음: than any other+단수 명사. (e) 옳음: One of+복수 명사가 주어면 단수 동사 is. 따라서 틀린 것은 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Nothing is as precious as time.
(b) She is the most famous painter in the country.
(c) No other student in the class got a highest score than Junho.
(d) That was one of the most exciting games I have ever watched.
(e) This is the oldest of all the building in the town.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Nothing is as+원급+as. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: than 앞에는 비교급 → a higher score. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: all the 뒤 복수 → buildings. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This is the highest mountain in the area.
(b) He is the youngest of the five brothers.
(c) Love is more important than any other thing.
(d) She is one of the best player on the team.
(e) This is the most expensive watch that I have ever bought.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 단수 장소 앞 in. (b) 옳음: 복수 앞 of. (c) 옳음: than any other+단수 명사. (d) 틀림: one of the best players. (e) 옳음. 따라서 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Spring is the most beautiful season of the four.
(b) Tom is smarter than any other students in his school.
(c) That was the most difficult question of all.
(d) No other person in my family cooks as well as my dad.
(e) It's the more interesting story I've ever heard.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: any other student. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음: No other ~ as well as. (e) 틀림: I've ever heard와 함께 최상급 → the most interesting. 따라서 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This lake is deeper than all the other lakes in the area.
(b) Nothing is more valuable than friendship.
(c) The cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
(d) No other team in the league has won more games than ours.
(e) This is one of the most beautiful beach in the world.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: than all the other+복수 명사. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음: No other+단수 명사 ~ 비교급+than. (e) 틀림: beaches. 따라서 (a), (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Yuna is the tallest girl (A) her class.
This is the best song (B) all.
One of my friends (C) in Canada.
items.exp: (A) 단수 집단 her class 앞 → in, (B) all 앞 → of, (C) One of+복수 명사가 주어면 단수 → lives예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
No other student in our school is (A) than Minho.
Minho is taller than any other (B) in our school.
Minho is the (C) student in our school.
items.exp: (A) than이 있으므로 비교급 taller, (B) any other+단수 명사 → student, (C) the+최상급 → tallest예요.

items.q: 다음 중 나머지 넷과 의미가 다른 문장은?
choices: Jisu is the most careful student in the class.
No other student in the class is as careful as Jisu.
Jisu is more careful than any other student in the class.
No other student in the class is more careful than Jisu.
Jisu is as careful as the other students in the class.
items.exp: ⑤는 '지수는 반의 다른 학생들만큼 신중하다'라는 원급 비교예요. 나머지는 모두 '지수가 반에서 가장 신중하다'라는 최상급의 의미예요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: Nothing is more important than health.
Nothing is less important than health.
Health is more important than anything else.
Nothing is as important as health.
Health is the most important thing.
items.exp: ②는 '건강보다 덜 중요한 것은 없다', 즉 건강이 가장 덜 중요하다는 뜻이에요. 나머지는 모두 '건강이 가장 중요하다'라는 뜻이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이것은 내가 지금까지 읽어 본 책 중에서 가장 재미있는 책이다.
items.s: This is ___.
a: the most interesting book I have ever read
items.exp: 「the+최상급+명사+(that)+주어+have ever p.p.」로 '지금까지 ~한 것 중 가장 …한'을 나타내요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Mike is the strongest boy in his class.
items.s: No other boy in his class is ___ Mike.
items.exp: 「No other+단수 명사 ~ as(so)+원급+as」로 최상급의 의미를 나타내요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Mike is the strongest boy in his class.
items.s: Mike is stronger than ___ in his class.
items.exp: 「비교급+than all the other+복수 명사」로 최상급의 의미를 나타내요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Soccer is one of the most popular [sport] in the world. → ___
items.exp: 「one of the+최상급+복수 명사」이므로 sports로 고쳐요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 도시에서 가장 오래된 건물들 중 하나가 내년에 수리될 것이다.
items.s: One of the ___ next year.
a: oldest buildings in the city will be repaired
items.exp: one of the+최상급+복수 명사이므로 oldest buildings, 건물은 '수리되는' 대상이고 next year이므로 미래 수동 will be repaired예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그날은 내 인생 최악의 날이었다.
items.s: It was ___ of my life.
items.exp: bad의 최상급은 worst이고, 최상급 앞에는 the를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Although the test was difficult, most students passed it.
I'll tell you the news when I will see you tomorrow.
I don't know when he will come back from his trip.
Unless you leave now, you will miss the train.
Since it was a holiday, the streets were quiet.
items.exp: 시간 부사절에서는 미래의 일도 현재시제로 쓰므로 when I see you가 맞아요. ③의 when절은 know의 목적어인 명사절(간접의문문)이라 will come이 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Despite he practiced hard, he lost the race.
Because of it snowed a lot, school was closed.
Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
As soon as she gets home, she will call her mom.
Although it was cold, but we went swimming.
items.exp: ① despite는 전치사라 절이 올 수 없고, ② because of도 전치사라 because로 고쳐야 해요. ③ unless에 이미 not의 뜻이 있어 don't를 빼야 하고, ⑤ although와 but은 함께 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: Because she was very tired, she fell asleep as soon as she lay down on the bed.
He has lived in this town since he was five years old.
Although the movie was bored, we watched it until the end.
I'll wait at the bus stop until you get there.
Once you start the work, you have to finish it.
items.exp: 영화가 '지루하게 하는' 것이므로 bored가 아니라 boring이에요. ①의 lay는 lie(눕다)의 과거형이라 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: I won't go to the party if Tom doesn't invite me.
By the time we arrived, the concert has already started.
She has been learning the piano since she has been seven.
He didn't go out because of the weather was bad.
You can use my laptop as long as you will be careful with it.
items.exp: ② 과거 시점보다 앞선 일이므로 had already started, ③ since절은 과거의 한 시점이라 since she was seven, ④ 절 앞에는 because, ⑤ 조건 부사절은 현재시제 are careful이어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I'll lend you the book if you promise to return it by Friday.
(b) Though he is rich, he lives in a small house.
(c) Unless it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go hiking.
(d) She was late for school because of she missed the bus.
(e) Do you know if she will come to the party tomorrow?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 조건 부사절이라 현재시제 promise. (b) 옳음: though 뒤에 절. (c) 틀림: unless 안에 부정의 뜻이 있어 Unless it rains로 써야 해요. (d) 틀림: 절 앞이므로 because of → because. (e) 옳음: if절이 know의 목적어(명사절)라 will come이 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) While my dad was washing the dishes, I cleaned the living room.
(b) He went to bed early as he had a headache.
(c) As soon as I will finish my homework, I'll go out.
(d) Although his hard work, he failed the test.
(e) We stayed inside because of the heavy snow.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: '~하는 동안'의 while. (b) 옳음: 이유의 as. (c) 틀림: 시간 부사절은 현재시제 As soon as I finish. (d) 틀림: although는 접속사라 명사구 앞에는 Despite(In spite of)를 써야 해요. (e) 옳음: 명사구 앞의 because of. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Now that summer has come, the days are getting longer.
(b) I have known her since we were in the same class.
(c) Even if you don't like the food, you should try a little.
(d) If you will need any help, please call me.
(e) She kept smiling though she was very nervous.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: now that은 '~이니까'. (b) 옳음: since 뒤 과거 시점, 주절 현재완료. (c) 옳음: even if는 '~하더라도'. (d) 틀림: 조건 부사절은 현재시제 If you need. (e) 옳음: though 뒤에 절. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) We will start the meeting when everyone arrives.
(b) The baby stopped crying as soon as she saw her mom.
(c) Because of he was sick, he stayed in bed all day.
(d) Unless you study harder, you won't pass the test.
(e) Although it was raining, but they kept playing soccer.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 시간 부사절의 현재시제 arrives. (b) 옳음: 과거의 일이라 saw. (c) 틀림: 절 앞이므로 Because of → Because. (d) 옳음: unless 뒤 긍정문. (e) 틀림: although와 but은 함께 쓰지 않아요. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) While I was cooking, my brother set the table.
(b) I'll call you after I will get home.
(c) He's been very busy since he started his new job.
(d) Despite the cold weather, many people came to the festival.
(e) Though the room was small, it was comfortably.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: while + 과거진행. (b) 틀림: 시간 부사절은 현재시제 after I get home. (c) 옳음: He's been = He has been, since 뒤 과거시제. (d) 옳음: despite + 명사구. (e) 틀림: be동사 뒤 보어 자리에는 형용사 comfortable을 써요. 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Tell me as soon as the package arrives.
(b) Even though we were tired, we kept to walk to the top.
(c) She couldn't sleep because the noise outside.
(d) As long as you keep your promise, I'll trust you.
(e) Since I have moved here, I've made many friends.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 시간 부사절의 현재시제. (b) 틀림: keep은 동명사를 목적어로 써서 kept walking이에요. (c) 틀림: 명사구 앞이므로 because of. (d) 옳음: as long as는 '~하는 한'. (e) 틀림: since 뒤에는 과거 시점을 나타내는 과거시제 Since I moved here를 써요. 옳은 것은 (a), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ she had a bad cold, she couldn't go to school.
(B) The road was wet ___ the heavy rain last night.
items.exp: (A)는 뒤에 절이 오고 이유를 나타내므로 Since, (B)는 뒤에 명사구가 오므로 전치사 because of가 알맞아요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) You can't enter the hall ___ you have a ticket.
(B) I'll wait here until the movie ___.
(C) ___ the bad weather, the game went on.
items.exp: (A) '표가 없으면 들어갈 수 없다'이므로 unless, (B) 시간 부사절은 현재시제 ends, (C) 명사구 앞이고 양보의 뜻이므로 전치사 Despite예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> [Since] it was very hot, we turned on the fan.
choices: I haven't seen him [since] he moved to Busan.
She has worked at this hospital [since] 2019.
It's been three years [since] we last met.
[Since] I have no money, I can't buy the bag.
Many things have changed [since] I was a child.
items.exp: <보기>의 since는 '~ 때문에'(이유)예요. ④만 이유이고, 나머지는 '~ 이후로'(시간)의 접속사·전치사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> [While] I was reading, my sister was watching TV.
choices: Someone called you [while] you were out.
Don't use your phone [while] you are driving.
He fell asleep [while] he was watching the movie.
Please wait [while] I check your ticket.
[While] I like math, my brother likes art.
items.exp: <보기>의 while은 '~하는 동안'이에요. ⑤는 두 사람의 대조를 나타내는 '~인 반면에'예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그가 도착하자마자 우리는 저녁을 먹기 시작할 거야.
items.s: We will start dinner ___.
items.exp: '~하자마자'는 as soon as이고, 시간 부사절은 미래의 일도 현재시제로 쓰며 주어 he에 맞춰 arrives예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 네가 사과하지 않으면 그녀는 너를 용서하지 않을 거야.
items.s: She won't forgive you ___.
items.exp: unless는 '~하지 않으면'이라는 뜻이라 뒤에 긍정문을 써요. 조건 부사절이므로 현재시제 apologize예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Although it was snowing heavily, the game was not canceled.
items.s: Despite ___, the game was not canceled.
items.exp: despite는 전치사라 뒤에 명사구가 와요. snowing heavily를 명사구 the heavy snow로 바꿔요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I have lived in Seoul since I [have been] ten years old. → ___
items.exp: since가 이끄는 절은 과거의 한 시점을 나타내므로 과거시제 was를 써요. 주절만 현재완료예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 미나는 초등학교에 입학한 이후로 지수를 알고 지냈다.
items.s: Mina ___ Jisu since she entered elementary school.
items.exp: since + 과거 시점은 과거부터 지금까지 이어지는 일이라 현재완료를 쓰고, 주어가 3인칭 단수라 has known이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소포가 배달되면 내가 너에게 문자를 보낼게.
items.s: I'll text you when the package ___.
items.exp: 시간 부사절이라 미래의 일도 현재시제로 쓰고, 소포는 '배달되는' 대상이라 수동태 is delivered예요.

units.name: Ch8-2 접속사 that의 여러 가지 쓰임

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It is surprising that he finished the work alone.
The fact that she won the prize made her parents proud.
I couldn't believe the rumor which our teacher was leaving.
The problem is that we don't have enough chairs.
He spoke so quietly that nobody could hear him.
items.exp: the rumor의 내용을 설명하는 동격절이고 뒤에 완전한 절이 오므로 which가 아니라 접속사 that을 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: That he told a lie were clear to everyone.
It was such a nice weather that we went on a picnic.
She woke up early so that she could catch the first bus.
What he will join our team is good news.
The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift.
items.exp: ① that절 주어는 단수 취급해 was, ② weather는 셀 수 없는 명사라 such nice weather, ④ 뒤가 완전한 절이므로 That, ⑤ lift의 목적어 it이 필요해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: It seems that the children are enjoying the show.
She was so excited that she couldn't sleep that night.
It is important that we keep our promises.
He is such a good cook that everyone loves his food.
The news that the singer will visit our city are exciting.
items.exp: 주어의 중심은 동격절 앞의 The news(단수)이므로 are가 아니라 is를 써야 해요. news는 -s로 끝나도 단수예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: It seems what he has lost his key.
I turned off the TV so that my brother could study.
The idea which we can travel to Mars sounds exciting.
It was so a difficult question that no one answered it.
We were such tired that we went to bed early.
items.exp: ① It seems 뒤에는 접속사 that, ③ 동격절은 that, ④ 「such a+형용사+명사」 또는 「so+형용사+a+명사」, ⑤ 형용사만 있으면 so tired를 써요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Everyone knows that the earth goes around the sun.
(b) It is true that he lived in Japan for five years.
(c) The fact what he was absent surprised us.
(d) She left early so that she wouldn't miss the train.
(e) My wish is that my family will be healthy.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 목적어 명사절 that(변하지 않는 사실은 현재시제). (b) 옳음: 가주어 It. (c) 틀림: 동격절은 what이 아니라 that. (d) 옳음: 목적의 so that. (e) 옳음: 보어 명사절 that. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) That she passed the exam is not surprising.
(b) It was such cold day that we stayed home.
(c) The dog ran so fast that I couldn't catch it.
(d) I heard the news which our school will build a new gym.
(e) She is so kind that everyone likes her.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: that절 주어는 단수 취급 is. (b) 틀림: 셀 수 있는 단수 명사 앞이므로 such a cold day. (c) 옳음: 「so+부사+that」. (d) 틀림: 동격절이므로 which → that. (e) 옳음. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It is strange that she didn't call me.
(b) The truth is what he forgot his homework.
(c) The book was so interesting that I read it twice.
(d) The movie was such boring that I fell asleep.
(e) There is no doubt that he will win the race.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가주어 It. (b) 틀림: 뒤가 완전한 절인 보어절이므로 what → that. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 형용사만 있으므로 such → so. (e) 옳음: doubt의 내용을 나타내는 동격 that. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It is clear that he made a mistake.
(b) She ran so fast that she won the race.
(c) He is so a funny boy that everyone likes him.
(d) I agree with the idea that we should save energy.
(e) That they will come to the party are certain.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가주어 It. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: such a funny boy 또는 so funny a boy. (d) 옳음: 동격 that. (e) 틀림: that절 주어는 단수 취급해 is. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It seems that she is angry with me.
(b) I was so hungry that I ate two bowls of rice.
(c) I'm sure what she will like the present.
(d) The problem is what the price is too high.
(e) The rumor that he is moving abroad is not true.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: be sure 뒤 완전한 절이므로 that. (d) 틀림: 보어절이 완전하므로 that. (e) 옳음: 동격 that, 주어 The rumor에 맞춘 is. 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I think she will like this song.
(b) He was so tired that he fell asleep on the sofa.
(c) She saved money so that she could buy a bike.
(d) It was such an exciting game that nobody left early.
(e) She speaks English so good that people think she is from England.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 목적어절의 접속사 that은 생략할 수 있어요. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: so that + could. (d) 옳음: such an exciting game. (e) 틀림: 동사 speaks를 꾸미므로 부사 well이어야 해요. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) It is a pity ___ he couldn't come to the party.
(B) Tell me ___ you want to eat for lunch.
(C) I heard the news ___ the bridge was closed.
items.exp: (A) 가주어 It의 진주어절이고 뒤가 완전하므로 that, (B) eat의 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절이므로 what, (C) the news의 내용을 말하는 동격절이므로 that이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) It was ___ that we couldn't go out.
(B) She spoke slowly ___ everyone could understand her.
choices: such a windy day – so that
so a windy day – so that
such a windy day – such that
items.exp: (A) 셀 수 있는 단수 명사가 있으므로 「such a+형용사+명사」, (B) '모두가 이해할 수 있도록'이라는 목적이므로 so that이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I believe [that] he is telling the truth.
choices: This is the bike [that] my uncle gave me.
The movie [that] we saw last night was great.
He is the man [that] helped me yesterday.
She said [that] she was too tired to go out.
Look at [that] tall building over there.
items.exp: <보기>의 that은 목적어 명사절을 이끄는 접속사예요. ④도 said의 목적어절을 이끄는 접속사이고, ①②③은 관계대명사, ⑤는 '저'라는 뜻의 지시형용사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> The news [that] he got a job made us happy.
choices: The news [that] he told us turned out to be false.
I like the idea [that] we should help each other.
Did you read the letter [that] she sent you?
This is the house [that] my grandfather built.
The fact [that] you mentioned is very important.
items.exp: <보기>는 뒤에 완전한 절이 오는 동격의 that이에요. ②만 동격이고, 나머지는 뒤에 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절을 이끄는 관계대명사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그가 그 시험에 합격했다는 것은 놀랍다.
items.s: ___ the test.
a: It is surprising that he passed
items.exp: that절 주어가 길어서 가주어 It을 앞에 두고 진주어 that절을 뒤로 보내요. 합격한 것은 과거의 일이라 passed예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The question was so difficult that I couldn't answer it.
items.s: It was ___ that I couldn't answer it.
items.exp: 「so+형용사+that」을 명사와 함께 쓰려면 「such a+형용사+명사+that」으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He left early in order to catch the last train.
items.s: He left early so that ___ the last train.
items.exp: in order to(목적)는 「so that+주어+can」으로 바꿀 수 있고, 주절이 과거(left)라 시제를 맞춰 could를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I can't accept the fact [what] he broke his promise. → ___
items.exp: the fact의 내용을 설명하고 뒤에 완전한 절이 오므로 동격의 접속사 that을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 다리가 곧 다시 개통될 것이라는 소식이 마을 사람들을 기쁘게 했다.
items.s: The news that the bridge ___ soon made the villagers happy.
items.exp: 소식을 들은 때(made)가 과거이므로 그 기준의 미래는 would를 쓰고, 다리는 '다시 열리는' 대상이라 수동태 be reopened를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: It seems that she knows the answer.
items.s: She ___ the answer.
items.exp: 「It seems that+주어+동사」는 「주어+seem(s) to+동사원형」으로 바꿀 수 있어요. 두 절의 시제가 같으므로 단순부정사 to know, 주어 She에 맞춰 seems예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I wonder why she didn't answer my call.
Do you know how old the building is?
What do you think he wants for his birthday?
Can you tell me what time does the bank open?
I'm not sure whether he will come or not.
items.exp: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이므로 what time the bank opens로 써야 해요. do/does/did는 빼고 동사에 시제·수를 반영해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Nobody knows who broke the window.
Do you think where she bought the dress?
I don't know if or not he passed the test.
Please tell me how much did you pay for it.
If he is honest is not clear.
items.exp: ① 의문사 who가 주어라 「의문사+동사」 어순 그대로 옳아요. ② think는 의문사를 문장 맨 앞에(Where do you think she bought ~?), ③ if or not은 쓸 수 없고 whether or not, ④ how much you paid, ⑤ 주어 자리는 Whether예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: I asked her where she had put the keys.
Can you tell me how long it takes to get there?
I wonder whether the store is open on Sundays.
Do you know when the next bus leaves?
Tell me how many students was absent today.
items.exp: how many students가 간접의문문의 주어이고 복수이므로 was가 아니라 were를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Do you know what is his name?
Why do you think she left the party early?
I wonder that she likes me.
Where do you think will he go next?
Whether or not he comes are not important.
items.exp: ① what his name is, ③ '~인지'는 if/whether, ④ 의문사를 앞으로 보낸 뒤에도 「주어+동사」 어순(he will go), ⑤ 명사절 주어는 단수 취급 is예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I don't remember where I parked my car.
(b) Can you tell me why are you so upset?
(c) Who do you believe will win the game?
(d) I'm curious if he likes Korean food.
(e) Do you think what he is doing now?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: why you are so upset. (c) 옳음: believe는 의문사를 문두로, who가 주어라 will win이 바로 와요. (d) 옳음: '~인지'의 if. (e) 틀림: think는 의문사를 문두로 보내 What do you think he is doing now?예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The question is whether we can finish it on time.
(b) Tell me which bus goes to the city hall.
(c) I want to know how tall your brother is.
(d) Do you remember when did we first meet?
(e) Whether it will rain tomorrow is the big question.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 보어 자리 whether절. (b) 옳음: which bus가 주어라 바로 동사. (c) 옳음: 「how+형용사+주어+동사」. (d) 틀림: remember는 Yes/No로 답하므로 의문사를 앞으로 보내지 않고 when we first met으로 써요. (e) 옳음: 주어 자리 Whether. 따라서 틀린 것은 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I'm not sure if he will join us tomorrow.
(b) If he will join us or not is not decided yet.
(c) Could you tell me where the restroom is?
(d) How do you think we can solve this problem?
(e) She asked me whether I had finished my homework.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 명사절 if라 미래는 will. (b) 틀림: 주어 자리에는 if를 쓸 수 없어 Whether. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음: think → 의문사 문두, 뒤는 「주어+동사」. (e) 옳음: 과거보다 앞선 일 had finished. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Do you know where he lives?
(b) I wonder what does she want.
(c) What do you suppose he will say?
(d) Tell me whether or not you agree.
(e) Do you think who will be our new teacher?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: what she wants. (c) 옳음: suppose는 의문사를 문두로. (d) 옳음: whether or not 가능. (e) 틀림: Who do you think will be our new teacher?예요. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Nobody knows how the fire started.
(b) I asked him how much money did he need.
(c) Do you know how fast he can run?
(d) Can you tell me who sent you these flowers?
(e) I don't know if or not he can come.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: how much money he needed. (c) 옳음: 「how+부사+주어+동사」. (d) 옳음: who가 주어. (e) 틀림: if 바로 뒤에는 or not을 쓸 수 없어 whether or not이에요. 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) She asked me what I was doing then.
(b) I wonder how many people live in this city.
(c) Where do you think did he hide the money?
(d) Do you know whose bag this is?
(e) I can't decide what I should wear to the party.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거 시점 진행 was doing. (b) 옳음: how many people이 주어, 복수 live. (c) 틀림: Where do you think he hid the money?예요. (d) 옳음: 「whose+명사+주어+동사」. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I don't know ___.
(B) ___ she is?
choices: where is the post office – How old do you think
where the post office is – Do you think how old
where the post office is – How old do you think
where does the post office – How old do you think
where is the post office – Do you think how old
items.exp: (A) 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」, (B) think가 있으면 의문사(구) How old를 문장 맨 앞에 두어요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ she will accept the offer is still a question.
(B) I wonder ___ he is at home now.
(C) Do you know what time ___?
choices: Whether – if – does the concert start
If – whether – does the concert start
items.exp: (A) 주어 자리 명사절은 if가 아닌 Whether, (B) '~인지'의 if, (C) 「의문사구+주어+동사」 어순이라 the concert starts예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I wonder [if] she will like my gift.
choices: [If] you need help, just call me.
We'll stay home [if] it rains tomorrow.
Ask him [if] he can lend you some money.
[If] I were you, I wouldn't do that.
You'll feel better [if] you get some rest.
items.exp: <보기>의 if는 '~인지'라는 뜻으로 명사절을 이끌어요. ③만 ask의 목적어절이고, 나머지는 '만약 ~라면'의 조건·가정 부사절이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> I don't know [who] called me last night.
choices: I have a friend [who] lives in Jeju.
Can you guess [who] won the prize?
Tell me [who] you met at the park.
Do you know [who] that tall man is?
items.exp: <보기>의 who는 간접의문문을 이끄는 의문사('누가')예요. ①은 선행사 a friend를 꾸미는 관계대명사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너는 그 가게가 몇 시에 문을 닫는지 아니?
items.s: Do you know ___?
items.exp: 간접의문문은 「의문사구+주어+동사」 어순이에요. does가 빠지면서 동사에 -s를 붙여 closes가 돼요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 연결할 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I want to know. + Where did he go yesterday?
items.s: I want to know ___ yesterday.
items.exp: Where did he go?를 간접의문문으로 바꾸면 did가 빠지고 과거시제가 동사로 옮겨 where he went가 돼요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너는 누가 이 경기에서 이길 거라고 생각하니?
items.s: ___ this game?
a: Who do you think will win
items.exp: think가 있으면 의문사를 맨 앞에 두어요. who가 주어이므로 뒤에 바로 will win이 와요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I wonder [that] the museum is open on Mondays. → ___
items.exp: wonder 뒤에서 '~인지'를 나타내는 간접의문문이므로 that이 아니라 if 또는 whether를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 연결할 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Nobody knows. + Is he telling the truth?
items.s: Nobody knows ___ the truth.
a: whether or not he is telling
items.exp: 의문사가 없는 의문문은 「if/whether+주어+동사」로 바꿔요. Is he가 he is 어순으로 바뀌어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 나에게 그 편지가 언제 배달되었는지 물었다.
items.s: She asked me when the letter ___.
items.exp: 물어본 것(asked)보다 배달이 먼저 일어났으므로 과거완료를 쓰고, 편지는 '배달되는' 대상이라 수동태 had been delivered예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Both my brother and my sister are good at swimming.
Either you or Jimin has to clean the classroom today.
Not only the students but also the teacher was surprised.
Neither my parents nor my uncle know about the plan.
My cousin as well as her friends is coming to the party.
items.exp: 「neither A nor B」는 B(my uncle)에 수를 맞추므로 knows예요. ⑤ 「B as well as A」는 앞의 B(My cousin)에 맞춰 is가 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: She is not only smart but also kindness.
He enjoys both reading and to write stories.
You can either take the bus or walking to school.
The problem is not the price but the size.
Neither he nor I are ready for the test.
items.exp: 상관접속사로 연결된 두 말은 형태가 같아야 해요. ① kind, ② writing, ③ walk로 고쳐야 하고, ⑤는 I에 맞춰 am이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 흐름상 접속부사의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
choices: The movie was very long. For example, many people enjoyed it.
The bus didn't come. Therefore, we took a taxi.
I wanted to go out. However, it was raining too hard.
She is good at math. In addition, she is good at science.
Don't stay up late. Otherwise, you will be tired tomorrow.
items.exp: 영화가 길었다는 것과 많은 사람이 즐겼다는 것은 대조이므로 예시의 For example이 아니라 However가 어울려요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Not only my sister but also my parents likes the singer.
Either Tom or his brothers is going to help us.
Not Minho but his friends were at the library yesterday.
Both the cake and the cookies was delicious.
The teacher as well as the students were excited.
items.exp: ③ 「not A but B」는 B(his friends)에 맞춰 were가 옳아요. ① like, ② are, ④ both A and B는 복수라 were, ⑤ The teacher에 맞춰 was예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: Both Sujin and I have lived here since 2018.
You can either call me or send me a text message.
He not only cleaned his room but also washed the dishes.
I was very tired. Nevertheless, I finished my homework.
Not only Jake but also I am interesting in history.
items.exp: 동사 am은 I에 맞게 옳지만, 내가 '흥미를 느끼는' 것이므로 interesting이 아니라 interested를 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Either you or I am going to give the speech.
(b) Both Mina and Junho was late for class.
(c) My friends as well as my brother want to join the club.
(d) She speaks not only English but also Chinese.
(e) Not money but health are the most important thing.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: either A or B는 B(I)에 맞춰 am. (b) 틀림: both A and B는 복수라 were. (c) 옳음: B as well as A는 B(My friends)에 맞춰 want. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: not A but B는 B(health)에 맞춰 is. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) He likes neither coffee nor tea.
(b) Not only the singer but also the dancers were great.
(c) I don't like the color of the jacket. Besides, it's too expensive.
(d) She was both tired and hungry.
(e) The road was closed. As a result, we had to go another way.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 목적어 두 개를 neither A nor B로 연결. (b) 옳음: B(the dancers)에 맞춰 were. (c) 옳음: besides는 '게다가'. (d) 옳음: 형용사끼리 병렬. (e) 옳음: as a result는 '그 결과'. 따라서 틀린 것은 0개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He wants to be either a doctor or a teacher.
(b) My dream is not to be rich but being happy.
(c) I like both playing soccer and to watch baseball.
(d) Neither Jisu nor her friends were at the party.
(e) You can either stay here or coming with us.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 명사끼리 병렬. (b) 틀림: to be rich와 맞춰 to be happy. (c) 틀림: playing과 맞춰 watching. (d) 옳음: B(her friends)에 맞춰 were. (e) 틀림: stay와 맞춰 come. 따라서 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Either my mom or my dad picks me up after school.
(b) Both the boy and his dog is sleeping on the sofa.
(c) Neither you nor he has finished the work.
(d) Not only you but also I are wrong.
(e) The players as well as the coach were happy with the result.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: B(my dad)에 맞춰 picks. (b) 틀림: both A and B는 복수라 are. (c) 옳음: B(he)에 맞춰 has. (d) 틀림: B(I)에 맞춰 am. (e) 옳음: B(The players)에 맞춰 were. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It rained all day. Therefore, the game was canceled.
(b) He is not only kind but also honesty.
(c) I didn't buy the shoes. Instead, I bought a bag.
(d) She can play both the piano and the violin.
(e) He not only sings well but also dance well.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 수동태 was canceled. (b) 틀림: kind와 맞춰 형용사 honest. (c) 옳음: instead는 '대신에'. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: sings와 맞춰 dances. 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 접속부사가 흐름에 맞게 쓰인 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He practiced every day. As a result, he won the contest.
(b) I love fruit. For example, I eat apples every morning.
(c) She was very tired. Therefore, she kept working until midnight.
(d) Hurry up. Otherwise, you'll miss the train.
(e) It was a sunny day. Instead, we went on a picnic.
items.exp: (a) 자연스러움: 결과. (b) 자연스러움: 예시. (c) 어색함: 피곤했지만 계속 일했으므로 However. (d) 자연스러움: '그렇지 않으면'. (e) 어색함: 맑아서 소풍을 간 것이므로 So(Therefore)가 어울려요. 자연스러운 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Both my dad and I ___ fond of hiking.
(B) Either you or your sister ___ to wash the dishes.
(C) Not only Junho but also his parents ___ invited to the wedding last month.
items.exp: (A) both A and B는 복수 are, (B) either A or B는 B(your sister)에 맞춰 has, (C) B(his parents)에 맞추고 과거(last month)라 were예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I was really hungry. ___, there was nothing to eat at home.
(B) Walk faster. ___, you'll be late for the concert.
items.exp: (A) 배고팠지만 먹을 것이 없었으므로 대조의 However, (B) '그렇지 않으면 늦을 것'이므로 Otherwise예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) She enjoys not only hiking but also ___.
(B) The coach as well as the players ___ happy after the game yesterday.
items.exp: (A) enjoy의 목적어 hiking과 병렬이므로 swimming, (B) 「B as well as A」는 B(The coach)에 맞추고 과거라 was예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나의 언니뿐만 아니라 나도 그 영화를 보고 싶다.
items.s: ___ to see the movie.
a: Not only my sister but also I want
items.exp: 「not only A but also B」가 주어이면 동사는 B(I)에 맞추므로 want예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Jiho has visited Jeju. His sister has visited Jeju, too.
items.s: Both Jiho and his sister ___ Jeju.
items.exp: 「both A and B」는 복수 취급하므로 has visited가 have visited로 바뀌어요.

items.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 형태를 쓰세요.
items.s: Not only you but also Minsu ___ responsible for the mistake last week.
items.exp: 「not only A but also B」는 B(Minsu)에 수를 맞추고, last week가 있어 과거시제 was예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She likes not only reading books but also [to draw] pictures. → ___
items.exp: 상관접속사로 연결되는 말은 형태가 같아야 하므로 reading에 맞춰 drawing으로 써요.

items.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 형태를 쓰세요.
items.s: Either my parents or my grandmother ___ me at the station tomorrow.
items.exp: 「either A or B」는 B(my grandmother)에 수를 맞추므로 is를 쓰고, 미래의 일이라 is going to meet이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 키가 클 뿐만 아니라 매우 빠르다.
items.hint: B as well as A 구문, 6단어
items.s: He is ___.
a: very fast as well as tall
items.exp: 「B as well as A」는 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'라는 뜻으로, 강조하는 말(very fast)을 앞에, 이미 아는 말(tall)을 뒤에 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The girl who is playing the violin is my cousin.
This is the most exciting game that I have ever played.
I know a woman whose son is a famous chef.
The book which I borrowed from the library were very interesting.
Everything that he said turned out to be true.
items.exp: 문장의 주어는 관계대명사절 앞의 The book(단수)이므로 were가 아니라 was를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The house which windows are broken is empty.
She showed me that she had bought at the market.
The people who lives next door are very friendly.
What surprised me most was his calm voice.
This is the only thing what I can do for you.
items.exp: ④ 선행사를 포함한 What절이 주어로 옳아요. ① 소유 관계라 whose, ② 선행사가 없으므로 what, ③ 선행사 The people에 맞춰 live, ⑤ 선행사가 있으므로 that이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The boy and his dog that are running in the park look happy.
The students who were chosen for the team practiced hard.
The movie which we watched last night was so bored.
I have a friend whose dream is to be a pilot.
Tell me what you want to buy for your mom.
items.exp: 관계대명사는 옳지만, 영화가 '지루하게 하는' 것이므로 bored가 아니라 boring이어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Is there anything that I can do for you?
This is the boy who I met him at the park.
That I want for my birthday is a new bike.
The teacher who teach us English is from Canada.
Look at the cat which tail is very long.
items.exp: ① -thing 선행사 뒤 that이 옳아요. ② 관계대명사가 목적어 역할을 하므로 him을 빼야 하고, ③ 선행사가 없으므로 What, ④ 선행사 The teacher에 맞춰 teaches, ⑤ 소유 관계라 whose예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The woman whom I talked to at the store was kind.
(b) Do you know the boy whose bike was stolen?
(c) The flowers which my grandmother planted is blooming.
(d) What he told me was not true.
(e) I like the song that she sang at the festival.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 전치사 to의 목적어인 목적격 관계대명사. (b) 옳음: 소유격 whose. (c) 틀림: 주어 The flowers에 맞춰 are. (d) 옳음: What절 주어는 단수 취급. (e) 옳음. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) She is the first student that solved the problem.
(b) I can't believe that you said.
(c) The house whose roof is red belongs to my uncle.
(d) The children who was playing outside came in.
(e) This is all the money that I have.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 서수 the first가 있는 선행사 뒤 that. (b) 틀림: said의 목적어가 없고 선행사도 없으므로 what. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 선행사 The children이 복수라 were. (e) 옳음: all이 있는 선행사 뒤 that. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The bag which I bought it yesterday is too small.
(b) He gave me which I had wanted for years.
(c) A man who name I don't know called you.
(d) The people that lives upstairs are noisy.
(e) The bridge which was built 100 years ago still stands.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: which가 목적어 역할이므로 it을 빼야 해요. (b) 틀림: 선행사가 없으므로 what. (c) 틀림: 소유 관계라 whose. (d) 틀림: 선행사 The people에 맞춰 live. (e) 옳음: 주어 The bridge에 맞춘 stands. 따라서 옳은 것은 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The man who is wearing a cap is my uncle.
(b) I have a cat whose eyes are blue.
(c) The pictures which he took was beautiful.
(d) This is what I wanted to tell you.
(e) The girl what I met yesterday was kind.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 소유격 whose. (c) 틀림: 주어 The pictures에 맞춰 were. (d) 옳음: 선행사를 포함한 what. (e) 틀림: 선행사 The girl이 있으므로 who(m)/that. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The bus that goes to the airport leaves every hour.
(b) What I need now is some sleep.
(c) The girl whose I sat next to was quiet.
(d) Minho has two sisters who lives in Busan.
(e) The old man and his dog that walk here every morning are my neighbors.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: 전치사 to의 목적어 역할이므로 whose가 아니라 who(m)/that. (d) 틀림: 선행사 two sisters에 맞춰 live. (e) 옳음: 사람+동물 선행사 뒤 that. 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The shoes I bought last week are too tight.
(b) The man I wanted to see wasn't there.
(c) The boy is sitting next to Mina is my brother.
(d) The pizza that we ordered it was cold.
(e) Show me the photos you took in Jeju.
items.exp: (a)(b)(e) 옳음: 목적격 관계대명사는 생략할 수 있어요. (c) 틀림: 주격 관계대명사는 생략할 수 없어 who is sitting(또는 sitting). (d) 틀림: that이 목적어이므로 it을 빼야 해요. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I met a boy ___ father is a firefighter.
(B) ___ I want for dinner is pizza.
(C) Look at the man and his horse ___ are crossing the river.
items.exp: (A) 소유 관계라 whose, (B) 선행사가 없으므로 What, (C) 선행사가 '사람+동물'이므로 that이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The cookies that my sister baked yesterday ___ delicious.
(B) I have a friend who ___ in London.
items.exp: (A) 문장의 주어는 The cookies(복수)이고 과거라 were, (B) 주격 관계대명사절의 동사는 선행사 a friend(단수)에 맞춰 lives예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> [What] he said made me angry.
choices: I don't know [what] her name is.
This is [what] I wanted to buy.
Can you tell me [what] time it is?
items.exp: <보기>의 What은 '~하는 것'이라는 뜻의 관계대명사예요. ③만 관계대명사이고, ①②⑤는 의문사, ④는 감탄문의 what이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> The bike [that] I bought last week is red.
choices: He is the tallest boy [that] I know.
This is the key [that] opens the door.
The dog [that] is barking is mine.
I think [that] the bike is too expensive.
items.exp: <보기>의 that은 관계대명사예요. ⑤는 뒤에 완전한 절이 오는 명사절 접속사예요.

items.q: 두 문장을 관계대명사를 써서 한 문장으로 연결할 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I know a girl. + Her brother is a famous singer.
items.s: I know a girl ___ a famous singer.
items.exp: Her brother에서 소유격 Her가 a girl을 가리키므로 소유격 관계대명사 whose를 쓰고 brother를 바로 붙여요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 어제 너에게 말한 것은 비밀이야.
items.s: ___ is a secret.
items.exp: '~하는 것'은 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what으로 나타내요. 어제 일이라 told예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The students who [has finished] the test can leave now. → ___
items.exp: 주격 관계대명사절의 동사는 선행사 The students(복수)에 맞추므로 have finished예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 할아버지가 쓰신 편지들은 아직 상자 안에 있다.
items.s: The letters which ___ by my grandfather are still in the box.
items.exp: 편지는 '쓰인' 것이라 수동태이고, 선행사 The letters가 복수이며 과거의 일이므로 were written이에요.

items.q: 두 문장을 관계대명사를 써서 한 문장으로 연결할 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: This is the dress. + I wore it at my sister's wedding.
items.s: This is the dress ___ at my sister's wedding.
items.exp: it이 the dress를 가리키는 목적어이므로 목적격 관계대명사 which(that)를 쓰고, it은 빼요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그것은 내가 지금까지 본 것 중 가장 아름다운 그림이다.
items.s: It is ___ I have ever seen.
items.exp: 최상급이 선행사를 꾸밀 때는 관계대명사 that을 주로 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The city in which I was born is very small.
The friend with whom I traveled lives in Daegu.
The song to that we listened was beautiful.
My uncle, who is a pilot, travels a lot.
He forgot my birthday, which made me sad.
items.exp: 전치사 바로 뒤에는 관계대명사 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 to which로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I have two brothers, that are both tall.
She said nothing, what made me worried.
The chair on he is sitting is old.
The woman to who I sent the letter didn't reply.
The topic about which we talked was interesting.
items.exp: ① 계속적 용법에는 that을 쓸 수 없어 who, ② 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법은 which, ③ 전치사 뒤에는 관계대명사 which가 필요하고, ④ 전치사 뒤 사람은 whom이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The girl standing by the door is my sister.
The house I live is near the river.
The man I wanted to meet was out.
The cake made by my dad was delicious.
The car parked in front of my house is not mine.
items.exp: 목적격 관계대명사가 생략된 문장인데, live in the house이므로 전치사 in이 남아 있어야 해요(The house I live in).

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: I visited Gyeongju, that is famous for its old temples.
This is the house in that my grandparents lived.
The boy whom I spoke to him was kind.
She bought a new phone, which was very expensive.
The pictures taking by him were amazing.
items.exp: ① 계속적 용법은 which, ② 전치사 뒤는 which, ③ whom이 목적어 역할을 하므로 him을 빼야 하고, ⑤ 사진은 '찍힌' 것이라 taken이에요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The pen with which I write is blue.
(b) The pen which I write with is blue.
(c) The pen with I write is blue.
(d) The pen I write with is blue.
(e) The pen with that I write is blue.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 전치사+which. (b) 옳음: 전치사를 뒤에 남김. (c) 틀림: 전치사 바로 뒤의 관계대명사는 생략할 수 없어요. (d) 옳음: 전치사가 뒤에 있으면 목적격 관계대명사 생략 가능. (e) 틀림: 전치사 뒤 that 불가. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Jisu, who lives next door, often helps me.
(b) He said he was sick, which was a lie.
(c) I met Mr. Kim, that teaches science at my school.
(d) The letter written in English was hard to read.
(e) The people with whom I work are kind.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 계속적 용법 who. (b) 옳음: 앞 절 내용을 받는 which. (c) 틀림: 계속적 용법에는 that을 쓸 수 없어 who. (d) 옳음: which was 생략, 과거분사 written. (e) 옳음: 전치사+whom. 따라서 틀린 것은 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The hotel at which we stayed was clean.
(b) The boy sitting next to me kept talking.
(c) She lost her bag, that she had bought in Paris.
(d) Look at the bird is singing in the tree.
(e) The music which we listened to it was relaxing.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: who was 생략, 현재분사 sitting. (c) 틀림: 계속적 용법은 which. (d) 틀림: 주격 관계대명사만 생략할 수 없어 which(that) is singing 또는 singing. (e) 틀림: which가 to의 목적어이므로 it을 빼야 해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The knife with which he cut the bread was sharp.
(b) The girl to whom I gave the book is my classmate.
(c) The bag, that I lost yesterday, was found.
(d) Seoul, which is the capital of Korea, is a big city.
(e) The book about I told you is on the desk.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: 계속적 용법에는 that 불가, which. (d) 옳음: 고유명사 뒤 계속적 용법 which. (e) 틀림: 전치사 뒤에 관계대명사 which가 필요해요. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I met a boy named Junho at the camp.
(b) The baby sleeping in the bed is my nephew.
(c) She is the singer about whom I talked.
(d) He failed the test again, what made his mom upset.
(e) The chair which he is sitting is broken.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 이름이 '불리는' 것이라 named. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: 전치사+whom. (d) 틀림: 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법은 which. (e) 틀림: sit on이므로 on which 또는 which he is sitting on이에요. 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I have a friend, who lives in Australia.
(b) The pen you are looking for is under the desk.
(c) The man who's talking to my dad is a doctor.
(d) The window broken by the ball was replaced.
(e) The restaurant we had dinner was very crowded.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 계속적 용법 who. (b) 옳음: 목적격 생략, look for의 for가 남아 있음. (c) 옳음: who's = who is. (d) 옳음: which was 생략. (e) 틀림: have dinner at the restaurant이므로 at이 필요해요(we had dinner at). 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The bench on ___ we sat was wet.
(B) I have an aunt, ___ is a nurse.
(C) He didn't call me, ___ made me angry.
items.exp: (A) 전치사 뒤에는 which, (B) 계속적 용법에 사람 선행사이므로 who, (C) 앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 용법은 which예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The boy ___ on the stage is my brother.
(B) The language ___ in Brazil is Portuguese.
items.exp: 「주격 관계대명사+be동사」가 생략된 형태예요. (A) 소년이 '춤추는' 것이라 dancing, (B) 언어는 '말해지는' 것이라 spoken이에요.

items.q: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 생략할 수 있는 것은? (생략해도 어법상 옳고 뜻이 같은 것)
choices: I have an uncle, [who] works in Japan.
The girl to [whom] I lent my umbrella is Yuna.
The man [who is] waiting for you is my dad.
The boy [who] helped me yesterday is Minsu.
He lost his key, [which] made him late.
items.exp: 「주격 관계대명사+be동사」는 함께 생략할 수 있어요. 계속적 용법(①⑤), 전치사 바로 뒤(②), 주격 관계대명사 단독(④)은 생략할 수 없어요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> He passed the exam, [which] surprised everyone.
choices: She lied to me, [which] made me angry.
I bought a shirt, [which] was too big for me.
This is the book [which] I read last week.
We visited Jeju, [which] has many beautiful beaches.
Do you know [which] bus goes downtown?
items.exp: <보기>의 which는 앞 절 전체(시험에 합격한 일)를 받는 계속적 용법이에요. ①도 거짓말한 일 전체를 받고, ②④는 앞의 명사, ③은 한정적 용법, ⑤는 의문사예요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 연결할 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: This is the house. + My grandparents lived in it.
items.s: This is the house ___ lived.
items.exp: it이 the house를 가리키고 전치사 in의 목적어이므로 「전치사+which」로 연결해요. 전치사 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 관계대명사를 써서 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I called Minho, but he didn't answer the phone.
items.s: I called Minho, ___ answer the phone.
items.exp: 계속적 용법의 관계대명사는 「접속사+대명사」(but he)의 뜻을 나타내요. 사람이므로 who를 쓰고 과거 부정 didn't를 이어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The woman with [that] I talked on the phone was very polite. → ___
items.exp: 전치사 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없고, 선행사가 사람이므로 목적격 whom을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 문을 잠그는 것을 잊었는데, 그것이 큰 문제를 일으켰다.
items.s: I forgot to lock the door, ___ a big problem.
items.exp: 앞 절 전체(문을 잠그지 않은 일)를 받는 계속적 용법의 which를 쓰고, 과거의 일이라 caused예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 공장에서 만들어지는 차들의 대부분은 해외로 팔린다.
items.s: Most of the cars ___ in this factory are sold abroad.
items.exp: 「주격 관계대명사+be동사」(which are)가 생략된 형태로, 차는 '만들어지는' 것이라 과거분사 made를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀가 말을 걸고 있던 그 남자는 나의 삼촌이었다.
items.s: The man ___ was my uncle.
items.exp: talk to the man에서 전치사 to를 관계대명사 앞으로 보내면 to whom이 돼요. 그때 하고 있던 일이라 과거진행 was talking이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I still remember the day when I first rode a bike.
This is the restaurant where we celebrated my birthday.
Tell me the reason why you didn't come.
I don't like the way how he talks to his friends.
That's why I was late for school.
items.exp: the way와 how는 함께 쓸 수 없어요. the way 또는 how 중 하나만 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: This is the town where I visited last summer.
Spring is the season which flowers bloom.
I want to know the way he solved the problem.
The house which I grew up has a big yard.
Busan is the city in where I was born.
items.exp: ① visited의 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절이므로 which(that), ② 완전한 절이므로 when(in which), ④ 완전한 절이므로 where(in which), ⑤ 전치사 뒤에는 which를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The park where we often go jogging is near my house.
Winter is the season when many people enjoys skiing.
I can't forget the moment when I heard the news.
This is how I made this cake.
