The office in which my mom works is downtown.
items.exp: 관계부사 when은 옳지만, 관계부사절의 주어 many people이 복수이므로 enjoys가 아니라 enjoy를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Come back at six, when dinner will be ready.
We went to Jeonju, which we tried bibimbap.
I remember the year where we moved to Seoul.
This is the museum where has many old paintings.
Nobody knows the reason which he quit his job.
items.exp: ① 시간을 보충 설명하는 계속적 용법 when이에요. ② 뒤가 완전한 절이므로 where, ③ 시간 선행사라 when, ④ 주어가 빠진 절이므로 which(that), ⑤ 이유 선행사 뒤 완전한 절이므로 why예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The hospital where I was born was built in 1990.
(b) I'll never forget the summer when we went camping.
(c) Tell me how you got the tickets.
(d) This is the reason which I called you.
(e) The library which is near my house closes at 9.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: 선행사 the way 없이 how. (d) 틀림: 뒤가 완전한 절이므로 why(for which). (e) 옳음: 주어가 빠진 절이므로 관계대명사 which가 맞아요. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) That is the bakery where I buy bread every morning.
(b) That is the bakery where sells the best bread in town.
(c) Sunday is the day when my family goes hiking.
(d) Show me the way how you use this app.
(e) We stayed in Gangneung, where we watched the sunrise.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 주어가 빠진 불완전한 절이므로 which(that). (c) 옳음: 주어 my family(단수)에 맞춰 goes. (d) 틀림: the way how는 함께 쓸 수 없어요. (e) 옳음: 계속적 용법 where. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I remember the place which we visited together.
(b) The day on which we met was rainy.
(c) This is why I like him so much.
(d) The village which I spent my childhood was quiet.
(e) I visited the house where the writer once lived.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: visited의 목적어가 빠졌으므로 which. (b) 옳음: on which = when. (c) 옳음: 선행사 the reason 생략. (d) 틀림: 완전한 절이므로 where(in which). (e) 옳음. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The farm where my uncle works has many cows.
(b) I know the shop which you're talking about.
(c) The time at when the train leaves is 3 p.m.
(d) Do you remember the day when we got lost?
(e) The town where I visited last year has changed a lot.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: about의 목적어가 빠졌으므로 which. (c) 틀림: 전치사 뒤에는 which(at which)를 써요. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: visited의 목적어가 빠졌으므로 which(that). 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) That's how he became a famous chef.
(b) She told me the reason why she was upset.
(c) I'll never forget the day which I met you.
(d) The room where we had the meeting was too small.
(e) He went to Busan, which he met his old friend.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: 완전한 절이므로 when(on which). (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: 완전한 절이므로 계속적 용법 where. 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This is the box in which I keep my letters.
(b) The year in which I was born was 2011.
(c) The reason for which he left is unknown.
(d) This is the way in which they make cheese.
(e) The city where in he lives is very clean.
items.exp: 관계부사는 「전치사+which」로 바꿀 수 있어요. (a) in which = where, (b) in which = when, (c) for which = why, (d) in which = how로 모두 옳아요. (e) 틀림: where 자체가 전치사+which이므로 in을 쓰면 안 돼요. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I don't know the reason ___ he was absent.
(B) This is the shop ___ I bought my shoes.
(C) Is this the shop ___ sells used books?
items.exp: (A) 이유 선행사 뒤 완전한 절이므로 why, (B) 장소 선행사 뒤 완전한 절이므로 where, (C) 주어가 빠진 절이므로 관계대명사 which예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Please show me ___ you fixed the bike.
(B) She still remembers the moment ___ she won the race.
items.exp: (A) the way how는 쓸 수 없으므로 how, (B) 시간 선행사 the moment 뒤 완전한 절이므로 when이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> This is the café [where] I met my best friend.
choices: Do you know a place [where] we can study quietly?
items.exp: <보기>의 where는 장소 선행사를 꾸미는 관계부사예요. ⑤만 선행사 a place를 꾸미고, ①②④는 의문사, ③은 '~하는 곳에'라는 뜻의 접속사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> I miss the days [when] we played together.
choices: I'll never forget the night [when] it snowed so much.
[When] I got home, my mom was cooking.
Do you remember the time [when] you lost your bag?
2002 was the year [when] my parents got married.
There are times [when] I feel lonely.
items.exp: <보기>의 when은 시간 선행사를 꾸미는 관계부사예요. ②는 선행사 없이 '~할 때'라는 뜻의 부사절 접속사예요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 연결할 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: This is the hospital. + My mother works at the hospital.
items.s: This is the hospital ___ works.
items.exp: at the hospital은 장소를 나타내는 부사구이므로 관계부사 where로 연결하고, 뒤에 완전한 절을 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I remember the day when we first met.
items.s: I remember the day ___ we first met.
items.exp: 관계부사 when은 「전치사+which」로 바꿀 수 있어요. 날(day) 앞에는 전치사 on을 쓰므로 on which예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: This is [the way how] she learned Chinese so quickly. → ___
items.exp: the way와 how는 함께 쓸 수 없으므로 둘 중 하나만 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그것이 그가 그 팀을 떠난 이유이다.
items.s: That is ___ the team.
items.exp: 이유를 나타내는 선행사 the reason 뒤에 관계부사 why를 쓰고, 과거의 일이라 left예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이곳은 그 영화가 촬영된 마을이다.
items.s: This is the village where the movie ___.
items.exp: 영화는 '촬영되는' 대상이므로 수동태이고, 과거의 일이라 was filmed예요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 연결할 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: We went to Gyeongju, and there we visited many temples.
items.s: We went to Gyeongju, ___ many temples.
items.exp: and there는 장소를 보충 설명하는 계속적 용법의 관계부사 where로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Whoever wants to join the club can sign up here.
You may choose whichever color you like.
Whatever you do, do your best.
However you are tired, you must finish the report.
I'll follow you wherever you go.
items.exp: '아무리 ~해도'는 「however+형용사/부사+주어+동사」 어순이므로 However tired you are로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Whoever break the window must pay for it.
Whatever happen, I will not give up.
You can visit me whenever you will be free.
No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't open the jar.
However fast you run, you can't catch up with he.
items.exp: ④ no matter how+부사+주어+동사로 옳아요. ① Whoever는 단수 취급해 breaks, ② happens, ③ 시간 부사절이라 are, ⑤ 전치사 with 뒤는 목적격 him이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: Whichever you choose, you will be satisfying.
Whenever I hear this song, I think of my grandma.
Anyone who comes first will get a free ticket.
No matter where you are, I'll find you.
items.exp: 복합관계대명사는 옳지만, 사람이 '만족하는' 것이므로 satisfying이 아니라 satisfied를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Whoever she meets, she always smile.
Whatever does he say, don't believe him.
I'll give you whichever of the two bags you want it.
Whoever finish first can go home.
However careful you are, mistakes can happen.
items.exp: ⑤ however+형용사+주어+동사로 옳아요. ① 주어 she에 맞춰 smiles, ② 「whatever+주어+동사」라 Whatever he says, ③ whichever가 want의 목적어이므로 it을 빼고, ④ Whoever는 단수 취급 finishes예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Whatever you need, just let me know.
(b) Whoever calls, tell them I'm out.
(c) However hard it may be, I'll try it.
(d) Wherever she goes, her dog follow her.
(e) Whichever team wins, we'll have a party.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 양보의 whatever. (b) 옳음: 양보의 whoever. (c) 옳음: however+형용사+주어+동사. (d) 틀림: 주절 주어 her dog에 맞춰 follows. (e) 옳음: whichever+명사, 부사절이라 현재시제 wins. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) You can invite whoever you want.
(b) Whatever you said yesterday were true.
(c) However much it costs, I will buy it.
(d) Whenever will you come, you are welcome.
(e) No matter what happens, stay calm.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: Whatever절 주어는 단수 취급해 was. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 「whenever+주어+동사」이고 부사절이라 Whenever you come. (e) 옳음. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) However late it is, call me.
(b) Whoever told you that, it's not true.
(c) Take whatever you like from the basket.
(d) Wherever you may go, I will remember you.
(e) Whichever you pick, it will be fine.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: however+형용사+주어+동사. (b) 옳음: 양보의 whoever. (c) 옳음: anything that의 뜻. (d) 옳음: 양보절에 may를 쓸 수 있어요. (e) 옳음: 양보의 whichever, 현재시제 pick. 따라서 옳은 것은 5개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Whatever you decide, I'll support you.
(b) Whoever answer the phone, ask for Mr. Lee.
(c) However you are smart, you need practice.
(d) Whenever I visit her, she is reading a book.
(e) You may sit wherever you like.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: Whoever는 단수 취급해 answers. (c) 틀림: However smart you are. (d) 옳음. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Whatever happened, it's not your fault.
(b) Whoever comes to the party are welcome.
(c) However busy he is, he exercises every day.
(d) Whichever book do you read, you'll learn something.
(e) Wherever you go, take your phone with you.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: Whoever절이 주어이면 단수 취급해 is. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 「whichever+명사+주어+동사」이므로 Whichever book you read. (e) 옳음. 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 두 문장의 뜻이 같은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Whoever wins will get a medal. = Anyone who wins will get a medal.
(b) Whatever you do, I'll trust you. = Anything that you do, I'll trust you.
(c) Whenever you come, I'll be happy. = No matter when you come, I'll be happy.
(d) However tired you are, you must go. = No matter how tired you are, you must go.
(e) Wherever you go, I'll follow you. = Any place that you go, I'll follow you.
items.exp: (a) 같음: 명사절 whoever = anyone who. (b) 다름: 양보의 whatever는 No matter what으로 바꿔요. (c) 같음. (d) 같음. (e) 다름: No matter where(또는 at any place where)로 바꿔야 해요. 같은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ comes to my house is welcome.
(B) ___ difficult the problem is, she never gives up.
(C) You can take ___ of the two cakes you like.
items.exp: (A) '오는 사람은 누구든'이므로 Whoever, (B) 형용사 앞의 '아무리 ~해도'는 However, (C) 정해진 것(두 케이크) 중 '어느 것이든'은 whichever예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Whoever ___ the rules will be punished.
(B) Whatever she ___ yesterday was delicious.
items.exp: (A) whoever는 단수 취급하므로 breaks, (B) yesterday가 있으므로 과거 cooked예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> [Whatever] you choose, I'll be happy.
choices: You can eat [whatever] is in the fridge.
items.exp: <보기>의 Whatever는 '무엇을 ~하더라도'(= No matter what)라는 양보 부사절이에요. ③만 양보이고, 나머지는 '~하는 것은 무엇이든'(= anything that)의 명사절이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> [However] hard he tried, he couldn't win.
choices: I wanted to go. [However], I was too busy.
[However] tired she was, she cooked dinner.
[However] much you eat, you never gain weight.
[However] you do it, the result will be the same.
items.exp: <보기>의 However는 '아무리 ~해도'라는 복합관계부사예요. ①은 '그러나'라는 뜻의 접속부사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그가 무슨 말을 하든, 나는 마음을 바꾸지 않을 거야.
items.s: ___, I won't change my mind.
items.exp: '무엇을 ~하더라도'는 양보의 whatever로 나타내고, 「whatever+주어+동사」 어순에 3인칭 단수 says를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: No matter how fast you run, you can't catch the bus.
items.s: ___ you run, you can't catch the bus.
items.exp: no matter how는 however로 바꿀 수 있고, 부사 fast를 however 바로 뒤에 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Anyone who finishes the test early can leave the room.
items.s: ___ the test early can leave the room.
items.exp: anyone who는 whoever로 바꿀 수 있고, whoever는 단수 취급하므로 finishes예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: [However you are busy], you should eat breakfast. → ___
items.exp: '아무리 ~해도'는 「however+형용사+주어+동사」 어순이므로 형용사 busy를 however 바로 뒤에 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 어제 회의에서 논의된 것은 무엇이든 비밀로 지켜져야 한다.
items.s: Whatever ___ at the meeting yesterday must be kept secret.
items.exp: Whatever가 이끄는 명사절에서 whatever가 주어이고 '논의된' 것이므로 수동태, 단수 취급하고 과거라 was discussed예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 네가 원할 때는 언제든지 내 자전거를 써도 돼.
items.s: You can use my bike ___.
items.exp: '~할 때는 언제든지'는 복합관계부사 whenever로 나타내요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: If I had a car, I would drive you home.
If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
If it were not raining, we could play outside.
If I had eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
If they had left earlier, they would catch the train last night.
items.exp: last night의 과거 사실과 반대이므로 가정법 과거완료 would have caught를 써야 해요. ④는 과거(if절)와 현재(now, 주절)가 섞인 혼합가정법으로 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: If I am a bird, I could fly to you.
If he had more time, he will travel around the world.
If you had told me the truth, I would forgive you then.
If she hadn't missed the bus, she would be here now.
If we have had a map, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
items.exp: ④ 과거에 버스를 놓쳐 지금 여기 없다는 혼합가정법이에요. ① were, ② would travel, ③ then은 과거라 would have forgiven, ⑤ had had로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: If the movie were more excited, more people would watch it.
If I were you, I wouldn't spend all the money.
If the weather had been nice, we would have gone to the beach.
If he lived near the school, he wouldn't have to take the bus.
If she had taken the medicine, she would feel better now.
items.exp: 가정법 과거 형태는 옳지만, 영화가 '흥미진진하게 하는' 것이므로 excited가 아니라 exciting을 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: If he were here, he will help us.
If I had known it was your birthday, I would buy a gift yesterday.
If we hadn't wasted so much time, we would have finished the project.
If it doesn't snow so heavily yesterday, we could have gone out.
If she would have come, I would have been happy.
items.exp: ③ 가정법 과거완료로 옳아요. ① would help, ② yesterday라 would have bought, ④ hadn't snowed, ⑤ if절에는 would를 쓰지 않고 had come이에요.

items.q:
다음 가정법 문장을 직설법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
If I had not lost my wallet, I could buy the shoes now.
choices: As I didn't lose my wallet, I can buy the shoes now.
As I lost my wallet, I can't buy the shoes now.
As I lost my wallet, I couldn't buy the shoes then.
As I don't lose my wallet, I can buy the shoes now.
As I had lost my wallet, I can buy the shoes now.
items.exp: if절은 과거 사실(지갑을 잃어버렸다)의 반대, 주절은 현재(now) 사실(살 수 없다)의 반대인 혼합가정법이에요. 그래서 As I lost my wallet, I can't buy the shoes now.예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If I knew her address, I would send her a letter.
(b) If he had been careful, he wouldn't have broken the vase.
(c) If you had come to the party, you would have enjoyed it.
(d) If it is sunny now, we could go for a walk.
(e) If I had slept enough last night, I wouldn't be so tired now.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거. (b) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 현재 사실의 반대이므로 If it were sunny. (e) 옳음: 혼합가정법. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) If she were taller, she could reach the top shelf.
(b) If we had won the game, we would have been happy.
(c) If I have a brother, I would play soccer with him every day.
(d) If you had listened to me, you wouldn't be in trouble now.
(e) If he hadn't helped me, I would fail the test last week.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: 주절이 would play이므로 가정법 과거 If I had. (d) 옳음: 혼합가정법. (e) 틀림: last week의 과거이므로 would have failed. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If I had had enough money, I would have bought the bike.
(b) If I were rich, I will help people in need.
(c) If she hadn't been sick, she would have joined us yesterday.
(d) If they had practiced more, they would win the contest last month.
(e) If he had followed the doctor's advice, he would be healthier now.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: had had는 have의 과거완료. (b) 틀림: 가정법 과거이므로 would help. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: last month이므로 would have won. (e) 옳음: 혼합가정법. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If you were in my shoes, what would you do?
(b) If I had known the answer, I would have raised my hand.
(c) If he has a car, he could drive us there.
(d) If she had not missed the plane, she would be in Paris now.
(e) If we had a map then, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거. (b) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료. (c) 틀림: 주절 could에 맞춰 If he had. (d) 옳음: 혼합가정법. (e) 틀림: then(과거)이고 주절이 wouldn't have gotten이므로 had had. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If I lived in the country, I could keep a dog.
(b) If he had told me earlier, I could have helped him.
(c) If she had saved money, she can buy the bag now.
(d) If you study harder, you would get better grades.
(e) If the bus had come on time, I wouldn't have been late this morning.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: 혼합가정법이므로 could buy. (d) 틀림: 주절이 would get이므로 If you studied. (e) 옳음: 이미 지난 this morning의 일이라 가정법 과거완료. 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
두 문장의 뜻이 같은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) As I am not tall, I can't be a model. = If I were tall, I could be a model.
(b) As he didn't come, we didn't start. = If he had come, we would have started.
(c) As she was sick, she couldn't go. = If she weren't sick, she could go.
(d) As I skipped breakfast, I'm hungry now. = If I hadn't skipped breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
(e) As it is raining, we stay in. = If it weren't raining, we would stay in.
items.exp: (a) 같음: 현재 반대 → 가정법 과거. (b) 같음: 과거 반대 → 가정법 과거완료. (c) 다름: 과거 사실이므로 If she hadn't been sick, she could have gone. (d) 같음: 혼합가정법. (e) 다름: 비가 오지 않으면 집에 있지 않을 것이므로 wouldn't stay home이어야 해요. 같은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If I ___ you, I would take the job.
(B) If he had left home earlier, he ___ the first train.
items.exp: (A) 현재 사실의 반대인 가정법 과거라 were, (B) if절이 had left인 가정법 과거완료이므로 would have caught예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If I had taken the umbrella this morning, I ___ wet now.
(B) If she ___ busy now, she would go shopping with us.
items.exp: (A) 과거(this morning)에 하지 않은 일이 현재(now)에 영향을 주는 혼합가정법이라 wouldn't be, (B) 현재 사실의 반대이므로 weren't예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If we ___ the map last night, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
(B) If it ___ so cold today, we would go swimming.
(C) If you had followed my advice, you ___ in trouble now.
choices: had checked – weren't – wouldn't have been
checked – hadn't been – wouldn't have been
items.exp: (A) 가정법 과거완료라 had checked, (B) 오늘(현재) 사실의 반대라 weren't, (C) 과거 일이 현재(now)에 영향을 주는 혼합가정법이라 wouldn't be예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 그 소식을 알았더라면, 너에게 말했을 텐데.
items.s: If I had known the news, ___.
items.exp: 과거 사실과 반대되는 가정이므로 주절에 「would have+과거분사」를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As I don't have enough time, I can't help you.
items.s: If ___, I could help you.
items.exp: 현재 사실(시간이 없다)의 반대는 가정법 과거이므로 if절에 과거형 had를 쓰고 긍정으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As he didn't take the medicine, he is sick now.
items.s: If he had taken the medicine, he ___ sick now.
items.exp: 과거(약을 먹지 않음)가 현재(지금 아픔)에 영향을 주므로 혼합가정법이에요. 주절은 「would+동사원형」이고 '아프지 않을 텐데'라 부정이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: If she [has] more free time now, she would learn to play the guitar. → ___
items.exp: 주절이 would learn이고 now가 있으므로 현재 사실의 반대인 가정법 과거예요. if절에 과거형 had를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 작년에 그 다리가 수리되었더라면, 지금 우리는 강을 쉽게 건널 수 있을 텐데.
items.s: If the bridge ___ last year, we could cross the river easily now.
items.exp: if절은 작년(과거) 사실의 반대이므로 과거완료이고, 다리는 '수리되는' 대상이라 수동태 had been repaired예요. 주절은 now라 could cross인 혼합가정법이에요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: If it hadn't rained yesterday, we would have gone hiking.
items.s: As it rained yesterday, ___.
items.exp: 가정법 과거완료는 과거 사실의 반대이므로, 직설법에서는 과거시제로 쓰고 긍정·부정을 반대로 바꿔 didn't go예요.

units.name: Ch10-2 I wish, as if 가정법

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I wish I didn't lose my umbrella on the bus this morning.
I wish I had studied harder when I was in elementary school.
He acts as if he were the owner of this restaurant.
I wish my parents let me keep a puppy now.
She looked as if she had cried all night.
items.exp: this morning은 이미 지난 과거의 일이므로 I wish 가정법 과거완료 hadn't lost로 써야 해요. let은 과거형도 let이라 가정법 과거로 맞는 문장이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I wish I can speak Chinese as well as you.
She wished she has a bigger room when she was young.
They act as if they had knew the secret for years.
I wish it were not rain so much these days.
Jisu talks as if she had seen the movie, but she hasn't seen it yet.
items.exp: 보지 않은 영화를 본 것처럼 말하므로 as if 가정법 과거완료 had seen이 맞아요. can→could, has→had, knew→known, were not rain→didn't rain으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: I wish you were here to see this view.
He smiled as if nothing had happened.
I wish I hadn't eaten so much pizza last night.
I wish I were as brave as my older sister.
My dog behaves as if he were understand every word I say.
items.exp: as if 가정법 과거는 일반동사의 과거형을 쓰므로 were understand를 understood로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: I wish I had a time machine and can go back to the past.
I wished I had listened to my teacher's advice before the exam.
I wish my brother doesn't play games all night.
She wishes she has more friends at her new school.
They looked at me as if I had been say something strange.
items.exp: 시험 전(소망한 시점보다 앞선 일)에 대한 아쉬움이므로 wished 뒤에 had listened가 맞아요. and 뒤의 can도 could여야 하고, doesn't→didn't, has→had, had been say→had said로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: I wish I had been invited to her birthday party last Saturday.
She talks as if she were loved by everyone in the class.
He looked as if he had been hit by a ball.
I wish the classroom were cleaning by the students every day.
I wish I could be chosen for the school band.
items.exp: 교실은 '청소되는' 대상이므로 수동태 were cleaned로 써야 해요. 나머지는 가정법과 수동태가 바르게 결합되었어요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I wish I had a dog to walk with every evening.
(b) He talks as if he had lived in Paris, but he has never been there.
(c) I wish I could have gone to the festival last weekend.
(d) I wish my school starts later in the morning.
(e) The boy acted as if he were not afraid of the dark at all.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 현재 소망은 가정법 과거 had. (b) 옳음: 과거 경험을 반대로 가정하므로 had lived. (c) 옳음: 과거 일에 대한 소망은 could have gone. (d) 틀림: I wish 뒤에는 starts가 아니라 started. (e) 옳음: acted와 같은 시점이므로 were. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I wish I didn't have to take the test tomorrow.
(b) She sings as if she were a professional singer.
(c) I wish I took more pictures during our trip last summer.
(d) He looked as if he had been running for an hour.
(e) I wish there are more parks in my town.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 미래의 일이라도 현재 소망은 가정법 과거 didn't have to. (b) 옳음: were. (c) 틀림: last summer의 과거 일이므로 had taken. (d) 옳음: looked보다 앞서 계속된 일이라 had been running. (e) 틀림: are→were. 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 같은 것의 개수는?
(a) I'm sorry I can't help you. = I wish I could help you.
(b) I'm sorry I didn't call you. = I wish I had called you.
(c) In fact, he isn't my teacher. = He talks as if he were my teacher.
(d) In fact, she didn't see the accident. = She talks as if she saw the accident.
(e) I'm sorry you aren't with me. = I wish you weren't with me.
items.exp: (a) 같음. (b) 같음: 과거 사실은 가정법 과거완료. (c) 같음: 현재 사실 반대는 were. (d) 다름: 과거 사실 반대이므로 had seen이어야 해요. (e) 다름: 긍정·부정을 반대로 해서 I wish you were with me가 되어야 해요. 같은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wish I were taller than my older brother.
(b) She talked as if she had known me for a long time.
(c) I wish I have a chance to meet him again.
(d) Jake wishes he had not said such a rude thing yesterday.
(e) My cat stared at me as if I had took its food.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: were. (b) 옳음: talked보다 앞선 일이라 had known. (c) 틀림: have→had. (d) 옳음: yesterday의 일이라 had not said. (e) 틀림: took→taken. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wish I had been there when you won the prize.
(b) I wished I could buy the bike, but I didn't have enough money.
(c) She talked as if she were the only person who knew the truth.
(d) I wish I hadn't forget my friend's birthday last week.
(e) I wish I knew how to swim last summer.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거 일이라 had been. (b) 옳음: wished와 같은 시점이라 could buy. (c) 옳음: talked와 같은 시점이라 were. (d) 틀림: forget→forgotten. (e) 틀림: last summer의 일이므로 had known. 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Minho wished he had more free time during the exam period.
(b) I wish I had studied English harder when I was young.
(c) He talks as if he had won the race yesterday, but he actually lost it.
(d) I wish it is sunny for the picnic this Saturday.
(e) I wish I didn't stay up late last night.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: wished와 같은 시점이라 had. (b) 옳음: 과거 일이라 had studied. (c) 옳음: 어제 이긴 것처럼 말하므로 had won. (d) 틀림: is→were. (e) 틀림: last night의 일이라 hadn't stayed. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Jun talks as if he ___ a famous chef, but actually he can't cook at all.
(B) I wish I ___ his advice last week. Then I wouldn't have burned the cake.
items.exp: (A)는 현재 사실과 반대이므로 as if 가정법 과거 were, (B)는 last week의 일에 대한 아쉬움이므로 가정법 과거완료 had taken이에요.

items.q:
두 문장의 의미가 같도록 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I'm sorry that I don't know her phone number. = I wish I ___ her phone number.
(B) In fact, he didn't break the window. = He acts as if he ___ the window.
items.exp: (A) 현재 사실에 대한 아쉬움은 I wish+과거형 knew, (B) 과거 사실의 반대는 as if+had p.p.로 had broken이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Many students wish they ___ to study so late every night.
(B) I wish my bike ___ last night. Now I have to walk to school.
items.exp: (A) 학생들은 공부하도록 '강요받는' 대상이고 현재 소망이므로 가정법 과거 수동태 weren't forced, (B) 자전거는 '도난당한' 대상이고 last night의 일이므로 hadn't been stolen이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 작년에 그 축구팀에 뽑혔더라면 좋을 텐데.
items.s: I wish I ___ for the soccer team last year.
items.exp: last year의 일에 대한 아쉬움이므로 가정법 과거완료이고, 내가 '뽑히는' 것이므로 수동태 had been chosen이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 마치 그 경기에서 이겼던 것처럼 말하지만, 사실 그는 졌다.
items.s: He talks as if he ___ the game, but in fact he lost it.
items.exp: 현재 말하면서 과거에 이긴 것처럼 가정하므로 as if 가정법 과거완료 had won이에요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I'm sorry that my best friend doesn't live near my house.
items.s: I wish ___ near my house.
items.exp: 현재 사실에 대한 아쉬움이므로 I wish 가정법 과거로, doesn't live의 반대인 lived를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: In fact, she didn't tell the truth to her parents.
items.s: She acts as if she ___ the truth to her parents.
items.exp: 과거 사실(didn't tell)의 반대를 가정하므로 as if 가정법 과거완료 had told예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: When I failed the test, I wished I [studied] harder before it. → ___
items.exp: 소망한 시점(wished)보다 앞선 시험 전의 일이므로 가정법 과거완료 had studied로 써야 해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 개는 마치 며칠 동안 아무것도 먹지 못했던 것처럼 보였다.
items.s: The dog looked as if it ___ anything for days.
items.exp: looked보다 앞선 시점부터 먹지 못한 것처럼 보였으므로 as if 가정법 과거완료의 부정 had not eaten이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: If it had not been for his help, I would fail the exam last month.
Without the map, we would have gotten lost in the forest yesterday.
Were I you, I would apologize to her first.
Had it not been for the rain, the game would have finished on time.
Had she left earlier, she wouldn't be stuck in traffic now.
items.exp: last month의 과거 사실과 반대이므로 주절도 would have failed로 써야 해요. 마지막 문장은 과거 조건과 현재 결과를 잇는 혼합가정법이라 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Had not I missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.
Without your advice, I would make a terrible mistake last year.
Did I have a car, I would drive you home.
But for the heater, we would freeze last night.
Were it not for the sun, nothing could live on the earth.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대이므로 Were it not for+가정법 과거가 맞아요. Had I not missed, would have made, If I had a car, would have frozen으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: If I had taken the medicine yesterday, I would feel better now.
Had he not helped me then, I would still be lost.
Without water, all plants would die.
But for the life jacket, he would have drowned in the river.
Without the teacher's help, we would not solve the problem yesterday.
items.exp: yesterday의 과거 사실과 반대이므로 주절은 would not have solved로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: If it had not been for my phone, I couldn't call you yesterday.
Had it not been for the volunteers, the festival would not have been so successful.
Were I a bird, I will fly to you right now.
Had been I there, I could have helped her.
Had I knew about the sale, I would have bought the jacket.
items.exp: 과거 사실의 반대를 Had it not been for로 바르게 썼어요. couldn't have called, would fly, Had I been, Had I known으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: Had the window been closed, the cat wouldn't have run away.
Without the firefighters, many houses would have been burned.
Were the rules followed by everyone, the game would be fairer.
If it had not been for the storm, the flight would not have cancelled.
Had I been told about the change, I would have come earlier.
items.exp: 비행기는 '취소되는' 대상이므로 수동태 would not have been cancelled로 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Without music, my life would be boring.
(b) Had I studied harder, I would have passed the test.
(c) If it had not been for the seat belt, he would have been hurt badly.
(d) Were it not for the Internet, we could not search for information so easily.
(e) But for his help, I would not finish the project last week.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Without+가정법 과거. (b) 옳음: if 생략 도치 Had I studied. (c) 옳음: 과거 사실 반대. (d) 옳음: Were it not for+가정법 과거. (e) 틀림: last week의 일이므로 would not have finished. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Had not she called me, I would have overslept this morning.
(b) Were I in your place, I would not buy that expensive bag.
(c) If it were not for the trees, the air would not be so clean.
(d) Without your umbrella, I would get wet yesterday.
(e) Had he not broken his leg, he would play in today's game.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: if 생략 도치는 Had she not called. (b) 옳음: Were I. (c) 옳음: If it were not for. (d) 틀림: yesterday의 일이므로 would have gotten wet. (e) 옳음: 과거 조건+오늘의 결과인 혼합가정법. 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 같은 것의 개수는?
(a) Without you, I would have failed. = Had it not been for you, I would have failed.
(b) If I knew it, I could tell you. = Did I know it, I could tell you.
(c) If it were not for gravity, we would float. = But for gravity, we would float.
(d) As I didn't have money, I couldn't buy it. = Had I had money, I could have bought it.
(e) As it is raining, we can't go out. = If it were not raining, we could not go out.
items.exp: (a) 같음. (b) 다름: if를 생략할 때 Did로 도치하지 않아요. (c) 같음. (d) 같음: 과거 사실 반대를 Had I had로 도치. (e) 다름: 비가 오지 않는다면 나갈 수 있으므로 could go out이어야 해요. 같은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Had I been there, I could have helped you.
(b) Without the doctor's quick action, the boy would die last night.
(c) Were it not for the moon, the night sky would be very dark.
(d) If it had not been for the fog, the plane would have taken off on time.
(e) Had not they warned us, we would have been in danger.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: last night의 일이라 would have died. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: Had they not warned로 써야 해요. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Had I eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
(b) If I had saved money last year, I could buy a new laptop now.
(c) Had she took the subway, she would have arrived on time.
(d) If it were not for the bridge, we would have to take a boat.
(e) Had we left home earlier, we would catch the train an hour ago.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 혼합가정법. (b) 옳음: 혼합가정법. (c) 틀림: took→taken. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: an hour ago의 일이므로 would have caught. 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) But for the coach, the team would not win the final last year.
(b) If it had not been for your support, I would give up long ago.
(c) Were I rich, I would build a library for children.
(d) Had it not snowed so much, the roads would not be closed now.
(e) Had it not been for the guide, we would get lost in the jungle last week.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: last year의 일이라 would not have won. (b) 틀림: long ago의 일이라 would have given up. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음: 과거 조건+현재 결과(now)의 혼합가정법. (e) 틀림: last week의 일이라 would have gotten lost. 옳은 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ your help, I could not have finished the report.
(B) ___ I a little taller, I could reach the top shelf.
items.exp: (A) 명사 앞에서 '~이 없었다면'은 Without, (B) If I were에서 if를 생략한 Were I예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Had it not been for the alarm, I (A) ___ the bus this morning. And if I had missed it, I (B) ___ in trouble now.
choices: would have missed – would have been
items.exp: (A) this morning의 과거 일이므로 would have missed, (B) now가 있는 혼합가정법이므로 would be예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Were it not for air, nothing ___ on the earth.
(B) If it ___ for the rain yesterday, we could have gone hiking.
choices: could have lived – had not been
items.exp: (A) Were it not for는 가정법 과거라 could live, (B) yesterday의 과거 일이므로 If it had not been for예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 지도가 없었다면, 우리는 길을 잃었을 것이다.
items.s: ___ the map, we would have gotten lost.
items.exp: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 If it had not been for를 쓰는데, if를 생략하면 Had it not been for가 돼요.

items.q: if를 생략하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
items.ctx: If I were in your shoes, I would take the job.
items.s: ___ in your shoes, I would take the job.
items.exp: 가정법 과거에서 if를 생략하면 주어와 were의 순서를 바꿔 Were I가 돼요.

items.q: if를 생략한 가정법으로 같은 의미가 되게 바꿔 쓰세요.
items.ctx: As I didn't wear a coat, I caught a cold.
items.s: ___ a coat, I wouldn't have caught a cold.
items.exp: 과거 사실(didn't wear)의 반대이므로 가정법 과거완료 If I had worn이고, if를 생략하면 Had I worn이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 어젯밤에 비가 오지 않았더라면, 지금 운동장이 젖어 있지 않을 텐데.
items.s: Had it not rained last night, the playground ___ wet now.
items.exp: 조건은 과거(last night), 결과는 현재(now)인 혼합가정법이므로 would not be예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Without your quick call, the fire [would spread] to the next building last night. → ___
items.exp: last night의 과거 사실과 반대이므로 Without 뒤 주절은 가정법 과거완료 would have spread예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 만약 스마트폰이 없다면, 많은 사람들이 불편함을 느낄 텐데.
items.s: ___ for smartphones, many people would feel uncomfortable.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대는 If it were not for인데, if를 생략하면 Were it not for가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Not only the students but also their teacher were surprised by the news.
The number of students who walk to school is decreasing.
Each of the books on these shelves has a different color.
Three years is a long time to wait for a friend.
Most of the water in this lake comes from the mountains.
items.exp: 「not only A but also B」는 B(their teacher)에 수를 맞추므로 were를 was로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The rest of the money were donated to the hospital.
The man who sells flowers on the corner have a beautiful garden.
The boy as well as his parents was invited to the wedding.
Economics are one of the most popular majors at this university.
Either you or Minsu have to clean the classroom today.
items.exp: 「A as well as B」는 A(The boy)에 수를 맞춰 was가 맞아요. were→was, have→has, are→is, have→has로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Forty percent of the money was spent on food.
The elderly need more care in winter.
Whether we win or lose doesn't matter much.
Neither my brother nor I am good at cooking.
A number of tourists visits this village every summer.
items.exp: 「a number of+복수명사」는 '많은 ~'로 복수 취급하므로 visits를 visit으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Two-thirds of the students in my class has a pet.
Everyone in my family, including my grandparents, loves spicy food.
To make new friends at a new school are not easy.
There is many cookies left in the jar.
The pictures on the wall of my room was painted by my aunt.
items.exp: Everyone은 단수이고 삽입구(including ~)와 상관없이 loves가 맞아요. has→have, are→is, is→are, was→were로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: The key to the lockers is kept in the office.
The girls in the picture, who are my cousins, live in Busan.
Each boy and each girl gets a free ticket.
The list of the winners were posted on the board.
All of the milk in the bottle has gone bad.
items.exp: 주어의 핵심은 The list(단수)이므로 were를 was로 고쳐야 해요. of the winners는 수식어예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Half of the cake was eaten by the children.
(b) Half of the cookies were eaten by the children.
(c) Every teacher and student in this school has to wear a name tag.
(d) Ten kilometers are too far to walk in this heat.
(e) Something strange is happening in the park.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: of 뒤 the cake(단수). (b) 옳음: of 뒤 the cookies(복수). (c) 옳음: every가 이끄는 주어는 and로 이어져도 단수. (d) 틀림: 거리는 하나의 단위로 보아 is. (e) 옳음: -thing은 단수. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The number of people who use bikes are growing.
(b) My brother, as well as my parents, likes Korean food.
(c) Neither my sister nor my parents like horror movies.
(d) Some of the information on this website is wrong.
(e) The people who live next door has three dogs.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: the number of는 단수이므로 is growing. (b) 옳음: A as well as B는 A에 일치. (c) 옳음: neither A nor B는 B(my parents)에 일치. (d) 옳음: of 뒤 information(셀 수 없음)이라 단수. (e) 틀림: 주어 The people은 복수라 have. 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Mathematics is my best subject.
(b) The young are usually interested in new technology.
(c) That the students wear uniforms makes the school look neat.
(d) One of the girls who are dancing on the stage is my cousin.
(e) Fifty dollars is enough to buy the shoes.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 학문 이름은 단수. (b) 옳음: the+형용사는 복수. (c) 옳음: that절 주어는 단수라 makes. (d) 옳음: 관계사절은 선행사 the girls에 맞춰 are, 문장 주어 One은 단수라 is. (e) 옳음: 금액은 단수. 모두 옳아 5개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Each of the players have a uniform with a number.
(b) The rest of the students are waiting in the hall.
(c) A number of the questions were very difficult.
(d) Learning to play musical instruments take a lot of practice.
(e) Both my uncle and my aunt work at the hospital.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: each of는 단수라 has. (b) 옳음: the rest of 뒤 복수명사라 are. (c) 옳음: a number of는 복수. (d) 틀림: 동명사구 주어는 단수라 takes. (e) 옳음: both A and B는 복수. 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Not only I but also my brother likes baseball.
(b) Either my parents or my sister is going to pick me up.
(c) The books that my teacher recommended was really interesting.
(d) Sixty percent of the land are covered with forests.
(e) Nobody in my class knows the answer.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: B(my brother)에 일치. (b) 옳음: either A or B는 B(my sister)에 일치. (c) 틀림: 주어 The books는 복수라 were. (d) 틀림: of 뒤 the land(단수)라 is. (e) 옳음: nobody는 단수. 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The poor in the city need warm clothes this winter.
(b) Most of the furniture in this room are made of wood.
(c) What I want to buy for my mom is a pair of gloves.
(d) There are a lot of money in the box.
(e) The girl with two big dogs lives next to my house.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the poor는 복수. (b) 틀림: furniture는 셀 수 없는 명사라 is. (c) 옳음: what절 주어는 단수. (d) 틀림: money는 셀 수 없으므로 There is. (e) 옳음: 주어는 The girl(단수). 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The number of cars on this road ___ increased a lot.
(B) A number of cars ___ parked in front of the store now.
items.exp: (A) the number of는 '~의 수'로 단수라 has, (B) a number of는 '많은 ~'로 복수라 are예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Physics (A) ___ hard for me, but the students who study it with me (B) ___ it fun.
items.exp: (A) 학문 이름 physics는 단수라 is, (B) 주어는 관계사절의 수식을 받는 the students(복수)라 find예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The pictures that my grandfather took ___ very old.
(B) Every one of the pictures ___ a story behind it.
items.exp: (A) 주어는 The pictures(복수)라 are, (B) every one of는 단수라 has예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 도서관의 책들 중 대부분은 기증되었다.
items.s: Most of the books in the library ___.
items.exp: most of는 of 뒤 명사에 수를 맞추므로 books(복수)에 맞추고, 책은 '기증되는' 대상이라 수동태예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 매일 아침 운동하는 것은 지난 3개월 동안 내 건강을 향상시켜 왔다.
items.s: Exercising every morning ___ my health for the last three months.
items.exp: 동명사구 주어는 단수이고, for the last three months는 현재완료와 함께 쓰므로 has improved예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나뿐만 아니라 내 친구들도 그 소식에 놀랐다.
items.s: Not only I but also my friends ___ at the news.
items.exp: not only A but also B는 B(my friends)에 수를 맞추고, '놀라게 된' 것이므로 수동태 were surprised예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 부유한 사람들이 항상 행복한 것은 아니다.
items.s: ___ always happy.
items.exp: 「the+형용사」는 '~한 사람들'로 복수 취급하므로 are를 쓰고, '항상 ~인 것은 아니다'는 not always예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The number of students who [joins] the science club has doubled this year. → ___
items.exp: 관계사절의 동사는 선행사 students(복수)에 맞추므로 join이에요. 문장 전체 동사 has는 the number에 맞춘 거예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Every one of the songs on her new album [are] about her hometown. → ___
items.exp: every one of는 단수 취급하므로 is로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: We learned that the Olympic Games had been held in Seoul in 1988.
I thought that Mina would join our club.
He told me that he had already seen the movie twice.
Our teacher said that the moon goes around the earth.
I know that she will come back next week.
items.exp: 역사적 사실은 주절의 시제와 상관없이 과거시제로 쓰므로 had been held를 were held로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: She told me that light traveled faster than sound.
I heard that Jisu has won the singing contest last week.
My father said that he will buy me a bike the next day.
I was sure that she will solve the problem soon.
She said that she had lost her wallet the day before.
items.exp: 주절(said)보다 앞선 일이므로 had lost가 맞아요. 과학적 사실은 travels, last week는 won, 주절이 과거이므로 will은 would로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: The guide told us that the museum opens at nine every day.
I hoped that you would like my present.
She knew that her brother had broken the vase.
I think that he was very busy last week.
Mr. Park taught us that water froze at 0°C.
items.exp: 물이 0°C에서 어는 것은 과학적 사실이므로 froze를 freezes로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: We learned that the Korean War has broken out in 1950.
My grandmother always told me that practice makes perfect.
She told me that she has been sick since the previous Monday.
They said that the earth was round.
I knew that he can't come to the party the next day.
items.exp: 속담·격언은 항상 현재시제이므로 makes가 맞아요. broke, had been, is, couldn't로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞는 것은?
choices: He found out that his bike had stolen.
We knew that the game will be held the next day.
Jake told me that he is reading a book at that time.
I was told that the concert had been canceled because of the rain.
I thought that the bridge was build fifty years ago.
items.exp: 콘서트는 '취소된' 대상이고 주절보다 앞선 일이므로 had been canceled가 맞아요. had been stolen, would be held, was reading, was built로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I thought that you were at home.
(b) He said that he would call me the next day.
(c) We learned that the Second World War ended in 1945.
(d) She told us that the sun rose in the east.
(e) I knew that he has left for Paris the day before.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 과거→과거. (b) 옳음: will→would. (c) 옳음: 역사적 사실은 과거. (d) 틀림: 과학적 사실은 rises. (e) 틀림: 주절보다 앞선 일이므로 had left. 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) My mom said that she had made cookies for us.
(b) I didn't know that you could speak Chinese.
(c) The teacher told us that the earth moved around the sun.
(d) She said that she has met him two days before.
(e) Tom said that he had been to Jeju twice.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 과거 주절에 could. (c) 틀림: 과학적 사실이라 moves. (d) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 had met. (e) 옳음. 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I believe that he will win the race.
(b) I believed that he would win the race.
(c) She thought that he has been sick since last week.
(d) He knew that the bus had already left.
(e) My teacher said that time is money.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 주절이 현재면 모든 시제 가능. (b) 옳음: will→would. (c) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 had been. (d) 옳음: 앞선 일은 과거완료. (e) 옳음: 격언은 현재. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He said that he was hungry then.
(b) We learned that water boiled at 100°C.
(c) I heard that the movie has been very popular in the previous year.
(d) She said that she would visit her aunt the following week.
(e) They learned that the telephone was invented in the 19th century.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 과학적 사실이라 boils. (c) 틀림: 주절이 과거이고 the previous year가 있으므로 had been. (d) 옳음. (e) 옳음: 역사적 사실은 과거. 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I knew that the girl was telling a lie.
(b) He told me that he had lived in Canada before he moved here.
(c) Ms. Kim said that honesty was the best policy.
(d) She said that she has studied for five hours.
(e) Jimin says that she was born in Daegu.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 이사 오기 전의 일이라 had lived. (c) 틀림: 격언은 현재이므로 is. (d) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 had studied. (e) 옳음: 주절이 현재면 과거시제도 가능. 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He said that he would be a doctor when he grew up.
(b) She told me that the sun is much bigger than the earth.
(c) I hoped that it will stop raining soon.
(d) We learned that Korea and Japan hosted the World Cup together in 2002.
(e) My brother said that he had broken the window the day before.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 과학적 사실은 현재. (c) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 would. (d) 옳음: 역사적 사실은 과거. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Mina said that she (A) ___ to the library the day before and that she (B) ___ there again the next day.
items.exp: (A) 말한 시점보다 앞선 일이라 과거완료 had gone, (B) 주절이 과거이므로 will의 과거형 would go예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Our science teacher said that the earth (A) ___ around the sun, and we learned that people first (B) ___ on the moon in 1969.
items.exp: (A) 과학적 사실은 항상 현재시제 goes, (B) 역사적 사실은 항상 과거시제 walked예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Last year, my parents told me that the new library (A) ___ by the end of that year, but it (B) ___ yet.
choices: would be built – hasn't been finished
will be built – hasn't been finished
items.exp: (A) 주절이 과거이고 도서관은 '지어지는' 대상이라 would be built, (B) 지금까지 완공되지 않은 것이므로 현재완료 수동태 hasn't been finished예요.

items.q: 주절을 과거시제로 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I think that he has already finished the work.
items.s: I thought that he ___ the work.
items.exp: 주절이 과거가 되면 종속절의 현재완료는 과거완료로 바뀌어 had already finished가 돼요.

items.q: 주절을 과거시제로 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Mina says that she can't go to the party because she is sick.
items.s: Mina said that she ___ to the party because she was sick.
items.exp: 주절이 과거이므로 can't는 couldn't로 바뀌어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리는 선생님께 빛이 소리보다 더 빠르게 이동한다고 배웠다.
items.s: We learned from our teacher that light ___ faster than sound.
items.exp: 과학적 사실은 주절의 시제와 상관없이 현재시제로 쓰고, 주어 light는 단수라 travels예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 내가 문을 잠그지 않았다는 것을 깨달았다.
items.s: I realized that I ___ the door.
items.exp: 깨달은 시점(realized)보다 앞서 잠그지 않은 것이므로 과거완료 부정 had not locked예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My uncle told me that he [will visit] us the next weekend. → ___
items.exp: 주절이 과거(told)이므로 종속절의 will은 would로 써야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: We learned that the first modern Olympic Games [had been held] in Athens in 1896. → ___
items.exp: 역사적 사실은 주절의 시제와 상관없이 과거시제로 쓰므로 were held예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Jinho said me that he had to leave early.
Mina told me that she was very tired that day.
He said that he had met my sister the previous day.
The teacher told us that the earth is round.
Kate said that she was going to buy those shoes.
items.exp: say는 바로 뒤에 사람 목적어를 쓰지 않으므로 said me를 told me(또는 said to me)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
Yuna said to me, "I bought this cap for you yesterday."
choices: Yuna told me that she had bought this cap for me the day before.
Yuna told me that she had bought that cap for you the day before.
Yuna said me that she had bought that cap for me the previous day.
Yuna told me that she had bought that cap for me yesterday.
Yuna told me that she had bought that cap for me the day before.
items.exp: said to→told, I→she, you→me, bought→had bought, this→that, yesterday→the day before로 모두 바꿔야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Sam says that he is too busy to play now.
My aunt told me that she would visit us the following week.
Junho said that he had seen the movie two days before.
Dad said that he was proud of me.
Amy told me that she can't find her glasses then.
items.exp: 주절이 과거(told)이므로 can't를 couldn't로 고쳐야 해요. 주절이 현재(says)인 문장은 시제를 바꾸지 않아요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
Mr. Han said to us, "I will check your reports here tomorrow."
choices: Mr. Han told us that he will check our reports there the next day.
Mr. Han told us that he would check our reports there the next day.
Mr. Han told us that he would check your reports there the next day.
Mr. Han told us that he would check our reports here the next day.
Mr. Han said us that he would check our reports there the next day.
items.exp: said to us→told us, will→would, your→our, here→there, tomorrow→the next day로 바꿔야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: She said that she had been invited to the party.
He told us that his bike had been stolen the night before.
Yuri said that she would be late that night.
He told me that he had bought the shoes a week ago.
My teacher told me that I should read more books.
items.exp: 간접화법에서 ago는 before로 바꾸므로 a week before로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것의 개수는?
(a) He said, "I am hungry." → He said that he was hungry.
(b) She said to me, "I like your bag." → She told me that she liked my bag.
(c) Tom said, "I saw her two days ago." → Tom said that he had seen her two days ago.
(d) Mom said to me, "You can go out now." → Mom told me that I could go out then.
(e) They said, "We will leave tomorrow." → They said that they would leave tomorrow.
items.exp: (a) 바름. (b) 바름: your→my. (c) 틀림: ago→before. (d) 바름: can→could, now→then. (e) 틀림: tomorrow→the next day. 바른 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 간접화법으로 잘못 바꾼 것의 개수는?
(a) Sora said, "I'll clean this room." → Sora said that she would clean that room.
(b) Jun said to me, "I have lost your pen." → Jun told me that he had lost my pen.
(c) Ann said, "The sun rises in the east." → Ann said that the sun rises in the east.
(d) He says, "I am tired now." → He says that he was tired then.
(e) She said to us, "I met your dad yesterday." → She told us that she had met our dad yesterday.
items.exp: (a) 바름: will→would, this→that. (b) 바름: have lost→had lost. (c) 바름: 불변의 진리는 현재시제 유지. (d) 틀림: 주절이 현재면 시제·부사를 바꾸지 않아 He says that he is tired now. (e) 틀림: yesterday→the day before. 잘못된 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He told that he was sick.
(b) She said that she would call me the following day.
(c) My brother told me that he had already eaten lunch.
(d) Ben said that he was reading a book then.
(e) They told us that they had lived there before.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: told 뒤에는 사람 목적어가 필요하므로 said that 또는 told me that. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Jisu told me that she had finished her homework.
(b) Mike said that he will go to the museum the next day.
(c) The girl told us that she lived there.
(d) She said that she had visited Busan a week before.
(e) Dad told me that I have to come home early that day.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 would. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음: ago→before. (e) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 had to. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 간접화법으로 잘못 바꾼 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Mina said, "I can swim." → Mina said that she could swim.
(b) He said, "I'm busy today." → He said that he was busy that day.
(c) She said, "I bought these yesterday." → She said that she had bought these the day before.
(d) They said, "We met here." → They said that they had met there.
(e) He said to me, "You look tired." → He told me that you looked tired.
items.exp: (a) 바름. (b) 바름: today→that day. (c) 틀림: these→those. (d) 바름: here→there. (e) 틀림: you는 듣는 사람(me)을 가리키므로 I looked tired. 잘못된 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 간접화법 문장을 직접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He told me that he would call me. → He said to me, "I will call you."
(b) She said that she had been sick the day before. → She said, "I was sick yesterday."
(c) Tom told me that he was leaving then. → Tom said to me, "I am leaving now."
(d) Amy told me that she liked my idea. → Amy said to me, "I like my idea."
(e) He said that he could help us the next day. → He said, "I can help you yesterday."
items.exp: (a) 바름. (b) 바름. (c) 바름: then→now. (d) 틀림: my idea는 듣는 사람의 생각이므로 your idea. (e) 틀림: the next day→tomorrow. 바른 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
간접화법으로 바꿀 때 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Minji said to me, "I'll meet you here tomorrow."
→ Minji (A) ___ me that she would meet me (B) ___ the next day.
items.exp: said to me는 told me로 바꾸고, here는 there로 바꿔요.

items.q:
간접화법으로 바꿀 때 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Jake said, "I lost my phone two days ago, but I found it this morning."
→ Jake said that he (A) ___ his phone two days (B) ___, but that he had found it that morning.
items.exp: (A) 말한 시점보다 앞선 일이라 had lost, (B) 간접화법에서 ago는 before로 바꿔요.

items.q:
간접화법으로 바꿀 때 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Ms. Lee said to the students, "You did a great job today."
→ Ms. Lee (A) ___ the students that (B) ___ a great job (C) ___.
choices: told – they had done – that day
told – you had done – that day
said – they had done – that day
told – they have done – that day
items.exp: said to→told, you→they, did→had done, today→that day로 바꿔요.

items.q: 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Jiho said to me, "I will lend you my bike tomorrow."
items.s: Jiho told me that ___ the next day.
a: he would lend me his bike
items.exp: I→he, will→would, you→me, my→his로 바꿔요.

items.q: 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Mom said to me, "I made these cookies for you yesterday."
items.s: Mom told me that she ___ for me the day before.
items.exp: 말한 시점보다 앞선 일이므로 made→had made, these→those로 바꿔요.

items.q: 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Ms. Kim says to us, "I am too busy to see you today."
items.s: Ms. Kim tells us that she ___ to see us today.
items.exp: 전달동사가 현재(tells)이므로 시제와 부사(today)를 바꾸지 않고 is를 그대로 써요.

items.q: 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He said, "I can't come here now."
items.s: He said that he ___ then.
items.exp: 주절이 과거이므로 can't→couldn't, here→there, now→then으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Mina told me that she had visited the museum [two years ago]. → ___
items.exp: 간접화법에서 ago는 before로 바꾸므로 two years before예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My brother [said me] that he would be home late. → ___
items.exp: say는 사람 목적어를 바로 쓰지 않으므로 told me 또는 said to me로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: She asked me what time the movie started.
Dad asked me where had I put his glasses.
He asked me whether I had ever been to Jeju.
The doctor advised me not to eat late at night.
Mom told me to turn off the TV.
items.exp: 의문사가 있는 의문문의 간접화법은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이므로 where I had put으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
Mr. Choi said to me, "Where did you buy this book?"
choices: Mr. Choi asked me where had I bought that book.
Mr. Choi asked me where I had bought this book.
Mr. Choi asked me if where I had bought that book.
Mr. Choi told me where I had bought that book.
Mr. Choi asked me where I had bought that book.
items.exp: said to→asked, 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순, did buy→had bought, this→that으로 바꿔야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: The teacher asked us who had broken the window.
My friend asked me whether or not I liked the gift.
The guide told us not to touch the paintings.
He asked me why I looked so sad.
She asked me if could I help her with her homework.
items.exp: if가 이끄는 간접의문문은 「if+주어+동사」 어순이므로 if I could help로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 문장을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
The coach said to us, "Don't give up until the end."
choices: The coach told us don't give up until the end.
The coach told us not to give up until the end.
The coach told us not give up until the end.
The coach said us not to give up until the end.
The coach asked us that we didn't give up until the end.
items.exp: 부정 명령문은 「tell+목적어+not to+동사원형」으로 바꿔요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 if의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> He asked me [if] I had seen his cat.
choices: [If] you hurry, you can catch the bus.
I'll stay home [if] it snows tomorrow.
[If] I were you, I would wait.
She wanted to know [if] the store was open.
You can borrow it [if] you need it.
items.exp: <보기>와 정답의 if는 '~인지'라는 뜻으로 명사절(목적어)을 이끌어요. 나머지는 '만약 ~라면'의 조건 부사절이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 to의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> Mom told me [to] clean my room.
choices: She advised me [to] drink more water.
I went to the store [to] buy milk.
I have a lot of homework [to] do.
items.exp: <보기>와 정답의 to부정사는 tell, advise의 목적격보어예요. 나머지는 목적, 형용사적, 목적어, 감정의 원인으로 쓰였어요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) He asked me if I was hungry.
(b) She asked me what was my name.
(c) Mom told me to wash my hands before dinner.
(d) The teacher asked us whether we had finished the test.
(e) I asked him where did he live.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: what my name was 어순. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: where he lived 어순. 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 간접화법으로 잘못 바꾼 것의 개수는?
(a) She said to me, "Are you tired?" → She asked me if I was tired.
(b) He said to me, "What do you want?" → He asked me what I wanted.
(c) Dad said to me, "Be careful." → Dad told me to be careful.
(d) She said to him, "Don't be late." → She told him not to be late.
(e) He said, "Who called me?" → He asked who had called him.
items.exp: (a) 바름: if+주어+동사. (b) 바름: what+주어+동사. (c) 바름: to+동사원형. (d) 바름: not to. (e) 바름: 의문사 who가 주어이므로 그대로 쓰고 called→had called. 잘못된 것은 0개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The doctor advised him to get some rest.
(b) She asked me whether or not I would come.
(c) My mom asked me how much the shoes cost.
(d) He ordered the dog sit down.
(e) They asked me which bus went to the station.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: whether or not 가능. (c) 옳음: cost의 과거형은 cost. (d) 틀림: order는 목적격보어로 to부정사를 써서 to sit. (e) 옳음: which bus가 주어라 바로 동사가 와요. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I asked her where she was going.
(b) He asked me that I liked music.
(c) The teacher told us to be quiet in the library.
(d) She asked me how old was my sister.
(e) My friend asked me whether I could lend her some money.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 의문사 없는 의문문은 if/whether. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: how old my sister was 어순. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 간접화법으로 잘못 바꾼 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He said to me, "Can you swim?" → He asked me if I could swim.
(b) She said to me, "Where are you going?" → She asked me where I was going.
(c) Mom said to me, "Don't play games." → Mom told me not to play games.
(d) He said to her, "Do you like this?" → He asked her if she liked this.
(e) She said to me, "Who is that boy?" → She asked me who was that boy.
items.exp: (a) 바름. (b) 바름. (c) 바름. (d) 틀림: this→that. (e) 틀림: who that boy was 어순. 잘못된 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The police officer ordered the man to stop the car.
(b) She asked me what I had done the day before.
(c) He asked me whether I knew the answer or not.
(d) The nurse told me don't move.
(e) I asked my dad if he will buy me a bike.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: whether ~ or not 가능. (d) 틀림: told me not to move. (e) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 would. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
간접화법으로 바꿀 때 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Jenny said to me, "Do you have a pen?"
→ Jenny asked me (A) ___ I (B) ___ a pen.
items.exp: 의문사가 없는 의문문은 if(whether)로 연결하고, 주절이 과거이므로 have→had로 바꿔요.

items.q:
간접화법으로 바꿀 때 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The teacher said to us, "Don't run in the hallway."
→ The teacher (A) ___ us (B) ___ in the hallway.
items.exp: 부정 명령문은 「told+목적어+not to+동사원형」으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Minsu said to me, "Why were you absent yesterday?"
items.s: Minsu asked me ___ the day before.
items.exp: 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순으로 쓰고, 묻는 시점보다 앞선 일이라 were→had been이에요.

items.q: 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The librarian said to us, "Please don't eat food here."
items.s: The librarian asked us ___ there.
items.exp: 부정 명령(요청)문은 「asked+목적어+not to+동사원형」으로 바꾸고, here는 there로 바꿔요.

items.q: 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: She said to me, "Have you ever tried Mexican food?"
items.s: She asked me ___ ever tried Mexican food.
items.exp: 의문사 없는 의문문은 if(whether)+주어+동사로 바꾸고, have tried→had tried가 돼요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리 선생님은 우리에게 매일 영어 일기를 쓰라고 조언하셨다.
items.s: Our teacher ___ an English diary every day.
items.exp: advise는 「advise+목적어+to부정사」 형태로 쓰고, 과거의 일이라 advised예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The man asked me where [was the bus stop]. → ___
items.exp: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이므로 the bus stop was로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Dad told me [not stay] up too late. → ___
items.exp: 부정 명령문의 간접화법은 「tell+목적어+not to+동사원형」이므로 not to stay예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It was the twins that was dancing on the stage.
My little sister does look like my mom.
It was at the bus stop that I lost my umbrella.
We did enjoy the school festival last Friday.
It is this song that always makes me happy.
items.exp: 강조된 주어 the twins가 복수이므로 that절의 동사 was를 were로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He does likes playing soccer after school.
It was in 2015 which my family moved to Daegu.
It was my grandfather who built this wooden house.
It was the red bag that Jimin bought it.
They did visited their uncle last weekend.
items.exp: 강조 대상이 사람이고 that절의 주어 역할이므로 who를 쓸 수 있어요. like, that, it 삭제, visit으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: It is not money but health that matters most.
Do be careful when you cross the street.
It was yesterday that Mr. Jang told us the news.
She did call you, but you didn't answer.
It is Mina and Yuna that makes cookies every Friday.
items.exp: 강조된 주어 Mina and Yuna는 복수이므로 makes를 make로 고쳐야 해요. not A but B는 B(health)에 맞춰 matters가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: It was on Monday what the new teacher came.
It is on weekends that my dad cooks for us.
My parents does want me to be a doctor.
It was a small cat which I saw it under the car.
Please does come to my party.
items.exp: 부사구 on weekends를 It is ~ that으로 바르게 강조했어요. that, do, it 삭제, do로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 It의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> [It] was in the garden that I found the ring.
choices: [It] is important that you eat breakfast.
[It] is true that he lied to me.
[It] was a gift from my aunt.
[It] was my sister that won the prize.
items.exp: <보기>와 정답은 It ~ that 강조 구문의 It이에요. 가주어 It(중요하다, 사실이다), 명암의 비인칭 주어 It, '그것'이라는 대명사 It과 구별해야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: He [did] his best in the test.
items.exp: did his best의 did는 '하다'라는 뜻의 일반동사이고, 나머지는 동사원형 앞에서 동사를 강조하는 조동사예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I do remember the day we first met.
(b) It was in the park that we played badminton.
(c) It is Tom and his brother that live next door.
(d) She did made a cake for her mom's birthday.
(e) It was yesterday that I lost my wallet.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: 강조된 주어가 복수라 live. (d) 틀림: did 뒤에는 동사원형 make. (e) 옳음: 시간 부사 yesterday를 It was ~ that으로 강조. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) It was last Sunday that we go to the zoo.
(b) He did tried his best in the race.
(c) It was my aunt who sent me this letter.
(d) It is the stars that shines brightly tonight.
(e) It was at the station which I met her.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 과거 일이므로 went. (b) 틀림: did try. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: the stars가 복수라 shine. (e) 틀림: 부사구(at the station) 강조는 that. 틀린 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The kids do love playing in the snow.
(b) It is the teachers that has to decide the rules.
(c) It was this book that I borrowed from Minho.
(d) My cat do sleep a lot during the day.
(e) It was with my brother which I went fishing.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: the teachers가 복수라 have. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 주어가 3인칭 단수라 does. (e) 틀림: 부사구 강조는 that. 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was Jun that broke the window.
(b) It was the window that Jun broke.
(c) It was yesterday that Jun broke the window.
(d) It was Jun which broke the window.
(e) Jun did broke the window.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 주어 강조. (b) 옳음: 목적어 강조. (c) 옳음: 부사 강조. (d) 틀림: 사람은 which가 아니라 who/that. (e) 틀림: did break. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It is my parents who always support me.
(b) I haven't finished it yet, but I do want to finish it.
(c) It was in the kitchen that I found my keys.
(d) It was my mom that she made this dress.
(e) It is the old photos that reminds me of my childhood.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: my parents에 맞춰 support. (b) 옳음: 강조의 do+동사원형. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 강조된 주어를 that절에 다시 쓰지 않으므로 she 삭제. (e) 틀림: the old photos가 복수라 remind. 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) It was Ms. Oh who taught us how to swim.
(b) She does wants to travel to Spain.
(c) It was at the library that I met him.
(d) Do sit down and have some tea.
(e) It was in the morning which the accident happened.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: does want. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음: 명령문 강조 Do+동사원형. (e) 틀림: 부사구 강조는 that. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) My brother ___ clean his room yesterday, but Mom didn't believe him.
(B) It is the children in this town ___ need a new playground.
items.exp: (A) 과거(yesterday)의 동사 강조는 did+동사원형, (B) It is ~ that 강조 구문이므로 that이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
It was in 1998 (A) ___ my parents got married, and it was my uncle (B) ___ introduced them to each other.
items.exp: (A) 부사구 in 1998을 강조하므로 that, (B) 사람(my uncle)을 강조하며 주어 역할이므로 who(that)예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장의 장소 부사구를 It ~ that 강조 구문으로 강조하여 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Jisu found the key under the sofa.
items.s: ___ Jisu found the key.
a: It was under the sofa that
items.exp: 과거 문장이므로 It was를 쓰고, 강조할 부사구 under the sofa를 It was와 that 사이에 넣어요.

items.q: 주어진 문장의 주어를 It ~ that 강조 구문으로 강조하여 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: My grandparents grow these vegetables.
items.s: ___ grow these vegetables.
items.exp: 현재 문장이므로 It is를 쓰고, 강조된 주어가 사람이라 that 또는 who를 써요. 동사 grow는 my grandparents에 맞춘 복수형이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 어제 정말로 숙제를 했지만, 집에 놓고 왔다.
items.s: I ___ my homework yesterday, but I left it at home.
items.exp: 과거의 동사를 강조하므로 did+동사원형이고, '숙제를 하다'의 동사원형 do를 붙여 did do예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리 오빠는 정말로 매운 음식을 좋아한다.
items.s: My older brother ___ spicy food.
items.exp: 3인칭 단수 현재의 동사를 강조하므로 does+동사원형 like예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It was the girls in the red shirts that [was] singing loudly. → ___
items.exp: 강조된 주어 the girls가 복수이므로 were로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: It is the blue jacket [what] I want to buy. → ___
items.exp: It is ~ that 강조 구문에서 강조된 대상이 사물이므로 that 또는 which를 써요. what은 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: On the wall hangs many pictures of my family.
Under the bridge lives an old fisherman.
Never have I seen such a big fish.
Little did we know that the store was closed.
items.exp: 장소 부사구가 앞에 와서 도치되면 동사는 뒤의 주어 many pictures(복수)에 맞춰야 하므로 hangs를 hang으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Seldom she goes to bed before midnight.
I can't swim, and neither can't my brother.
Never I have told anyone about it.
Only after the movie ended did I realize how late it was.
items.exp: Only가 이끄는 부사절이 앞에 오면 주절을 「did+주어+동사원형」으로 도치해요. does she go, he ran, neither can, have I told로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Rarely does my father drive to work.
My sister likes K-pop, and so does my mom.
In the middle of the lake is a small island.
Not until he got home he did realize he had lost his wallet.
items.exp: Not until ~이 문장 앞에 오면 주절을 도치해야 하므로 did he realize로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Little she knew that we were planning a surprise party.
Down the hill rolled the big red ball.
A: I haven't finished my homework. B: Neither did I.
Under the tree was sitting two boys.
items.exp: 방향 부사구 Down the hill이 앞에 와서 「동사+주어」로 바르게 도치됐어요. did she know, Here it comes, Neither have I, were sitting으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: Only in the morning can you see the birds here.
There goes my best friend, Jiho.
Never has the team lost a game at home.
Rarely do my parents argues with each other.
From the kitchen came a sweet smell.
items.exp: 부정어 Rarely 뒤에 「do+주어+동사원형」으로 도치하므로 argues를 argue로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Seldom does he eat vegetables.
(b) On the table were two cups of tea.
(c) Never will I forget your kindness.
(d) There comes she.
(e) I was tired, and so was my sister.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 주어 two cups에 맞춰 were. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 주어가 대명사이면 도치하지 않아 There she comes. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Only then did I understand her words.
(b) Around the corner is a nice bakery.
(c) Rarely we see snow in this city.
(d) A: I can't sleep. B: Neither can I.
(e) At the top of the hill stand an old castle.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: Rarely do we see. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: 주어 an old castle이 단수라 stands. 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Little did I dream that I would win.
(b) Hardly could he believe his eyes.
(c) Into the water jumped the boys.
(d) Away flew it.
(e) Mina has been to Japan, and so did her brother.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 조동사 could를 앞으로. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 대명사 주어는 도치하지 않아 Away it flew. (e) 틀림: 현재완료이므로 so has her brother. 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Not once did he say sorry.
(b) Among the guests was a famous chef.
(c) Here are the books you asked for.
(d) Never did I thought he would leave.
(e) Next to the bank stands a tall building.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 주어 a famous chef에 맞춰 was. (c) 옳음: 주어 the books에 맞춰 are. (d) 틀림: did 뒤 동사원형 think. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Only by working hard can you succeed.
(b) Seldom I have eaten such delicious food.
(c) Out of the box jumped a little frog.
(d) He didn't go to the party, and so did I.
(e) Rarely is the library closed on Saturdays.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: Seldom have I eaten. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: 부정문에 동의하므로 neither did I. (e) 옳음: be동사 도치. 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Behind the door was hiding a small boy.
(b) Never before the city has seen such heavy snow.
(c) Under the bed lay my lost socks.
(d) Not until last year I learned to ride a bike.
(e) There they go.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: Never before has the city seen. (c) 옳음: lay는 lie(놓여 있다)의 과거형. (d) 틀림: did I learn. (e) 옳음: 대명사 주어는 도치하지 않아요. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) On the shelf ___ a lot of old toys.
(B) Seldom ___ my grandmother use her phone.
items.exp: (A) 도치된 주어 a lot of old toys가 복수라 are, (B) 부정어 Seldom 뒤 일반동사 현재, 3인칭 단수이므로 does예요.

items.q:
대화의 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
A: I didn't like the ending of the movie.
B: (A) ___ I. It was too sad.
A: But I love the main actor.
B: (B) ___ I!
items.exp: (A) 과거 부정문(didn't like)에 동의하므로 Neither did I, (B) 현재 긍정문(love)에 동의하므로 So do I예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Little ___ that his life would change.
(B) In front of the gate ___ two guards.
items.exp: (A) 부정어 Little 뒤 「did+주어+동사원형」, (B) 장소 부사구 도치에서 동사는 two guards(복수)에 맞춰야 하므로 stood예요.

items.q: Never로 시작하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I have never heard such a beautiful song.
items.s: Never ___ such a beautiful song.
items.exp: 완료시제에서 부정어가 앞에 오면 「have+주어+과거분사」로 도치해요.

items.q: Hardly로 시작하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: She hardly understood what the teacher said.
items.s: Hardly ___ what the teacher said.
items.exp: 일반동사 과거 문장에서 부정어가 앞에 오면 「did+주어+동사원형」으로 도치해요.

items.q: 장소 부사구를 문장 앞으로 보내 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: A big brown bear came out of the cave.
items.s: Out of the cave ___.
items.exp: 장소·방향 부사구가 문장 앞에 오면 주어가 명사일 때 「동사+주어」 순서로 도치해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그 소식을 듣고 나서야 비로소 그를 이해했다.
items.hint: (understand) 활용, 조동사 can은 쓰지 말 것, 3단어
items.s: Only after I heard the news ___ him.
items.exp: Only가 이끄는 부사절이 앞에 오면 주절을 「did+주어+동사원형」으로 도치해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: A: I'm not good at math. B: [Neither do I]. I need some help. → ___
items.exp: be동사 부정문(I'm not)에 동의하므로 Neither am I로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Little [we knew] what was waiting for us. → ___
items.exp: 부정어 Little이 앞에 오면 「did+주어+동사원형」으로 도치하므로 did we know예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Though felt tired, she kept studying.
Not every student in my class likes math.
When asked about the plan, he said nothing.
The news that our team had won made everyone happy.
I wanted to go to the concert, but I couldn't afford to.
items.exp: 부사절에서는 「주어+be동사」를 함께 생략하므로 Though (she was) tired로 써야 해요. felt만 남길 수는 없어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Not every houses on this street has a garden.
The fact which he lied to me made me sad.
While walked in the park, I met my teacher.
I have a dream of become a pilot.
Not all of the stories in this book are true.
items.exp: 부분 부정 not all of 뒤 복수명사 stories에 맞춰 are가 맞아요. every house, 동격 that, While walking, of becoming으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: If possible, please send me the file today.
My uncle, a cook, opened a new restaurant.
You can use my pen if you want to.
I heard the rumor of Minho would move to Canada.
items.exp: rumor 뒤에 절(주어+동사)이 오므로 동격의 접속사 that을 써서 the rumor that Minho would move로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Not every child like ice cream.
Although very young, the boy played the piano well.
When I young, I lived in a small town.
I don't know neither of them.
Not all the students was at school today.
items.exp: Although (he was) very young에서 「주어+be동사」를 바르게 생략했어요. likes, When (I was) young, either, were로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> The news [that] he passed the test made me happy.
choices: This is the cake [that] my mom made.
The book [that] I read was boring.
There is a rumor [that] the singer will visit our school.
items.exp: <보기>와 정답의 that은 앞 명사(news, rumor)의 내용을 설명하는 동격의 that이에요. 관계대명사 that, 목적어절 that, 진주어절 that과 구별해야 해요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 of의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> I like the idea [of] living in the country.
choices: She has a dream [of] becoming a singer.
This is a picture [of] my family.
The roof [of] the house is red.
items.exp: <보기>와 정답의 of는 앞 명사(idea, dream)와 뒤 동명사구가 같은 내용임을 나타내는 동격의 of예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Not all birds can fly.
(b) Not every road in this city is wide.
(c) Nobody in the room knew the answer.
(d) When arrived at the station, I called my mom.
(e) The fact that she won the contest surprised us.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부분 부정. (b) 옳음: not every+단수명사+단수동사. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: When (I) arrived는 be동사가 아니라 생략할 수 없으므로 When I arrived 또는 When arriving. (e) 옳음: 동격 that. 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I don't always agree with my parents.
(b) None of the milk in the fridge was fresh.
(c) If necessary, you can call me at night.
(d) The rumor that the school would close were not true.
(e) Though tired, but he kept running.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부분 부정. (b) 옳음: milk는 셀 수 없어 was. (c) 옳음: If (it is) necessary. (d) 틀림: 주어는 The rumor(단수)라 was. (e) 틀림: though와 but을 함께 쓰지 않아요. 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Not every member was at the meeting.
(b) There is a belief that black cats bring bad luck.
(c) I'd like to join you, but I don't have time to.
(d) Neither of them didn't know about the plan.
(e) While stayed in Jeju, we visited many beaches.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 동격 that. (c) 옳음: to 뒤 반복되는 join you 생략(대부정사). (d) 틀림: neither 자체가 부정이라 knew. (e) 틀림: While staying 또는 While we stayed. 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Not all the books in the library are new.
(b) I like the idea of having a pet.
(c) Though was sick, he went to school.
(d) Mr. Song, my homeroom teacher, is from Busan.
(e) Not every students passed the test.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 동격 of. (c) 틀림: 주어와 be동사를 함께 생략해 Though sick. (d) 옳음: 콤마 동격. (e) 틀림: every student. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) When in trouble, you can ask me for help.
(b) The news that he was in the hospital shocked us.
(c) I don't know nothing about it.
(d) She has a dream that she will be a vet someday.
(e) We heard the rumor which a new mall would open nearby.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: When (you are) in trouble. (b) 옳음: 동격 that. (c) 틀림: 이중 부정이라 anything. (d) 옳음: 동격 that. (e) 틀림: 동격절은 which가 아니라 that. 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Not all of the students wear glasses.
(b) None of the money was spent.
(c) Not everyone like spicy food.
(d) Although she was tired, she kept working.
(e) While I reading a book, I fell asleep.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: money는 셀 수 없어 was. (c) 틀림: everyone은 단수라 likes. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: While (I was) reading처럼 주어와 be동사를 함께 생략하거나 I was reading. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ of my friends came to the party, so I was very sad.
(B) ___ student in our class has a phone, but most of them do.
items.exp: (A) 아무도 오지 않아 슬펐으므로 전체 부정 None, (B) '모든 학생이 ~한 것은 아니다'라는 부분 부정이므로 Not every예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The fact ___ he lied to us made us angry.
(B) While ___ dinner, she cut her finger.
items.exp: (A) The fact의 내용을 설명하는 동격의 that, (B) While she was cooking에서 she was를 생략한 cooking이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 모든 학생이 그 축제에 참여한 것은 아니었다.
items.s: ___ took part in the festival.
items.exp: '모든 ~가 …한 것은 아니다'는 부분 부정 not every+단수명사로 나타내요.

items.q: 부사절에서 생략할 수 있는 부분을 생략하여 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Though she was very nervous, she gave a great speech.
items.s: ___, she gave a great speech.
items.exp: 부사절의 주어가 주절과 같고 be동사가 쓰였으므로 she was를 함께 생략해요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀가 그 대회에서 우승했다는 소식은 모두를 놀라게 했다.
items.s: The news ___ everyone.
a: that she had won the contest surprised
that she won the contest surprised
items.exp: news의 내용을 설명하는 동격의 that절을 쓰고, 주어 The news는 단수이며 과거의 일이므로 surprised예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리 부모님이 항상 나에게 화를 내시는 것은 아니다.
items.s: My parents ___ angry with me.
items.exp: '항상 ~하는 것은 아니다'는 부분 부정 not always로 나타내고, 주어가 복수이고 현재이므로 do not을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She was afraid of the rumor [which] she would lose her job. → ___
items.exp: rumor의 내용을 설명하는 동격절이므로 which가 아니라 that을 써야 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: While [I walking] home, I saw a rainbow. → ___
items.exp: 부사절의 주어와 be동사는 함께 생략하거나 함께 써야 하므로 walking 또는 I was walking으로 고쳐요.
